create or replace function private.bpay_next_source_binding_members_v1(p_receipt_id uuid)
returns table(candidate_id uuid,member_no integer,head_id uuid,prior_head_id uuid,
  work_id uuid,revision_id uuid,publication_command_id uuid,predecessor_revision_id uuid)
language plpgsql security definer
set search_path=pg_catalog,private,public
as $function$
declare
  v_receipt private.weekly_source_entitlement_publication_receipts%rowtype;
  v_n integer; v_i integer; v_row record;
begin
  select r.* into strict v_receipt from private.weekly_source_entitlement_publication_receipts r
    where r.id=p_receipt_id;
  v_n:=pg_catalog.cardinality(v_receipt.head_ids);
  if v_n not between 1 and 2 or not exists (
    select 1 from public.weekly_source_entitlement_decision_bundles b
    where b.decision_bundle_id=v_receipt.decision_bundle_id and b.bundle_revision=v_receipt.bundle_revision
      and b.candidate_id=v_receipt.candidate_id and b.state in ('PROPOSED','COMMITTED')
      and b.request_digest=v_receipt.request_digest and b.decision_id=v_receipt.decision_id
      and b.decided_by_user_id=v_receipt.decided_by_user_id) then
    raise exception using errcode='55000',message='BPAY_NEXT_BINDING_RECEIPT_NOT_QUALIFIED';
  end if;
  for v_i in 1..v_n loop
    select h.id,h.prior_head_id,w.id as work_id,r.id as revision_id,
           p.command_id,coalesce(p.predecessor_revision_id,
             case when p.command_id is null and w.current_revision_id is distinct from r.id
               then w.current_revision_id end) as predecessor_revision_id into v_row
      from public.weekly_source_entitlement_heads h
      join public.weekly_source_root_authorisations a on a.root_timesheet_id=h.root_timesheet_id
        and a.withdrawn_at_utc is null and a.current_entitlement_head_id=h.id
      join private.bpay_next_work w on w.original_timesheet_id=h.root_timesheet_id
        and w.booking_id=h.root_family_booking_id and w.candidate_id=h.candidate_id
        and w.contract_id=h.contract_id and w.week_ending_date=h.week_ending_date and w.work_kind='SOURCE'
      join private.bpay_next_work_revision r on r.work_id=w.id and r.source_head_id=h.id and r.source_event_id=h.id
        and r.physical_timesheet_id=h.root_timesheet_id and r.physical_timesheet_version=h.root_timesheet_version
        and r.source_kind in ('SOURCE','PROTECTED')
      left join private.bpay_next_publication p on p.work_id=w.id and p.revision_id=r.id
        and p.candidate_id=w.candidate_id
      where h.id=v_receipt.head_ids[v_i] and h.state='COMMITTED_CURRENT'
        and h.candidate_id=v_receipt.candidate_id and h.root_timesheet_id=v_receipt.member_root_ids[v_i]
        and h.root_family_booking_id=v_receipt.member_family_booking_ids[v_i]
        and h.root_timesheet_version=v_receipt.member_root_versions[v_i]
        and h.decision_bundle_id=v_receipt.decision_bundle_id and h.bundle_revision=v_receipt.bundle_revision
        and h.publication_receipt_digest=v_receipt.request_digest
        and h.scope_change_tx_token=v_receipt.scope_change_tx_token;
    if not found then
      raise exception using errcode='55000',message='BPAY_NEXT_BINDING_MEMBER_NOT_CURRENT';
    end if;
    candidate_id:=v_receipt.candidate_id; member_no:=v_i; head_id:=v_row.id;
    prior_head_id:=v_row.prior_head_id; work_id:=v_row.work_id; revision_id:=v_row.revision_id;
    publication_command_id:=v_row.command_id; predecessor_revision_id:=v_row.predecessor_revision_id;
    return next;
  end loop;
end
$function$;

create or replace function private.bpay_next_initial_tsfin_certificate_v1(p_root_authorisation_id uuid)
returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer
set search_path=pg_catalog,private,public
as $function$
declare
  a public.weekly_source_root_authorisations%rowtype;
  t public.timesheets%rowtype;f public.timesheets_financials%rowtype;
  w private.bpay_next_work%rowtype;r private.bpay_next_work_revision%rowtype;
  p private.bpay_next_publication%rowtype;c public.contracts%rowtype;
  inventory jsonb;basis jsonb;origin jsonb;details jsonb;n integer;epoch bigint;
begin
  if p_root_authorisation_id is null then
    raise exception 'BPAY_NEXT_INITIAL_AUTH_ID_REQUIRED' using errcode='22023';end if;
  select m.owner_epoch into epoch from private.bpay_next_module_control m
    where m.id=1 and m.active_owner='NEXT' for share;
  if epoch is null then raise exception 'BPAY_NEXT_BINDING_NEXT_REQUIRED' using errcode='55000';end if;
  select x.* into strict a from public.weekly_source_root_authorisations x where x.id=p_root_authorisation_id;
  select x.* into strict t from public.timesheets x where x.timesheet_id=a.root_timesheet_id;
  select x.* into strict c from public.contracts x where x.id=t.contract_id;
  select x.* into strict r from private.bpay_next_work_revision x where x.source_event_id=a.id;
  select x.* into strict w from private.bpay_next_work x where x.id=r.work_id;
  select x.* into strict f from public.timesheets_financials x where x.id=r.financial_snapshot_id;
  select x.* into strict p from private.bpay_next_publication x
    where x.command_id=private.bpay_next_source_command_id_v1(a.id);
  if a.withdrawn_at_utc is not null or a.current_entitlement_head_id is not null
     or exists(select 1 from public.weekly_source_entitlement_heads h where btrim(h.root_family_booking_id)=btrim(t.booking_id))
     or t.is_current is distinct from true or t.authorised_at_server is null
     or t.revoked_at is not null or t.archived_at_utc is not null
     or (a.family_booking_id,a.timesheet_version) is distinct from (t.booking_id,t.version)
     or (w.work_kind,w.candidate_id,w.contract_id,w.original_timesheet_id,w.booking_id,w.week_ending_date,(case when w.current_revision_id is not null and exists(select 1 from private.bpay_next_work_revision cr where cr.id=w.current_revision_id and cr.sealed_at_utc is not null and cr.payment_treatment_approval_revision_id is not null) then private.bpay_next_treatment_approval_revision_v1(w.current_revision_id) else w.current_revision_id end))
       is distinct from ('SOURCE'::text,c.candidate_id,c.id,t.timesheet_id,t.booking_id,t.week_ending_date,r.id)
     or w.approval_state is distinct from 'APPROVED'
     or (r.source_kind,r.source_head_id,r.source_event_id,r.physical_timesheet_id,r.physical_timesheet_version,r.week_ending_date)
       is distinct from ('SOURCE'::text,null::uuid,a.id,t.timesheet_id,t.version,t.week_ending_date)
     or r.approved_at_utc is null or r.sealed_at_utc is null
     or f.is_current is distinct from true or f.is_stale is distinct from false or f.authorised_at_utc is null
     or (f.timesheet_id,f.timesheet_version,f.candidate_id,f.client_id)
       is distinct from (t.timesheet_id,t.version,w.candidate_id,c.client_id)
     or (p.work_id,p.revision_id,p.candidate_id,p.revision_no)
       is distinct from (w.id,r.id,w.candidate_id,r.revision_no)
     or not exists(select 1 from private.bpay_next_command command
       join private.bpay_next_command_member member on member.command_id=command.id and member.candidate_id=w.candidate_id
       where command.id=p.command_id and command.command_kind='POSITION_APPLY'
         and command.module_epoch=epoch and command.status in ('SEALED','COMPLETE')
         and command.sealed_at_utc is not null and command.expected_member_count=1 and member.member_no=1
         -- INITIAL_METADATA_PHASE_V2_BEGIN: no fabricated enrollment/job.
         and ((command.status='SEALED' and command.enrolled_member_count=0
           and p.status='QUEUED' and p.phase='NEW' and p.applied_at_utc is null
           and not exists(select 1 from private.bpay_next_job job where job.command_id=command.id))
          or (command.status='COMPLETE' and command.enrolled_member_count=1
           and p.status='APPLIED' and p.phase='DONE' and p.applied_at_utc is not null
           and (select count(*) from private.bpay_next_job job where job.command_id=command.id)=1
           and exists(select 1 from private.bpay_next_job job
             join private.bpay_next_worker_control ctl on ctl.candidate_id=job.candidate_id
             where job.command_id=command.id and job.candidate_id=w.candidate_id
               and job.job_kind='POSITION_APPLY' and job.command_sequence=command.agency_sequence
               and job.module_epoch=command.module_epoch and job.status='DONE' and job.phase='DONE'
               and job.owner_epoch>0 and job.owner_epoch<=ctl.active_owner_epoch
               and job.lease_nonce is null and job.lease_until_utc is null)))
         -- INITIAL_METADATA_PHASE_V2_END
       )
  then raise exception 'BPAY_NEXT_INITIAL_AUTH_NOT_CURRENT' using errcode='55000';end if;
  inventory:=private.weekly_source_effective_inventory_v1(t.timesheet_id);
  basis:=inventory->'approval_basis';origin:=basis->'origin';
  details:=jsonb_build_object('segments',f.invoice_breakdown_json->'segments','additional_units',f.additional_units_json,
    'actual_schedule',f.actual_schedule_json,'rate_source_refs',f.rate_source_refs_json);
  if inventory->>'ok' is distinct from 'true' or inventory->>'authority' is distinct from 'TSFIN'
     or inventory->>'head_id' is not null or jsonb_typeof(inventory->'components') is distinct from 'array'
     or jsonb_typeof(basis) is distinct from 'object' or basis->'coverage_complete' is distinct from 'true'::jsonb
     or basis is distinct from private.weekly_source_inventory_approval_basis_v2(t.timesheet_id,inventory)
     or origin is distinct from jsonb_build_object('kind','INITIAL_AUTHORISED_TSFIN_V1',
       'root_authorisation_id',a.id,'financial_snapshot_id',f.id,'authorisation_generation',a.authorisation_generation,
       'root_timesheet_id',t.timesheet_id,'root_version',t.version::text,'authorised_row_signature',a.authorised_row_signature,
       'financial_snapshot_digest',encode(private.weekly_source_sha256_jsonb_v1('WEEKLY_SOURCE_APPROVED_FINANCIAL_SNAPSHOT_V2',
         jsonb_build_object('policy',f.policy_snapshot_json,'details',details,'components',inventory->'components')),'hex'),
       'inventory_digest',basis->>'inventory_digest','entitlement_digest',basis->>'entitlement_digest')
     or basis->>'detail_digest' is distinct from encode(private.weekly_source_sha256_jsonb_v1('WEEKLY_SOURCE_APPROVED_DETAIL_V2',details),'hex')
     or basis->>'policy_fingerprint' is distinct from encode(private.weekly_source_sha256_jsonb_v1('WEEKLY_SOURCE_APPROVED_POLICY_V2',f.policy_snapshot_json),'hex')
     or r.source_inventory_digest is distinct from decode(basis->>'inventory_digest','hex')
     or r.approved_source_ex_vat is distinct from (basis->>'approved_pay_ex_vat')::numeric
     or r.expected_line_count is distinct from jsonb_array_length(inventory->'components')
  then raise exception 'BPAY_NEXT_INITIAL_I1_CERTIFICATE_REQUIRED' using errcode='55000';end if;
  select count(*) into n from private.bpay_next_approved_line l where l.revision_id=r.id;
  if n<>r.expected_line_count or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(inventory->'components') component
      left join private.bpay_next_approved_line l on l.revision_id=r.id
        and l.source_component_id=(component.value->>'component_id')::uuid
        and l.component_key='SOURCE:'||(component.value->>'component_id')
      where l.id is null or l.line_no is distinct from (component.value->>'component_ordinal')::integer
        or l.evidence_ref is distinct from 'source-component:'||(component.value->>'component_id')||'#'||(component.value->>'component_sha256')
        or l.source_pay_ex_vat is distinct from case when (component.value->>'exclude_from_pay')::boolean then 0 else (component.value->>'pay_ex_vat')::numeric end
        or l.component_kind is distinct from case component.value->>'component_kind' when 'WORKED_TIME' then 'WORK' when 'ADDITIONAL_UNIT' then 'ADDITIONAL' else 'EXPENSE' end
        or l.tax_treatment is distinct from case when component.value->>'component_kind' in ('WORKED_TIME','ADDITIONAL_UNIT') then 'TAXABLE'::text
          when component.value->>'component_kind' in ('EXPENSE','SOURCE_FIXED_EXPENSE') then 'NON_TAXABLE'::text else null::text end)
  then raise exception 'BPAY_NEXT_INITIAL_SEALED_COMPONENTS_MISMATCH' using errcode='23514';end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('candidate_id',w.candidate_id,'work_id',w.id,'revision_id',r.id,'command_id',p.command_id,
    'source_channel',r.source_pay_channel,'origin',origin,'basis',basis,'components',inventory->'components',
    'certificate_digest',encode(private.weekly_source_sha256_jsonb_v1('BPAY_NEXT_INITIAL_TSFIN_CERTIFICATE_V1',basis),'hex'));
end

declare
  a public.weekly_source_root_authorisations%rowtype;
  t public.timesheets%rowtype;f public.timesheets_financials%rowtype;
  w private.bpay_next_work%rowtype;r private.bpay_next_work_revision%rowtype;
  p private.bpay_next_publication%rowtype;c public.contracts%rowtype;
  inventory jsonb;basis jsonb;origin jsonb;details jsonb;n integer;epoch bigint;
begin
  if p_root_authorisation_id is null then
    raise exception 'BPAY_NEXT_INITIAL_AUTH_ID_REQUIRED' using errcode='22023';end if;
  select m.owner_epoch into epoch from private.bpay_next_module_control m
    where m.id=1 and m.active_owner='NEXT' for share;
  if epoch is null then raise exception 'BPAY_NEXT_BINDING_NEXT_REQUIRED' using errcode='55000';end if;
  select x.* into strict a from public.weekly_source_root_authorisations x where x.id=p_root_authorisation_id;
  select x.* into strict t from public.timesheets x where x.timesheet_id=a.root_timesheet_id;
  select x.* into strict c from public.contracts x where x.id=t.contract_id;
  select x.* into strict r from private.bpay_next_work_revision x where x.source_event_id=a.id;
  select x.* into strict w from private.bpay_next_work x where x.id=r.work_id;
  select x.* into strict f from public.timesheets_financials x where x.id=r.financial_snapshot_id;
  select x.* into strict p from private.bpay_next_publication x
    where x.command_id=private.bpay_next_source_command_id_v1(a.id);
  if a.withdrawn_at_utc is not null or a.current_entitlement_head_id is not null
     or exists(select 1 from public.weekly_source_entitlement_heads h where btrim(h.root_family_booking_id)=btrim(t.booking_id))
     or t.is_current is distinct from true or t.authorised_at_server is null
     or t.revoked_at is not null or t.archived_at_utc is not null
     or (a.family_booking_id,a.timesheet_version) is distinct from (t.booking_id,t.version)
     or (w.work_kind,w.candidate_id,w.contract_id,w.original_timesheet_id,w.booking_id,w.week_ending_date,(case when w.current_revision_id is not null and exists(select 1 from private.bpay_next_work_revision cr where cr.id=w.current_revision_id and cr.sealed_at_utc is not null and cr.payment_treatment_approval_revision_id is not null) then private.bpay_next_treatment_approval_revision_v1(w.current_revision_id) else w.current_revision_id end))
       is distinct from ('SOURCE'::text,c.candidate_id,c.id,t.timesheet_id,t.booking_id,t.week_ending_date,r.id)
     or w.approval_state is distinct from 'APPROVED'
     or (r.source_kind,r.source_head_id,r.source_event_id,r.physical_timesheet_id,r.physical_timesheet_version,r.week_ending_date)
       is distinct from ('SOURCE'::text,null::uuid,a.id,t.timesheet_id,t.version,t.week_ending_date)
     or r.approved_at_utc is null or r.sealed_at_utc is null
     or f.is_current is distinct from true or f.is_stale is distinct from false or f.authorised_at_utc is null
     or (f.timesheet_id,f.timesheet_version,f.candidate_id,f.client_id)
       is distinct from (t.timesheet_id,t.version,w.candidate_id,c.client_id)
     or (p.work_id,p.revision_id,p.candidate_id,p.revision_no)
       is distinct from (w.id,r.id,w.candidate_id,r.revision_no)
     or not exists(select 1 from private.bpay_next_command command
       join private.bpay_next_command_member member on member.command_id=command.id and member.candidate_id=w.candidate_id
       where command.id=p.command_id and command.command_kind='POSITION_APPLY'
         and command.module_epoch=epoch and command.status in ('SEALED','COMPLETE')
         and command.sealed_at_utc is not null and command.expected_member_count=1 and member.member_no=1
         -- INITIAL_METADATA_PHASE_V2_BEGIN: no fabricated enrollment/job.
         and ((command.status='SEALED' and command.enrolled_member_count=0
           and p.status='QUEUED' and p.phase='NEW' and p.applied_at_utc is null
           and not exists(select 1 from private.bpay_next_job job where job.command_id=command.id))
          or (command.status='COMPLETE' and command.enrolled_member_count=1
           and p.status='APPLIED' and p.phase='DONE' and p.applied_at_utc is not null
           and (select count(*) from private.bpay_next_job job where job.command_id=command.id)=1
           and exists(select 1 from private.bpay_next_job job
             join private.bpay_next_worker_control ctl on ctl.candidate_id=job.candidate_id
             where job.command_id=command.id and job.candidate_id=w.candidate_id
               and job.job_kind='POSITION_APPLY' and job.command_sequence=command.agency_sequence
               and job.module_epoch=command.module_epoch and job.status='DONE' and job.phase='DONE'
               and job.owner_epoch>0 and job.owner_epoch<=ctl.active_owner_epoch
               and job.lease_nonce is null and job.lease_until_utc is null)))
         -- INITIAL_METADATA_PHASE_V2_END
       )
  then raise exception 'BPAY_NEXT_INITIAL_AUTH_NOT_CURRENT' using errcode='55000';end if;
  inventory:=private.weekly_source_effective_inventory_v1(t.timesheet_id);
  basis:=inventory->'approval_basis';origin:=basis->'origin';
  details:=jsonb_build_object('segments',f.invoice_breakdown_json->'segments','additional_units',f.additional_units_json,
    'actual_schedule',f.actual_schedule_json,'rate_source_refs',f.rate_source_refs_json);
  if inventory->>'ok' is distinct from 'true' or inventory->>'authority' is distinct from 'TSFIN'
     or inventory->>'head_id' is not null or jsonb_typeof(inventory->'components') is distinct from 'array'
     or jsonb_typeof(basis) is distinct from 'object' or basis->'coverage_complete' is distinct from 'true'::jsonb
     or basis is distinct from private.weekly_source_inventory_approval_basis_v2(t.timesheet_id,inventory)
     or origin is distinct from jsonb_build_object('kind','INITIAL_AUTHORISED_TSFIN_V1',
       'root_authorisation_id',a.id,'financial_snapshot_id',f.id,'authorisation_generation',a.authorisation_generation,
       'root_timesheet_id',t.timesheet_id,'root_version',t.version::text,'authorised_row_signature',a.authorised_row_signature,
       'financial_snapshot_digest',encode(private.weekly_source_sha256_jsonb_v1('WEEKLY_SOURCE_APPROVED_FINANCIAL_SNAPSHOT_V2',
         jsonb_build_object('policy',f.policy_snapshot_json,'details',details,'components',inventory->'components')),'hex'),
       'inventory_digest',basis->>'inventory_digest','entitlement_digest',basis->>'entitlement_digest')
     or basis->>'detail_digest' is distinct from encode(private.weekly_source_sha256_jsonb_v1('WEEKLY_SOURCE_APPROVED_DETAIL_V2',details),'hex')
     or basis->>'policy_fingerprint' is distinct from encode(private.weekly_source_sha256_jsonb_v1('WEEKLY_SOURCE_APPROVED_POLICY_V2',f.policy_snapshot_json),'hex')
     or r.source_inventory_digest is distinct from decode(basis->>'inventory_digest','hex')
     or r.approved_source_ex_vat is distinct from (basis->>'approved_pay_ex_vat')::numeric
     or r.expected_line_count is distinct from jsonb_array_length(inventory->'components')
  then raise exception 'BPAY_NEXT_INITIAL_I1_CERTIFICATE_REQUIRED' using errcode='55000';end if;
  select count(*) into n from private.bpay_next_approved_line l where l.revision_id=r.id;
  if n<>r.expected_line_count or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(inventory->'components') component
      left join private.bpay_next_approved_line l on l.revision_id=r.id
        and l.source_component_id=(component.value->>'component_id')::uuid
        and l.component_key='SOURCE:'||(component.value->>'component_id')
      where l.id is null or l.line_no is distinct from (component.value->>'component_ordinal')::integer
        or l.evidence_ref is distinct from 'source-component:'||(component.value->>'component_id')||'#'||(component.value->>'component_sha256')
        or l.source_pay_ex_vat is distinct from case when (component.value->>'exclude_from_pay')::boolean then 0 else (component.value->>'pay_ex_vat')::numeric end
        or l.component_kind is distinct from case component.value->>'component_kind' when 'WORKED_TIME' then 'WORK' when 'ADDITIONAL_UNIT' then 'ADDITIONAL' else 'EXPENSE' end
        or l.tax_treatment is distinct from case when component.value->>'component_kind' in ('WORKED_TIME','ADDITIONAL_UNIT') then 'TAXABLE'::text
          when component.value->>'component_kind' in ('EXPENSE','SOURCE_FIXED_EXPENSE') then 'NON_TAXABLE'::text else null::text end)
  then raise exception 'BPAY_NEXT_INITIAL_SEALED_COMPONENTS_MISMATCH' using errcode='23514';end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('candidate_id',w.candidate_id,'work_id',w.id,'revision_id',r.id,'command_id',p.command_id,
    'source_channel',r.source_pay_channel,'origin',origin,'basis',basis,'components',inventory->'components',
    'certificate_digest',encode(private.weekly_source_sha256_jsonb_v1('BPAY_NEXT_INITIAL_TSFIN_CERTIFICATE_V1',basis),'hex'));
end

create or replace function private.bpay_next_initial_tsfin_bound_assert_v1(p_binding_version_id uuid)
returns void language plpgsql security definer set search_path=pg_catalog,private,public
as $function$
declare v private.bpay_next_source_component_binding_version%rowtype;l private.bpay_next_approved_line%rowtype;
  cert jsonb;origin jsonb;basis jsonb;component jsonb;
begin
  select x.* into strict v from private.bpay_next_source_component_binding_version x where x.id=p_binding_version_id;
  if v.origin_kind is distinct from 'INITIAL_AUTHORISED_TSFIN_V1' then
    raise exception 'BPAY_NEXT_INITIAL_ORIGIN_REQUIRED' using errcode='23514';end if;
  cert:=private.bpay_next_initial_tsfin_certificate_v1(v.initial_root_authorisation_id);origin:=cert->'origin';basis:=cert->'basis';
  select value into strict component from jsonb_array_elements(cert->'components') x(value)
    where (value->>'component_id')::uuid=v.source_component_id;
  select x.* into strict l from private.bpay_next_approved_line x
    where x.revision_id=(cert->>'revision_id')::uuid and x.source_component_id=v.source_component_id;
  if (v.candidate_id,v.canonical_work_id,v.approval_work_id,v.approval_revision_id,v.publication_command_id_1,
      v.initial_financial_snapshot_id,v.initial_root_timesheet_id,v.initial_root_version,v.initial_authorisation_generation,
      v.initial_authorised_row_signature,v.initial_financial_snapshot_digest,v.initial_inventory_digest,v.initial_entitlement_digest,
      v.initial_detail_digest,v.initial_policy_digest,v.initial_certificate_digest,v.component_sha256)
    is distinct from ((cert->>'candidate_id')::uuid,(cert->>'work_id')::uuid,(cert->>'work_id')::uuid,(cert->>'revision_id')::uuid,
      (cert->>'command_id')::uuid,(origin->>'financial_snapshot_id')::uuid,(origin->>'root_timesheet_id')::uuid,
      (origin->>'root_version')::integer,(origin->>'authorisation_generation')::integer,origin->>'authorised_row_signature',
      decode(origin->>'financial_snapshot_digest','hex'),decode(basis->>'inventory_digest','hex'),decode(basis->>'entitlement_digest','hex'),
      decode(basis->>'detail_digest','hex'),decode(basis->>'policy_fingerprint','hex'),decode(cert->>'certificate_digest','hex'),
      decode(component->>'component_sha256','hex'))
     or (v.approved_line_id,v.classification_line_id,v.canonical_component_key,v.approval_component_key,
         v.approval_source_channel,v.tax_treatment,v.publication_work_id_1,v.publication_revision_id_1)
       is distinct from (l.id,l.id,l.component_key,l.component_key,cert->>'source_channel',l.tax_treatment,
         (cert->>'work_id')::uuid,(cert->>'revision_id')::uuid)
     or v.binding_digest is distinct from sha256(convert_to(jsonb_build_array('INITIAL_AUTHORISED_TSFIN_V1',v.canonical_work_id,
       v.canonical_component_key,v.approval_revision_id,v.approved_line_id,v.initial_root_authorisation_id,
       cert->>'certificate_digest',cert->>'command_id',component->>'component_sha256')::text,'UTF8'))
  then raise exception 'BPAY_NEXT_INITIAL_CAPTURE_CERTIFICATE_CHANGED' using errcode='23514';end if;
end

create or replace function private.bpay_next_segment_pay_basis_v1(p_segment_id uuid)
returns bytea language sql stable security invoker set search_path=pg_catalog,private
as $function$
  select pg_catalog.sha256(pg_catalog.convert_to(jsonb_build_array(r.work_id,s.segment_key,
    s.component_key,r.source_pay_channel,r.source_umbrella_id,
    a.tax_treatment,s.pay_excluded,s.approved_hours,s.hours_day,s.hours_night,s.hours_sat,s.hours_sun,s.hours_bh,
    case when not s.pay_excluded and s.hours_day<>0 then s.pay_day end,
    case when not s.pay_excluded and s.hours_night<>0 then s.pay_night end,
    case when not s.pay_excluded and s.hours_sat<>0 then s.pay_sat end,
    case when not s.pay_excluded and s.hours_sun<>0 then s.pay_sun end,
    case when not s.pay_excluded and s.hours_bh<>0 then s.pay_bh end,
    s.approved_source_ex_vat)::text,'UTF8'))
  from private.bpay_next_approved_segment s
  join private.bpay_next_approved_line a on a.id=s.approved_line_id
  join private.bpay_next_work_revision r on r.id=s.revision_id where s.id=p_segment_id
$function$;
routines.body:
select pg_catalog.sha256(pg_catalog.convert_to(jsonb_build_array(r.work_id,s.segment_key,
    s.component_key,r.source_pay_channel,r.source_umbrella_id,
    a.tax_treatment,s.pay_excluded,s.approved_hours,s.hours_day,s.hours_night,s.hours_sat,s.hours_sun,s.hours_bh,
    case when not s.pay_excluded and s.hours_day<>0 then s.pay_day end,
    case when not s.pay_excluded and s.hours_night<>0 then s.pay_night end,
    case when not s.pay_excluded and s.hours_sat<>0 then s.pay_sat end,
    case when not s.pay_excluded and s.hours_sun<>0 then s.pay_sun end,
    case when not s.pay_excluded and s.hours_bh<>0 then s.pay_bh end,
    s.approved_source_ex_vat)::text,'UTF8'))
  from private.bpay_next_approved_segment s
  join private.bpay_next_approved_line a on a.id=s.approved_line_id
  join private.bpay_next_work_revision r on r.id=s.revision_id where s.id=p_segment_id

create or replace function private.bpay_next_line_pay_basis_v1(p_line_id uuid)
returns bytea language sql stable security invoker set search_path=pg_catalog,private
as $function$

    r.source_pay_channel,r.source_umbrella_id,a.component_kind,
    a.tax_treatment,a.approved_quantity,case when a.approved_quantity<>0 then a.approved_unit_rate end,a.source_pay_ex_vat,
    coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(d.bucket,d.approved_hours,

    a.tax_treatment,a.approved_quantity,case when a.approved_quantity<>0 then a.approved_unit_rate end,a.source_pay_ex_vat,

create or replace function private.bpay_next_work_segment_gross_balance_v1(
  p_work_id uuid,p_component_key text,p_segment_key text)
returns table(realised_source_ex_vat numeric,active_held_source_ex_vat numeric)

      where s.work_id=p_work_id and s.component_key=p_component_key and s.segment_key=p_segment_key),0)
$function$;

      where e.work_id=p_work_id and e.component_key=p_component_key and e.segment_key=p_segment_key),0),

create or replace function private.bpay_next_work_segment_debt_basis_v1(p_work_id uuid,p_component_key text,p_revision_id uuid)
returns table(segment_key text,approved_source_ex_vat numeric,realised_source_ex_vat numeric,held_source_ex_vat numeric,
  written_off_source_ex_vat numeric,active_recovery_source_ex_vat numeric,negative_source_ex_vat numeric,
  free_recovery_source_ex_vat numeric,outstanding_source_ex_vat numeric)
language sql stable security invoker set search_path=pg_catalog,private
as $function$
  with keys as (
    select s.segment_key from private.bpay_next_approved_segment s where s.revision_id=p_revision_id and s.component_key=p_component_key
    union select s.segment_key from private.bpay_next_work_segment_origin_share s where s.work_id=p_work_id and s.component_key=p_component_key
  ), amounts as (
    select k.segment_key,coalesce(a.approved_source_ex_vat,0) a,b.realised_source_ex_vat c,b.active_held_source_ex_vat h,
      coalesce((select sum(s.written_off_source_ex_vat) from private.bpay_next_work_segment_write_off_share s
        where s.work_id=p_work_id and s.component_key=p_component_key and s.segment_key=k.segment_key),0) w,
      coalesce((select sum(s.reserved_source_ex_vat) from private.bpay_next_work_segment_recovery_share s
        join private.bpay_next_case_hold h on h.id=s.case_hold_id and h.status='ACTIVE'
        where s.work_id=p_work_id and s.component_key=p_component_key and s.segment_key=k.segment_key),0) hc
    from keys k left join private.bpay_next_approved_segment a on a.revision_id=p_revision_id
      and a.component_key=p_component_key and a.segment_key=k.segment_key
    cross join lateral private.bpay_next_work_segment_gross_balance_v1(p_work_id,p_component_key,k.segment_key) b
  ) select segment_key,a,c,h,w,hc,greatest(c-a,0),greatest(c-a-w-hc,0),greatest(c-a-w,hc,0) from amounts
$function$;
routines.body:
with keys as (
    select s.segment_key from private.bpay_next_approved_segment s where s.revision_id=p_revision_id and s.component_key=p_component_key
    union select s.segment_key from private.bpay_next_work_segment_origin_share s where s.work_id=p_work_id and s.component_key=p_component_key
  ), amounts as (
    select k.segment_key,coalesce(a.approved_source_ex_vat,0) a,b.realised_source_ex_vat c,b.active_held_source_ex_vat h,
      coalesce((select sum(s.written_off_source_ex_vat) from private.bpay_next_work_segment_write_off_share s
        where s.work_id=p_work_id and s.component_key=p_component_key and s.segment_key=k.segment_key),0) w,
      coalesce((select sum(s.reserved_source_ex_vat) from private.bpay_next_work_segment_recovery_share s
        join private.bpay_next_case_hold h on h.id=s.case_hold_id and h.status='ACTIVE'
        where s.work_id=p_work_id and s.component_key=p_component_key and s.segment_key=k.segment_key),0) hc
    from keys k left join private.bpay_next_approved_segment a on a.revision_id=p_revision_id
      and a.component_key=p_component_key and a.segment_key=k.segment_key
    cross join lateral private.bpay_next_work_segment_gross_balance_v1(p_work_id,p_component_key,k.segment_key) b
  ) select segment_key,a,c,h,w,hc,greatest(c-a,0),greatest(c-a-w-hc,0),greatest(c-a-w,hc,0) from amounts

create or replace function private.bpay_next_snooze_at_cut_v1(
  p_work_id uuid,p_revision_id uuid,p_segment_key text,p_component_key text,p_sequence bigint,p_business_date date)
returns jsonb language sql stable security invoker set search_path=pg_catalog,private
as $function$
  select e.after_state from private.bpay_next_snooze s
  join lateral(select ev.after_state from private.bpay_next_snooze_event ev
    where ev.snooze_id=s.id and ev.control_sequence<=p_sequence order by ev.control_sequence desc limit 1) e on true
  join private.bpay_next_approved_line a on a.revision_id=p_revision_id and a.component_key=p_component_key
  left join private.bpay_next_approved_segment seg on seg.revision_id=p_revision_id and seg.segment_key=p_segment_key and seg.component_key=a.component_key
  join private.bpay_next_revision_worker_basis b on b.revision_id=p_revision_id
  where s.work_id=p_work_id and (e.after_state->>'active')::boolean
    and ((e.after_state->>'until_date') is null or (e.after_state->>'until_date')::date>=p_business_date)
    and ((s.scope_kind='WHOLE_TIMESHEET' and (e.after_state->>'worker_pay_basis')::bytea=b.whole_basis)
      or (s.scope_kind='SEGMENT' and s.segment_key=p_segment_key
        and (e.after_state->>'worker_pay_basis')::bytea=private.bpay_next_segment_pay_basis_v1(seg.id))
      or (s.scope_kind='EXPENSES_ALL' and a.component_kind in ('EXPENSE','MILEAGE')
        and (e.after_state->>'worker_pay_basis')::bytea=b.expense_basis)
      or (s.scope_kind='EXPENSE_LINE' and s.component_key=p_component_key
        and (e.after_state->>'worker_pay_basis')::bytea=private.bpay_next_line_pay_basis_v1(a.id)))
  order by (e.after_state->>'until_date') is null desc,s.scope_kind,s.id limit 1
$function$;
routines.body:
select e.after_state from private.bpay_next_snooze s
  join lateral(select ev.after_state from private.bpay_next_snooze_event ev
    where ev.snooze_id=s.id and ev.control_sequence<=p_sequence order by ev.control_sequence desc limit 1) e on true
  join private.bpay_next_approved_line a on a.revision_id=p_revision_id and a.component_key=p_component_key
  left join private.bpay_next_approved_segment seg on seg.revision_id=p_revision_id and seg.segment_key=p_segment_key and seg.component_key=a.component_key
  join private.bpay_next_revision_worker_basis b on b.revision_id=p_revision_id
  where s.work_id=p_work_id and (e.after_state->>'active')::boolean
    and ((e.after_state->>'until_date') is null or (e.after_state->>'until_date')::date>=p_business_date)
    and ((s.scope_kind='WHOLE_TIMESHEET' and (e.after_state->>'worker_pay_basis')::bytea=b.whole_basis)
      or (s.scope_kind='SEGMENT' and s.segment_key=p_segment_key
        and (e.after_state->>'worker_pay_basis')::bytea=private.bpay_next_segment_pay_basis_v1(seg.id))
      or (s.scope_kind='EXPENSES_ALL' and a.component_kind in ('EXPENSE','MILEAGE')
        and (e.after_state->>'worker_pay_basis')::bytea=b.expense_basis)
      or (s.scope_kind='EXPENSE_LINE' and s.component_key=p_component_key
        and (e.after_state->>'worker_pay_basis')::bytea=private.bpay_next_line_pay_basis_v1(a.id)))
  order by (e.after_state->>'until_date') is null desc,s.scope_kind,s.id limit 1

create or replace function private.bpay_next_workbench_ensure_metadata_v1(p_candidate_id uuid)

begin

    target_pay_channel,target_umbrella_id,target_umbrella_vat_chargeable,target_umbrella_enabled,bank_warning_code)
    select c.id,coalesce(nullif(btrim(c.display_name),''),nullif(btrim(concat_ws(' ',c.first_name,c.last_name)),''),c.id::text),c.tms_ref,
      case when c.pay_method in ('PAYE','UMBRELLA') then c.pay_method end,
      case when c.pay_method='UMBRELLA' then c.umbrella_id end,
      case when c.pay_method='UMBRELLA' then u.vat_chargeable end,
      case when c.pay_method='UMBRELLA' then u.enabled end,
      case when nullif(btrim(case when c.pay_method='UMBRELLA' then u.bank_details_hash else c.bank_details_hash end),'') is null

    from public.candidates c left join public.umbrellas u on u.id=c.umbrella_id where c.id=p_candidate_id

  update private.bpay_next_workbench_candidate_metadata m set target_pay_channel=c.pay_method,
    target_umbrella_id=case when c.pay_method='UMBRELLA' then c.umbrella_id end,

    where m.candidate_id=p_candidate_id and c.id=m.candidate_id and m.target_pay_channel is null

  select m.* into strict v_metadata from private.bpay_next_workbench_candidate_metadata m
    where m.candidate_id=p_candidate_id for update;
  return v_metadata;
end

begin
  perform private.bpay_next_workbench_require_next_v1();
  return query
    with scoped as (
      select g.candidate_id,cs.client_id,cs.client_scope,ch.pay_channel,sec.section,
        i.group_key,i.component_key,i.member_kind,i.member_key,i.portion_kind,i.section item_section,
        i.selectable,i.is_selected,i.direction,i.payroll_stage,i.amount_known,i.selected_amount_known,
        (g.complete and g.certified_zero and i.member_kind='GROUP_EVIDENCE') certified_zero_evidence,
        i.reason_code,i.gross_due_source_ex_vat,i.nominal_source_ex_vat,i.approved_source_ex_vat,i.realised_source_ex_vat,
        i.active_reserved_source_ex_vat,i.included_source_ex_vat,i.excluded_source_ex_vat,
        i.recovery_source_ex_vat,i.deduction_balance_source_ex_vat,i.selected_source_ex_vat
      from private.bpay_next_workbench_item i
      join private.bpay_next_workbench_group g on g.group_key=i.group_key
      cross join lateral(select distinct v.client_id,v.client_scope from (values(g.client_id,g.client_id::text),(null::uuid,'ALL'::text)) v(client_id,client_scope)
        where v.client_scope is not null) cs
      cross join lateral(select distinct v.pay_channel from (values(g.target_pay_channel),('ALL'::text)) v(pay_channel)
        where v.pay_channel is not null) ch
      cross join lateral(select distinct v.section from (values(i.section),('ALL'::text)) v(section)) sec
      where i.group_key=p_group_key
    )
    select candidate_id,client_id,client_scope,pay_channel,section,
      count(distinct group_key)::bigint,
      count(*) filter(where member_kind<>'GROUP_EVIDENCE')::bigint,
      count(distinct (component_key,member_kind,member_key)) filter(where member_kind<>'GROUP_EVIDENCE')::bigint,
      count(*) filter(where selectable and direction='PAYMENT')::bigint,
      count(distinct (component_key,member_kind,member_key)) filter(where is_selected)::bigint,
      count(*) filter(where reason_code='SNOOZED')::bigint,
      count(*) filter(where portion_kind='RESERVED' or (portion_kind='WITHDRAWN' and active_reserved_source_ex_vat>0))::bigint,
      count(*) filter(where reason_code in ('PAY_QUERY_OPEN','PAY_QUERY_UNAVAILABLE'))::bigint,
      count(*) filter(where item_section='BLOCKED')::bigint,
      count(distinct (component_key,member_kind,member_key)) filter(where selectable and direction='DEDUCTION')::bigint,
      count(*) filter(where not amount_known and not certified_zero_evidence)::bigint,
      count(*) filter(where is_selected and not selected_amount_known)::bigint,
      coalesce(sum(included_source_ex_vat) filter(where item_section='READY' and direction='PAYMENT' and payroll_stage='GROSS_ADD'),0)::numeric,
      coalesce(sum(gross_due_source_ex_vat) filter(where item_section='WAITING' and direction='PAYMENT' and payroll_stage='GROSS_ADD' and portion_kind<>'RESERVED'),0)::numeric,
      coalesce(sum(included_source_ex_vat) filter(where item_section='READY' and direction='PAYMENT' and payroll_stage='NET_ADD'),0)::numeric,
      coalesce(sum(nominal_source_ex_vat) filter(where item_section='WAITING' and direction='PAYMENT' and payroll_stage='NET_ADD' and portion_kind<>'RESERVED'),0)::numeric,
      coalesce(sum(deduction_balance_source_ex_vat) filter(where direction='DEDUCTION' and payroll_stage='GROSS_DEDUCT'),0)::numeric,
      coalesce(sum(deduction_balance_source_ex_vat) filter(where direction='DEDUCTION' and payroll_stage='NET_DEDUCT'),0)::numeric,
      coalesce(sum(approved_source_ex_vat),0)::numeric,
      coalesce(sum(realised_source_ex_vat),0)::numeric,
      coalesce(sum(active_reserved_source_ex_vat),0)::numeric,
      coalesce(sum(excluded_source_ex_vat),0)::numeric,
      coalesce(sum(recovery_source_ex_vat),0)::numeric,
      coalesce(sum(selected_source_ex_vat) filter(where is_selected and selected_amount_known),0)::numeric
    from scoped group by candidate_id,client_id,client_scope,pay_channel,section;
end

create or replace function private.bpay_next_workbench_accepted_work_v1(
  p_work_id uuid,p_component_key text,p_segment_key text)
returns table(run_id uuid,command_id uuid,module_epoch bigint,selected_source_ex_vat numeric)
language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path=pg_catalog,private
as $function$
declare v_count integer:=0;v record;
begin
  perform private.bpay_next_workbench_require_next_v1();
  for v in
    select r.id run_id,c.id command_id,c.module_epoch,
      case when p_segment_key is not null then
        (select p.included_positive_source_ex_vat from private.bpay_next_run_work_segment_parent p
          where p.run_work_id=rw.id and p.component_key=p_component_key and p.segment_key=p_segment_key)
      else (select l.source_consumed_ex_vat from private.bpay_next_run_line l
          where l.run_work_id=rw.id and l.component_key=p_component_key) end selected_source_ex_vat
    from private.bpay_next_work_choice w
    join private.bpay_next_run_selection rs on rs.run_id=w.run_id and rs.work_id=w.work_id
    join private.bpay_next_pay_run r on r.id=w.run_id and r.selection_state='SEALED'
      and r.status in ('PREPARING','REVIEW','DRAFT','EXECUTING')
    join private.bpay_next_selection_candidate sc on sc.run_id=r.id and sc.candidate_id=rs.candidate_id
    join private.bpay_next_run_command rc on rc.run_id=r.id
    join private.bpay_next_command c on c.id=rc.command_id and c.command_kind='PREPARE'
    left join private.bpay_next_run_worker worker on worker.run_id=r.id and worker.candidate_id=rs.candidate_id
    left join private.bpay_next_run_work rw on rw.run_worker_id=worker.id and rw.work_id=w.work_id
    where w.work_id=p_work_id and w.selection_state='SEALED'
      and (worker.id is null or worker.status in ('PREPARING','REVIEW','READY','DRAFT','CANCELLING','ISSUED'))
      and ((p_segment_key is not null and exists(select 1 from private.bpay_next_selected_segment s
        where s.run_id=r.id and s.work_id=w.work_id and s.component_key=p_component_key
          and s.segment_key=p_segment_key and s.disposition='INCLUDED'))
        or (p_segment_key is null and exists(select 1 from private.bpay_next_approved_line a
          where a.revision_id=w.expected_revision_id and a.component_key=p_component_key
            and not exists(select 1 from private.bpay_next_approved_segment s
              where s.revision_id=a.revision_id and s.component_key=a.component_key))
          and (w.selection_mode='ALL' or exists(select 1 from private.bpay_next_selected_component s
            where s.run_id=r.id and s.work_id=w.work_id and s.component_key=p_component_key))
          and private.bpay_next_snooze_at_cut_v1(w.work_id,w.expected_revision_id,null,p_component_key,
            r.snooze_control_sequence,r.snooze_business_date) is null))
  loop
    v_count:=v_count+1;
    if v_count>1 then raise exception using errcode='23514',message='BPAY_NEXT_WORKBENCH_ACCEPTED_MEMBER_COLLISION';end if;
    run_id:=v.run_id;command_id:=v.command_id;module_epoch:=v.module_epoch;
    selected_source_ex_vat:=v.selected_source_ex_vat;return next;
  end loop;
end
$function$;

begin
  perform private.bpay_next_workbench_require_next_v1();
  for v in
    select r.id run_id,c.id command_id,c.module_epoch,
      case when p_segment_key is not null then
        (select p.included_positive_source_ex_vat from private.bpay_next_run_work_segment_parent p
          where p.run_work_id=rw.id and p.component_key=p_component_key and p.segment_key=p_segment_key)
      else (select l.source_consumed_ex_vat from private.bpay_next_run_line l
          where l.run_work_id=rw.id and l.component_key=p_component_key) end selected_source_ex_vat
    from private.bpay_next_work_choice w
    join private.bpay_next_run_selection rs on rs.run_id=w.run_id and rs.work_id=w.work_id
    join private.bpay_next_pay_run r on r.id=w.run_id and r.selection_state='SEALED'
      and r.status in ('PREPARING','REVIEW','DRAFT','EXECUTING')
    join private.bpay_next_selection_candidate sc on sc.run_id=r.id and sc.candidate_id=rs.candidate_id
    join private.bpay_next_run_command rc on rc.run_id=r.id
    join private.bpay_next_command c on c.id=rc.command_id and c.command_kind='PREPARE'
    left join private.bpay_next_run_worker worker on worker.run_id=r.id and worker.candidate_id=rs.candidate_id
    left join private.bpay_next_run_work rw on rw.run_worker_id=worker.id and rw.work_id=w.work_id
    where w.work_id=p_work_id and w.selection_state='SEALED'
      and (worker.id is null or worker.status in ('PREPARING','REVIEW','READY','DRAFT','CANCELLING','ISSUED'))
      and ((p_segment_key is not null and exists(select 1 from private.bpay_next_selected_segment s
        where s.run_id=r.id and s.work_id=w.work_id and s.component_key=p_component_key
          and s.segment_key=p_segment_key and s.disposition='INCLUDED'))
        or (p_segment_key is null and exists(select 1 from private.bpay_next_approved_line a
          where a.revision_id=w.expected_revision_id and a.component_key=p_component_key
            and not exists(select 1 from private.bpay_next_approved_segment s
              where s.revision_id=a.revision_id and s.component_key=a.component_key))
          and (w.selection_mode='ALL' or exists(select 1 from private.bpay_next_selected_component s
            where s.run_id=r.id and s.work_id=w.work_id and s.component_key=p_component_key))
          and private.bpay_next_snooze_at_cut_v1(w.work_id,w.expected_revision_id,null,p_component_key,
            r.snooze_control_sequence,r.snooze_business_date) is null))
  loop
    v_count:=v_count+1;
    if v_count>1 then raise exception using errcode='23514',message='BPAY_NEXT_WORKBENCH_ACCEPTED_MEMBER_COLLISION';end if;
    run_id:=v.run_id;command_id:=v.command_id;module_epoch:=v.module_epoch;
    selected_source_ex_vat:=v.selected_source_ex_vat;return next;
  end loop;
end

create or replace function private.bpay_next_workbench_work_members_v1(p_work_id uuid,p_revision_id uuid)
returns table(component_key text,approved_line_id uuid,approved_segment_id uuid,segment_key text,
  component_kind text,tax_treatment text,work_date date,approved_quantity numeric,unit_label text,
  approved_amount numeric,realised_amount numeric,held_amount numeric,source_pay_channel text,
  parent_complete boolean,segment_attribution_complete boolean)
language plpgsql security definer set search_path=pg_catalog,private
as $function$
declare v_revision private.bpay_next_work_revision%rowtype;v_approval uuid;v_event uuid;
begin
  perform private.bpay_next_workbench_require_next_v1();
  select x.* into v_revision from private.bpay_next_work_revision x where x.id=p_revision_id and x.work_id=p_work_id;
  v_approval:=p_revision_id;v_event:=v_revision.source_event_id;
  if v_revision.payment_treatment_approval_revision_id is not null and v_revision.sealed_at_utc is not null then
    v_approval:=private.bpay_next_treatment_approval_revision_v1(v_revision.id);
    select x.source_event_id into v_event from private.bpay_next_work_revision x where x.id=v_approval and x.work_id=p_work_id;
  end if;
  return query
  with source_books as materialized (
    select p.component_key,book.qualification_state,book.approval_revision_id,book.approved_line_id,
      book.source_channel,book.approved_source_ex_vat,book.native_realised_paye,book.native_realised_umbrella,
      book.native_held_paye,book.native_held_umbrella
    from private.bpay_next_work w join private.bpay_next_work_revision r on r.id=p_revision_id and r.work_id=w.id
    join private.bpay_next_position p on p.work_id=w.id and p.source_book_state='READY' and p.source_book_revision>0
    left join private.bpay_next_approved_line a on a.revision_id=r.id and a.component_key=p.component_key
    join private.bpay_next_source_component_binding b on b.canonical_work_id=w.id and b.canonical_component_key=p.component_key
    join private.bpay_next_source_component_binding_version v on v.id=b.current_binding_version_id
      and v.approval_work_id=w.id and v.approval_revision_id=v_approval and v.approval_component_key=p.component_key
    left join private.bpay_next_approved_line original_class on original_class.id=coalesce(v.classification_line_id,b.canonical_line_id)
    cross join lateral private.bpay_next_bound_source_snapshot_v1(v.id,p.source_book_revision) book
    where w.id=p_work_id and w.work_kind='SOURCE' and coalesce(a.component_kind,original_class.component_kind)='WORK' and (r.source_head_id is not null
      or (r.source_kind='SOURCE' and v_event is not null and r.financial_snapshot_id is not null))
  ), keys as (
    select a.component_key from private.bpay_next_approved_line a where a.revision_id=p_revision_id
    union select p.component_key from private.bpay_next_position p where p.work_id=p_work_id
  ), parents as (
    select k.component_key,a.id line_id,coalesce(a.component_kind,original_class.component_kind) component_kind,
      case when a.id is not null then a.tax_treatment else original_class.tax_treatment end tax_treatment,
      case when a.id is not null then a.work_date else original_class.work_date end work_date,a.approved_quantity,a.unit_label,
      p.approved_source_ex_vat a,p.realised_source_ex_vat c,p.held_source_ex_vat h,p.source_basis_channel,
      p.realised_target_ex_vat,p.realised_target_vat,p.realised_target_inc_vat,
      p.held_target_ex_vat,p.held_target_vat,p.held_target_inc_vat,
      (p.work_id is not null and p.applied_revision_id=p_revision_id
        and p.approved_source_ex_vat=coalesce(a.source_pay_ex_vat,0)
        and (a.id is not null or p.approved_source_ex_vat=0)
        and (w.work_kind<>'SOURCE' or a.id is not null or original_class.id is not null)
        and (not (w.work_kind='SOURCE' and coalesce(a.component_kind,original_class.component_kind)='WORK' and (r.source_head_id is not null
          or (r.source_kind='SOURCE' and v_event is not null and r.financial_snapshot_id is not null)))
          or (book.qualification_state='READY' and book.approval_revision_id=v_approval
            and book.approved_line_id is not distinct from aa.id and book.source_channel=r.source_pay_channel
            and (book.approved_source_ex_vat,book.native_realised_paye,book.native_held_paye,book.native_realised_umbrella,book.native_held_umbrella)
              is not distinct from (p.approved_source_ex_vat,
                case when r.source_pay_channel='PAYE' then p.realised_source_ex_vat else 0::numeric end,
                case when r.source_pay_channel='PAYE' then p.held_source_ex_vat else 0::numeric end,
                case when r.source_pay_channel='UMBRELLA' then p.realised_source_ex_vat else 0::numeric end,
                case when r.source_pay_channel='UMBRELLA' then p.held_source_ex_vat else 0::numeric end)))) complete,
      (exists(select 1 from private.bpay_next_approved_segment s where s.revision_id=p_revision_id and s.component_key=k.component_key)
        or exists(select 1 from private.bpay_next_work_segment_origin_share s where s.work_id=p_work_id and s.component_key=k.component_key)) segmented
    from keys k left join private.bpay_next_approved_line a on a.revision_id=p_revision_id and a.component_key=k.component_key
    left join private.bpay_next_approved_line aa on aa.revision_id=v_approval and aa.component_key=k.component_key
    left join private.bpay_next_position p on p.work_id=p_work_id and p.component_key=k.component_key
    join private.bpay_next_work w on w.id=p_work_id
    left join private.bpay_next_work_revision r on r.id=p_revision_id and r.work_id=w.id
    left join private.bpay_next_source_component_binding binding on binding.canonical_work_id=w.id and binding.canonical_component_key=k.component_key
    left join private.bpay_next_source_component_binding_version version on version.id=binding.current_binding_version_id
    left join private.bpay_next_approved_line original_class on original_class.id=coalesce(version.classification_line_id,binding.canonical_line_id)
    left join source_books book on book.component_key=k.component_key
  ), segment_keys as (
    select s.component_key,s.segment_key from private.bpay_next_approved_segment s where s.revision_id=p_revision_id
    union select s.component_key,s.segment_key from private.bpay_next_work_segment_origin_share s where s.work_id=p_work_id
  ), members as (
    select p.*,s.segment_key,seg.id segment_id,seg.work_date segment_date,seg.approved_hours,
      coalesce(seg.approved_source_ex_vat,0) segment_a,b.realised_source_ex_vat segment_c,b.active_held_source_ex_vat segment_h
    from parents p join segment_keys s on s.component_key=p.component_key
    left join private.bpay_next_approved_segment seg on seg.revision_id=p_revision_id
      and seg.component_key=s.component_key and seg.segment_key=s.segment_key
    cross join lateral private.bpay_next_work_segment_gross_balance_v1(p_work_id,s.component_key,s.segment_key) b
  ), totals as (
    select m.component_key,sum(m.segment_a) a,sum(m.segment_c) c,sum(m.segment_h) h from members m group by m.component_key
  ), target_credit as (
    select e.component_key,sum(e.target_ex_vat) ex,sum(e.target_vat) vat,sum(e.target_inc_vat) inc
    from private.bpay_next_work_segment_effect_share e where e.work_id=p_work_id group by e.component_key
  ), target_hold as (
    select s.component_key,sum(s.target_reserved_ex_vat) ex,sum(s.target_reserved_vat) vat,sum(s.target_reserved_inc_vat) inc
    from private.bpay_next_work_segment_origin_share s join private.bpay_next_hold h on h.id=s.hold_id and h.status='ACTIVE'
    where s.work_id=p_work_id group by s.component_key
  )
  select m.component_key,m.line_id,m.segment_id,m.segment_key,m.component_kind,m.tax_treatment,
    m.segment_date,m.approved_hours,'hours'::text,m.segment_a,m.segment_c,m.segment_h,m.source_basis_channel,
    coalesce(m.complete,false),
    ((t.a,t.c,t.h,coalesce(c.ex,0),coalesce(c.vat,0),coalesce(c.inc,0),coalesce(h.ex,0),coalesce(h.vat,0),coalesce(h.inc,0))
      is not distinct from (m.a,m.c,m.h,m.realised_target_ex_vat,m.realised_target_vat,m.realised_target_inc_vat,
        m.held_target_ex_vat,m.held_target_vat,m.held_target_inc_vat))
    from members m join totals t on t.component_key=m.component_key
      left join target_credit c on c.component_key=m.component_key left join target_hold h on h.component_key=m.component_key
  union all
  select p.component_key,p.line_id,null::uuid,null::text,p.component_kind,p.tax_treatment,p.work_date,
    p.approved_quantity,p.unit_label,p.a,p.c,p.h,p.source_basis_channel,coalesce(p.complete,false),true
    from parents p where not p.segmented;
end

create or replace function private.bpay_next_workbench_refresh_group_display_v1(p_group_key text)
returns void language plpgsql security definer set search_path=pg_catalog,private,public
as $function$
declare
 g private.bpay_next_workbench_group%rowtype;w private.bpay_next_work%rowtype;
 r private.bpay_next_work_revision%rowtype;c public.candidates%rowtype;u public.umbrellas%rowtype;
 v_date_context jsonb;v_pay_date date;v_sensitive boolean:=false;v_component record;
 v_keys text[];v_source numeric;v_quote jsonb;v_delta numeric:=0;
begin
  perform private.bpay_next_workbench_require_next_v1();
  if p_group_key is null then raise exception using errcode='22023',message='BPAY_NEXT_WORKBENCH_GROUP_INVALID';end if;
  select x.* into g from private.bpay_next_workbench_group x where x.group_key=p_group_key;
  -- Native projection owners hold Candidate then Work and prove Source A/R/H
  -- before this display-only replacement. No summary/delta money changes.
  if g.group_kind='WORK' and g.complete and not g.dirty and g.progress_state='CURRENT' then
    select x.* into strict w from private.bpay_next_work x where x.id=g.work_id;
    select x.* into strict r from private.bpay_next_work_revision x where x.id=g.current_revision_id and x.work_id=w.id;
    select x.* into strict c from public.candidates x where x.id=g.candidate_id;
    select x.* into u from public.umbrellas x where x.id=c.umbrella_id;
    v_date_context:=public.pay_banking_official_date_context_v1(null::timestamptz);
    if v_date_context->>'ok' is distinct from 'true' or v_date_context->>'current_official_pay_date' is null then
      raise exception using errcode='55000',message='BPAY_NEXT_WORKBENCH_DATE_UNAVAILABLE';end if;
    v_pay_date:=(v_date_context->>'current_official_pay_date')::date;

    case when g.group_kind='CASE' and fc.case_kind<>'OVERPAYMENT' then i.case_component_id end case_component_id,

    bool_or(direction='DEDUCTION') has_deduction,bool_or(selectable) selectable,
    (array_agg(reason_code order by reason_priority,id))[1] reason_code,min(reason_priority::smallint) reason_priority,

          g.target_pay_channel,case when g.target_pay_channel='UMBRELLA' then u.id end,
          case when g.target_pay_channel='UMBRELLA' then u.vat_chargeable end,null::date) is not null);
    end if;
    for v_component in select distinct i.approved_line_id,i.component_key
      from private.bpay_next_workbench_item i where i.group_key=g.group_key and i.revision_id=r.id
        and i.tax_treatment='TAXABLE' and i.section='READY' and i.selectable and i.amount_known and not i.is_selected
        and i.direction='PAYMENT' and i.portion_kind in ('AVAILABLE','ZERO')

          and (d.based_on_revision_id=r.id or d.published_revision_id=r.id)
          and (case when d.based_on_revision_id=r.id then d.approved_line_id else d.published_line_id end)=i.approved_line_id)
      order by i.component_key,i.approved_line_id loop
      with native as materialized(select i.* from private.bpay_next_workbench_item i

          and i.component_key=v_component.component_key and i.section='READY' and i.selectable and i.amount_known
          and not i.is_selected and i.direction='PAYMENT' and i.portion_kind in ('AVAILABLE','ZERO')
        order by i.member_kind,i.member_key,i.id limit 10001)

        order by i.member_kind,i.member_key,i.id),sum(i.included_source_ex_vat)
        into v_keys,v_source from native i;

        v_delta:=v_delta+(v_quote->'component_quote'->>'ex')::numeric-v_source;
      end if;
    end loop;
  end if;

    update private.bpay_next_workbench_group_display set group_amount=group_amount+v_delta
      where parent_group_key=p_group_key and presentation_kind='WORK' and section='READY' and group_amount is not null;
    -- Certification follows the complete replacement, never partial paging.
    update private.bpay_next_workbench_group set chosen_display_date_sensitive=v_sensitive,
      chosen_display_pay_date=case when v_sensitive then v_pay_date end where group_key=p_group_key;
  end if;
end

create or replace function private.bpay_next_worker_release_complete_v1(p_run_worker_id uuid,p_cutoff timestamptz)
returns boolean language sql volatile security invoker set search_path=pg_catalog,private
as $function$
  select exists(select 1 from private.bpay_next_run_worker w
    join private.bpay_next_worker_reprepare_request x on x.run_worker_id=w.id and x.target_preparation_revision=w.preparation_revision
    join private.bpay_next_job j on j.id=x.job_id and j.id=w.active_prepare_job_id and j.command_id=x.command_id
      and j.candidate_id=w.candidate_id and j.module_epoch=x.module_epoch and j.job_kind='PREPARE' and j.status='DONE' and j.phase='CANCELLED'
    join private.bpay_next_run_command rc on rc.run_id=w.run_id and rc.command_id=x.original_prepare_command_id
    join private.bpay_next_job original on original.id=x.input_prepare_job_id and original.id=w.input_prepare_job_id
      and original.command_id=rc.command_id and original.candidate_id=w.candidate_id and original.job_kind='PREPARE' and original.status='DONE'
    join private.bpay_next_module_control m on m.id=1 and m.active_owner='NEXT' and m.owner_epoch=x.module_epoch
    where w.id=p_run_worker_id and w.status='CANCELLED' and x.run_id=w.run_id and x.candidate_id=w.candidate_id
      and x.action='RELEASE' and x.status='COMPLETE' and x.stage='COMPLETE' and x.finished_at_utc<=p_cutoff
      and x.captured_preparation_revision=w.captured_preparation_revision and x.selection_revision=w.case_selection_revision
      and x.expected_work_count=w.captured_line_count and x.released_work_count=x.expected_work_count
      and x.released_case_hold_count=x.expected_case_hold_count and w.active_case_hold_count=0
      and w.realised_effect_count=0 and w.net_request_revision=0 and w.net_projection_revision=0
      and not exists(select 1 from private.bpay_next_case_hold h where h.run_worker_id=w.id and h.status='ACTIVE')
      and not exists(select 1 from private.bpay_next_hold h join private.bpay_next_run_line l on l.id=h.run_line_id where l.run_worker_id=w.id and h.status='ACTIVE')
      and not exists(select 1 from private.bpay_next_transfer where run_worker_id=w.id)
      and not exists(select 1 from private.bpay_next_net_projection where run_worker_id=w.id))
$function$;
routines.body:
select exists(select 1 from private.bpay_next_run_worker w
    join private.bpay_next_worker_reprepare_request x on x.run_worker_id=w.id and x.target_preparation_revision=w.preparation_revision
    join private.bpay_next_job j on j.id=x.job_id and j.id=w.active_prepare_job_id and j.command_id=x.command_id
      and j.candidate_id=w.candidate_id and j.module_epoch=x.module_epoch and j.job_kind='PREPARE' and j.status='DONE' and j.phase='CANCELLED'
    join private.bpay_next_run_command rc on rc.run_id=w.run_id and rc.command_id=x.original_prepare_command_id
    join private.bpay_next_job original on original.id=x.input_prepare_job_id and original.id=w.input_prepare_job_id
      and original.command_id=rc.command_id and original.candidate_id=w.candidate_id and original.job_kind='PREPARE' and original.status='DONE'
    join private.bpay_next_module_control m on m.id=1 and m.active_owner='NEXT' and m.owner_epoch=x.module_epoch
    where w.id=p_run_worker_id and w.status='CANCELLED' and x.run_id=w.run_id and x.candidate_id=w.candidate_id
      and x.action='RELEASE' and x.status='COMPLETE' and x.stage='COMPLETE' and x.finished_at_utc<=p_cutoff
      and x.captured_preparation_revision=w.captured_preparation_revision and x.selection_revision=w.case_selection_revision
      and x.expected_work_count=w.captured_line_count and x.released_work_count=x.expected_work_count
      and x.released_case_hold_count=x.expected_case_hold_count and w.active_case_hold_count=0
      and w.realised_effect_count=0 and w.net_request_revision=0 and w.net_projection_revision=0
      and not exists(select 1 from private.bpay_next_case_hold h where h.run_worker_id=w.id and h.status='ACTIVE')
      and not exists(select 1 from private.bpay_next_hold h join private.bpay_next_run_line l on l.id=h.run_line_id where l.run_worker_id=w.id and h.status='ACTIVE')
      and not exists(select 1 from private.bpay_next_transfer where run_worker_id=w.id)
      and not exists(select 1 from private.bpay_next_net_projection where run_worker_id=w.id))
