create or replace function private.bpay_next_work_collection_observation_v1(
  p_work_id uuid,p_component_key text,p_revision_id uuid
) returns jsonb language plpgsql stable security invoker set search_path=pg_catalog,private
as $function$
declare v_position private.bpay_next_position%rowtype;v_work private.bpay_next_work%rowtype;
  v_revision private.bpay_next_work_revision%rowtype;v_original private.bpay_next_work_revision%rowtype;
  v_source_current private.bpay_next_work_revision%rowtype;v_source_original private.bpay_next_work_revision%rowtype;
  v_basis private.bpay_next_work_collection%rowtype;v_line private.bpay_next_approved_line%rowtype;
  v_case private.bpay_next_finance_case%rowtype;v_component private.bpay_next_case_component%rowtype;
  v_current private.bpay_next_approved_line%rowtype;v_segments record;v_segmented boolean;
  v_retained boolean:=false;v_removed boolean:=false;v_complete boolean:=false;v_outstanding numeric;v_free numeric;v_negative numeric;v_positive numeric;v_overhang numeric;
begin
  select pos.* into v_position from private.bpay_next_position pos where pos.work_id=p_work_id and pos.component_key=p_component_key;
  select wrk.* into v_work from private.bpay_next_work wrk where wrk.id=p_work_id;
  select rev.* into v_revision from private.bpay_next_work_revision rev where rev.id=p_revision_id and rev.work_id=p_work_id;
  select coll.* into v_basis from private.bpay_next_work_collection coll where coll.work_id=p_work_id and coll.component_key=p_component_key;
  -- Withdrawal retains a previously known sealed observation, never approval zero.
  v_retained:=v_work.approval_state='WITHDRAWN' and v_work.current_revision_id is null
    and v_work.applied_revision_id=p_revision_id and v_basis.observed_revision_id=p_revision_id
    and v_basis.observed_approved_source_ex_vat=v_position.approved_source_ex_vat
    and v_basis.collection_mode='MANUAL' and v_basis.manual_reason_code='AUTOMATIC_COLLECTION_UNAVAILABLE'
    and v_basis.manual_outstanding_source_ex_vat is not null;
  if v_basis.id is null or v_position.applied_revision_id is distinct from p_revision_id
    or not (coalesce(v_retained,false) or (v_work.current_revision_id=p_revision_id and v_work.approval_state='APPROVED'))
    or v_revision.sealed_at_utc is null or v_position.approved_source_ex_vat<0 or v_position.realised_source_ex_vat<0 then
    return jsonb_build_object('complete',false,'segmented',false);end if;
  select rev.* into strict v_original from private.bpay_next_work_revision rev where rev.id=v_basis.original_revision_id;
  select source.* into strict v_source_current from private.bpay_next_work_revision source
    where source.work_id=p_work_id and source.id=(case when v_revision.sealed_at_utc is not null and v_revision.payment_treatment_approval_revision_id is not null then private.bpay_next_treatment_approval_revision_v1(v_revision.id) else v_revision.id end);
  select source.* into strict v_source_original from private.bpay_next_work_revision source
    where source.work_id=p_work_id and source.id=(case when v_original.sealed_at_utc is not null and v_original.payment_treatment_approval_revision_id is not null then private.bpay_next_treatment_approval_revision_v1(v_original.id) else v_original.id end);
  select line.* into strict v_line from private.bpay_next_approved_line line where line.id=v_basis.original_approved_line_id;
  select line.* into v_current from private.bpay_next_approved_line line where line.revision_id=p_revision_id and line.component_key=p_component_key;
  if v_basis.case_id is not null then
    select fc.* into strict v_case from private.bpay_next_finance_case fc where fc.id=v_basis.case_id;
    select cc.* into strict v_component from private.bpay_next_case_component cc where cc.id=v_basis.case_component_id;
    if (v_case.principal_approved,v_case.principal_recovered,v_case.principal_written_off,v_case.active_recovery_hold_amount)
      is distinct from (v_component.approved_source_ex_vat,v_component.recovered_source_ex_vat,
        v_component.written_off_source_ex_vat,v_component.active_recovery_source_ex_vat) then
      return jsonb_build_object('complete',false,'segmented',false);end if;
  end if;
  if v_revision.source_pay_channel is distinct from v_basis.original_source_pay_channel
    or v_position.source_basis_channel is distinct from v_basis.original_source_pay_channel then
    return jsonb_build_object('complete',false,'segmented',false);end if;
  -- The same typed authorised key, not an arbitrary absent DAY/aggregate.
  v_complete:=v_revision.detail_kind=v_original.detail_kind and v_current.id is not null
    and v_current.component_kind=v_line.component_kind
    and v_current.tax_treatment is not distinct from v_line.tax_treatment
    and v_current.source_component_id is not distinct from v_line.source_component_id
    and v_current.source_pay_ex_vat=v_position.approved_source_ex_vat;
  v_complete:=v_complete or (v_revision.certified_zero and v_revision.expected_line_count=0
    and v_revision.approved_source_ex_vat=0 and v_position.approved_source_ex_vat=0);
  -- Explicit accepted REMOVED membership certifies this typed component's zero.
  -- A surviving fixed sibling may make the current revision FIXED; the paid
  -- component and native segment counters retain their original identity.
  v_removed:=v_work.work_kind='SOURCE' and v_original.work_id=p_work_id
    and v_line.revision_id=v_original.id and v_line.component_key=p_component_key
    and v_line.source_component_id is not null
    and p_component_key='SOURCE:'||v_line.source_component_id::text
    and v_current.id is null and v_position.approved_source_ex_vat=0
    and v_revision.source_head_id is not null and v_source_current.source_event_id=v_revision.source_head_id
    and ((v_source_original.source_kind='SOURCE' and v_source_original.source_event_id is not null
        and (v_source_original.source_head_id is null or v_source_original.source_head_id=v_source_original.source_event_id))
      or (v_source_original.source_kind='PROTECTED' and v_source_original.source_head_id is not null
        and v_source_original.source_head_id=v_source_original.source_event_id))
    and ((v_revision.source_kind='SOURCE' and v_source_current.source_event_id is not null
        and (v_revision.source_head_id is null or v_revision.source_head_id=v_source_current.source_event_id))
      or (v_revision.source_kind='PROTECTED' and v_revision.source_head_id is not null
        and v_revision.source_head_id=v_source_current.source_event_id))
    and exists(
      select 1 from private.bpay_next_source_component_binding b
        join private.bpay_next_source_component_binding_version bv on bv.id=b.current_binding_version_id
          and bv.canonical_work_id=b.canonical_work_id and bv.canonical_component_key=b.canonical_component_key
          and bv.candidate_id=b.candidate_id and bv.source_component_id=b.source_component_id
        join private.bpay_next_approved_line classification on classification.id=bv.classification_line_id
        join private.bpay_next_work_revision classified on classified.id=classification.revision_id
          and classified.work_id=p_work_id and classified.sealed_at_utc is not null
        join private.weekly_source_entitlement_publication_receipts receipt on receipt.id=bv.source_receipt_id
        join public.weekly_source_entitlement_decision_bundles bundle on bundle.decision_bundle_id=bv.decision_bundle_id
          and bundle.bundle_revision=bv.bundle_revision and bundle.state='COMMITTED'
        join public.weekly_source_entitlement_heads head on head.id=bv.head_id and head.state='COMMITTED_CURRENT'
        join public.weekly_source_root_authorisations auth on auth.current_entitlement_head_id=head.id
          and auth.root_timesheet_id=head.root_timesheet_id and auth.withdrawn_at_utc is null
        join private.bpay_next_publication publication on publication.command_id=bv.publication_command_id_1
          and publication.work_id=bv.publication_work_id_1 and publication.revision_id=bv.publication_revision_id_1
          and publication.candidate_id=v_work.candidate_id
        join private.bpay_next_publication actual_publication on actual_publication.work_id=p_work_id
          and actual_publication.revision_id=p_revision_id and actual_publication.candidate_id=v_work.candidate_id
      where b.canonical_work_id=p_work_id and b.canonical_component_key=p_component_key
        and b.candidate_id=v_work.candidate_id and b.source_component_id=v_line.source_component_id
        and bv.component_state='REMOVED' and bv.approved_line_id is null
        and bv.approval_work_id=p_work_id and bv.approval_revision_id=v_source_current.id
        and bv.approval_component_key=p_component_key and bv.approval_source_channel=v_basis.original_source_pay_channel
        and bv.publication_work_id_1=p_work_id and bv.publication_revision_id_1=v_source_current.id
        and bv.publication_command_id_2 is null and bv.publication_work_id_2 is null and bv.publication_revision_id_2 is null
        and bv.head_id=v_revision.source_head_id
        and classification.component_key=p_component_key and classification.source_component_id=v_line.source_component_id
        and classification.component_kind=v_line.component_kind
        and classification.tax_treatment is not distinct from v_line.tax_treatment
        and bv.tax_treatment is not distinct from v_line.tax_treatment
        and classified.source_pay_channel=v_basis.original_source_pay_channel
        and ((classified.source_kind='SOURCE' and classified.source_event_id is not null
            and (classified.source_head_id is null or classified.source_head_id=classified.source_event_id))
          or (classified.source_kind='PROTECTED' and classified.source_head_id is not null
            and classified.source_head_id=classified.source_event_id))
        and receipt.candidate_id=v_work.candidate_id and receipt.decision_bundle_id=bv.decision_bundle_id
        and receipt.bundle_revision=bv.bundle_revision and receipt.request_digest=bv.request_digest
        and cardinality(receipt.head_ids)=1 and receipt.head_ids[1]=bv.head_id
        and publication.status in ('QUEUED','APPLYING','APPLIED')
        and actual_publication.status in ('QUEUED','APPLYING','APPLIED'));
  v_complete:=v_complete or coalesce(v_removed,false);
  -- A Source head must be the genuinely authorised committed book. An
  -- unrelated/unbound binding is retained as AMOUNT_UNBOUND, never zero.
  if not coalesce(v_retained,false) and v_work.work_kind='SOURCE' and v_revision.source_head_id is not null and not exists(
    select 1 from private.bpay_next_source_component_binding b
      join private.bpay_next_source_component_binding_version bv on bv.id=b.current_binding_version_id
      join private.weekly_source_entitlement_publication_receipts receipt on receipt.id=bv.source_receipt_id
      join public.weekly_source_entitlement_decision_bundles bundle on bundle.decision_bundle_id=bv.decision_bundle_id
        and bundle.bundle_revision=bv.bundle_revision and bundle.state='COMMITTED'
      join public.weekly_source_entitlement_heads head on head.id=bv.head_id and head.state='COMMITTED_CURRENT'
      join public.weekly_source_root_authorisations auth on auth.current_entitlement_head_id=head.id
        and auth.root_timesheet_id=head.root_timesheet_id and auth.withdrawn_at_utc is null
      join private.bpay_next_publication publication on publication.command_id=bv.publication_command_id_1
        and publication.work_id=p_work_id and publication.revision_id=v_source_current.id and publication.candidate_id=v_work.candidate_id
      join private.bpay_next_publication actual_publication on actual_publication.work_id=p_work_id
        and actual_publication.revision_id=p_revision_id and actual_publication.candidate_id=v_work.candidate_id
      where b.canonical_work_id=p_work_id and b.canonical_component_key=p_component_key
        and bv.approval_work_id=p_work_id and bv.approval_component_key=p_component_key
        and bv.approval_revision_id=v_source_current.id and bv.candidate_id=v_work.candidate_id
        and bv.publication_command_id_2 is null and bv.head_id=v_revision.source_head_id
        and v_source_current.source_event_id=bv.head_id and bv.approval_source_channel=v_revision.source_pay_channel
        and receipt.decision_bundle_id=bv.decision_bundle_id and receipt.bundle_revision=bv.bundle_revision
        and receipt.request_digest=bv.request_digest and cardinality(receipt.head_ids)=1 and receipt.head_ids[1]=bv.head_id
        and publication.status in ('QUEUED','APPLYING','APPLIED')
        and actual_publication.status in ('QUEUED','APPLYING','APPLIED')) then v_complete:=false;end if;
  v_segmented:=exists(select 1 from private.bpay_next_approved_segment a where a.revision_id=p_revision_id and a.component_key=p_component_key)
    or exists(select 1 from private.bpay_next_work_segment_origin_share s where s.work_id=p_work_id and s.component_key=p_component_key);
  if v_segmented then
    -- Reuse native maintained segment balances. Original actual target totals
    -- must also reconcile; no gross-to-net ratio or history re-sum.
    select count(d.segment_key) n,bool_and(d.approved_source_ex_vat>=0 and d.realised_source_ex_vat>=0) nonnegative,
      sum(d.approved_source_ex_vat) approved,sum(d.realised_source_ex_vat) realised,sum(d.held_source_ex_vat) held,
      sum(d.written_off_source_ex_vat) written_off,sum(d.active_recovery_source_ex_vat) recovery_held,
      sum(credit.ex) realised_ex,sum(credit.vat) realised_vat,sum(credit.inc) realised_inc,
      sum(held.ex) held_ex,sum(held.vat) held_vat,sum(held.inc) held_inc,
      sum(d.outstanding_source_ex_vat) outstanding,sum(d.free_recovery_source_ex_vat) free,
      sum(d.negative_source_ex_vat) negative,
      sum(greatest(d.approved_source_ex_vat-d.realised_source_ex_vat-d.held_source_ex_vat,0)) positive,
      sum(greatest(d.held_source_ex_vat-greatest(d.approved_source_ex_vat-d.realised_source_ex_vat,0),0)) overhang
      into v_segments from private.bpay_next_work_segment_debt_basis_v1(p_work_id,p_component_key,p_revision_id) d
      cross join lateral (select coalesce(sum(e.target_ex_vat),0) ex,coalesce(sum(e.target_vat),0) vat,coalesce(sum(e.target_inc_vat),0) inc
        from private.bpay_next_work_segment_effect_share e where e.work_id=p_work_id and e.component_key=p_component_key and e.segment_key=d.segment_key) credit
      cross join lateral (select coalesce(sum(s.target_reserved_ex_vat),0) ex,coalesce(sum(s.target_reserved_vat),0) vat,coalesce(sum(s.target_reserved_inc_vat),0) inc
        from private.bpay_next_work_segment_origin_share s join private.bpay_next_hold h on h.id=s.hold_id and h.status='ACTIVE'
        where s.work_id=p_work_id and s.component_key=p_component_key and s.segment_key=d.segment_key) held;
    v_complete:=v_complete and v_line.component_kind='WORK' and (v_revision.detail_kind='SHIFT' or v_revision.certified_zero
        or (coalesce(v_removed,false) and v_original.detail_kind='SHIFT'))
      and v_segments.n>0 and v_segments.nonnegative
      and (v_segments.approved,v_segments.realised,v_segments.held,v_segments.realised_ex,v_segments.realised_vat,v_segments.realised_inc,
        v_segments.held_ex,v_segments.held_vat,v_segments.held_inc,v_segments.written_off,v_segments.recovery_held)
        is not distinct from (v_position.approved_source_ex_vat,v_position.realised_source_ex_vat,v_position.held_source_ex_vat,
          v_position.realised_target_ex_vat,v_position.realised_target_vat,v_position.realised_target_inc_vat,
          v_position.held_target_ex_vat,v_position.held_target_vat,v_position.held_target_inc_vat,
          coalesce(v_case.principal_written_off,0),coalesce(v_case.active_recovery_hold_amount,0));
    v_outstanding:=v_segments.outstanding;v_free:=v_segments.free;v_negative:=v_segments.negative;v_positive:=v_segments.positive;v_overhang:=v_segments.overhang;
  else
    v_outstanding:=greatest(v_position.realised_source_ex_vat-v_position.approved_source_ex_vat-coalesce(v_case.principal_written_off,0),
      coalesce(v_case.active_recovery_hold_amount,0),0);
    v_free:=v_outstanding-coalesce(v_case.active_recovery_hold_amount,0);
    v_negative:=greatest(v_position.realised_source_ex_vat-v_position.approved_source_ex_vat,0);
    v_positive:=greatest(v_position.approved_source_ex_vat-v_position.realised_source_ex_vat-v_position.held_source_ex_vat,0);
    v_overhang:=greatest(v_position.held_source_ex_vat-greatest(v_position.approved_source_ex_vat-v_position.realised_source_ex_vat,0),0);
  end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('complete',coalesce(v_complete,false),'segmented',v_segmented,
    'outstanding_source_ex_vat',case when v_complete then v_outstanding end,
    'free_recovery_source_ex_vat',case when v_complete then v_free end,
    'negative_source_ex_vat',case when v_complete then v_negative end,
    'positive_source_ex_vat',case when v_complete then v_positive end,
    'held_overhang_source_ex_vat',case when v_complete then v_overhang end);
end
$function$;
routines.body:
declare v_position private.bpay_next_position%rowtype;v_work private.bpay_next_work%rowtype;
  v_revision private.bpay_next_work_revision%rowtype;v_original private.bpay_next_work_revision%rowtype;
  v_source_current private.bpay_next_work_revision%rowtype;v_source_original private.bpay_next_work_revision%rowtype;
  v_basis private.bpay_next_work_collection%rowtype;v_line private.bpay_next_approved_line%rowtype;
  v_case private.bpay_next_finance_case%rowtype;v_component private.bpay_next_case_component%rowtype;
  v_current private.bpay_next_approved_line%rowtype;v_segments record;v_segmented boolean;
  v_retained boolean:=false;v_removed boolean:=false;v_complete boolean:=false;v_outstanding numeric;v_free numeric;v_negative numeric;v_positive numeric;v_overhang numeric;
begin
  select pos.* into v_position from private.bpay_next_position pos where pos.work_id=p_work_id and pos.component_key=p_component_key;
  select wrk.* into v_work from private.bpay_next_work wrk where wrk.id=p_work_id;
  select rev.* into v_revision from private.bpay_next_work_revision rev where rev.id=p_revision_id and rev.work_id=p_work_id;
  select coll.* into v_basis from private.bpay_next_work_collection coll where coll.work_id=p_work_id and coll.component_key=p_component_key;
  -- Withdrawal retains a previously known sealed observation, never approval zero.
  v_retained:=v_work.approval_state='WITHDRAWN' and v_work.current_revision_id is null
    and v_work.applied_revision_id=p_revision_id and v_basis.observed_revision_id=p_revision_id
    and v_basis.observed_approved_source_ex_vat=v_position.approved_source_ex_vat
    and v_basis.collection_mode='MANUAL' and v_basis.manual_reason_code='AUTOMATIC_COLLECTION_UNAVAILABLE'
    and v_basis.manual_outstanding_source_ex_vat is not null;
  if v_basis.id is null or v_position.applied_revision_id is distinct from p_revision_id
    or not (coalesce(v_retained,false) or (v_work.current_revision_id=p_revision_id and v_work.approval_state='APPROVED'))
    or v_revision.sealed_at_utc is null or v_position.approved_source_ex_vat<0 or v_position.realised_source_ex_vat<0 then
    return jsonb_build_object('complete',false,'segmented',false);end if;
  select rev.* into strict v_original from private.bpay_next_work_revision rev where rev.id=v_basis.original_revision_id;
  select source.* into strict v_source_current from private.bpay_next_work_revision source
    where source.work_id=p_work_id and source.id=(case when v_revision.sealed_at_utc is not null and v_revision.payment_treatment_approval_revision_id is not null then private.bpay_next_treatment_approval_revision_v1(v_revision.id) else v_revision.id end);
  select source.* into strict v_source_original from private.bpay_next_work_revision source
    where source.work_id=p_work_id and source.id=(case when v_original.sealed_at_utc is not null and v_original.payment_treatment_approval_revision_id is not null then private.bpay_next_treatment_approval_revision_v1(v_original.id) else v_original.id end);
  select line.* into strict v_line from private.bpay_next_approved_line line where line.id=v_basis.original_approved_line_id;
  select line.* into v_current from private.bpay_next_approved_line line where line.revision_id=p_revision_id and line.component_key=p_component_key;
  if v_basis.case_id is not null then
    select fc.* into strict v_case from private.bpay_next_finance_case fc where fc.id=v_basis.case_id;
    select cc.* into strict v_component from private.bpay_next_case_component cc where cc.id=v_basis.case_component_id;
    if (v_case.principal_approved,v_case.principal_recovered,v_case.principal_written_off,v_case.active_recovery_hold_amount)
      is distinct from (v_component.approved_source_ex_vat,v_component.recovered_source_ex_vat,
        v_component.written_off_source_ex_vat,v_component.active_recovery_source_ex_vat) then
      return jsonb_build_object('complete',false,'segmented',false);end if;
  end if;
  if v_revision.source_pay_channel is distinct from v_basis.original_source_pay_channel
    or v_position.source_basis_channel is distinct from v_basis.original_source_pay_channel then
    return jsonb_build_object('complete',false,'segmented',false);end if;
  -- The same typed authorised key, not an arbitrary absent DAY/aggregate.
  v_complete:=v_revision.detail_kind=v_original.detail_kind and v_current.id is not null
    and v_current.component_kind=v_line.component_kind
    and v_current.tax_treatment is not distinct from v_line.tax_treatment
    and v_current.source_component_id is not distinct from v_line.source_component_id
    and v_current.source_pay_ex_vat=v_position.approved_source_ex_vat;
  v_complete:=v_complete or (v_revision.certified_zero and v_revision.expected_line_count=0
    and v_revision.approved_source_ex_vat=0 and v_position.approved_source_ex_vat=0);
  -- Explicit accepted REMOVED membership certifies this typed component's zero.
  -- A surviving fixed sibling may make the current revision FIXED; the paid
  -- component and native segment counters retain their original identity.
  v_removed:=v_work.work_kind='SOURCE' and v_original.work_id=p_work_id
    and v_line.revision_id=v_original.id and v_line.component_key=p_component_key
    and v_line.source_component_id is not null
    and p_component_key='SOURCE:'||v_line.source_component_id::text
    and v_current.id is null and v_position.approved_source_ex_vat=0
    and v_revision.source_head_id is not null and v_source_current.source_event_id=v_revision.source_head_id
    and ((v_source_original.source_kind='SOURCE' and v_source_original.source_event_id is not null
        and (v_source_original.source_head_id is null or v_source_original.source_head_id=v_source_original.source_event_id))
      or (v_source_original.source_kind='PROTECTED' and v_source_original.source_head_id is not null
        and v_source_original.source_head_id=v_source_original.source_event_id))
    and ((v_revision.source_kind='SOURCE' and v_source_current.source_event_id is not null
        and (v_revision.source_head_id is null or v_revision.source_head_id=v_source_current.source_event_id))
      or (v_revision.source_kind='PROTECTED' and v_revision.source_head_id is not null
        and v_revision.source_head_id=v_source_current.source_event_id))
    and exists(
      select 1 from private.bpay_next_source_component_binding b
        join private.bpay_next_source_component_binding_version bv on bv.id=b.current_binding_version_id
          and bv.canonical_work_id=b.canonical_work_id and bv.canonical_component_key=b.canonical_component_key
          and bv.candidate_id=b.candidate_id and bv.source_component_id=b.source_component_id
        join private.bpay_next_approved_line classification on classification.id=bv.classification_line_id
        join private.bpay_next_work_revision classified on classified.id=classification.revision_id
          and classified.work_id=p_work_id and classified.sealed_at_utc is not null
        join private.weekly_source_entitlement_publication_receipts receipt on receipt.id=bv.source_receipt_id
        join public.weekly_source_entitlement_decision_bundles bundle on bundle.decision_bundle_id=bv.decision_bundle_id
          and bundle.bundle_revision=bv.bundle_revision and bundle.state='COMMITTED'
        join public.weekly_source_entitlement_heads head on head.id=bv.head_id and head.state='COMMITTED_CURRENT'
        join public.weekly_source_root_authorisations auth on auth.current_entitlement_head_id=head.id
          and auth.root_timesheet_id=head.root_timesheet_id and auth.withdrawn_at_utc is null
        join private.bpay_next_publication publication on publication.command_id=bv.publication_command_id_1
          and publication.work_id=bv.publication_work_id_1 and publication.revision_id=bv.publication_revision_id_1
          and publication.candidate_id=v_work.candidate_id
        join private.bpay_next_publication actual_publication on actual_publication.work_id=p_work_id
          and actual_publication.revision_id=p_revision_id and actual_publication.candidate_id=v_work.candidate_id
      where b.canonical_work_id=p_work_id and b.canonical_component_key=p_component_key
        and b.candidate_id=v_work.candidate_id and b.source_component_id=v_line.source_component_id
        and bv.component_state='REMOVED' and bv.approved_line_id is null
        and bv.approval_work_id=p_work_id and bv.approval_revision_id=v_source_current.id
        and bv.approval_component_key=p_component_key and bv.approval_source_channel=v_basis.original_source_pay_channel
        and bv.publication_work_id_1=p_work_id and bv.publication_revision_id_1=v_source_current.id
        and bv.publication_command_id_2 is null and bv.publication_work_id_2 is null and bv.publication_revision_id_2 is null
        and bv.head_id=v_revision.source_head_id
        and classification.component_key=p_component_key and classification.source_component_id=v_line.source_component_id
        and classification.component_kind=v_line.component_kind
        and classification.tax_treatment is not distinct from v_line.tax_treatment
        and bv.tax_treatment is not distinct from v_line.tax_treatment
        and classified.source_pay_channel=v_basis.original_source_pay_channel
        and ((classified.source_kind='SOURCE' and classified.source_event_id is not null
            and (classified.source_head_id is null or classified.source_head_id=classified.source_event_id))
          or (classified.source_kind='PROTECTED' and classified.source_head_id is not null
            and classified.source_head_id=classified.source_event_id))
        and receipt.candidate_id=v_work.candidate_id and receipt.decision_bundle_id=bv.decision_bundle_id
        and receipt.bundle_revision=bv.bundle_revision and receipt.request_digest=bv.request_digest
        and cardinality(receipt.head_ids)=1 and receipt.head_ids[1]=bv.head_id
        and publication.status in ('QUEUED','APPLYING','APPLIED')
        and actual_publication.status in ('QUEUED','APPLYING','APPLIED'));
  v_complete:=v_complete or coalesce(v_removed,false);
  -- A Source head must be the genuinely authorised committed book. An
  -- unrelated/unbound binding is retained as AMOUNT_UNBOUND, never zero.
  if not coalesce(v_retained,false) and v_work.work_kind='SOURCE' and v_revision.source_head_id is not null and not exists(
    select 1 from private.bpay_next_source_component_binding b
      join private.bpay_next_source_component_binding_version bv on bv.id=b.current_binding_version_id
      join private.weekly_source_entitlement_publication_receipts receipt on receipt.id=bv.source_receipt_id
      join public.weekly_source_entitlement_decision_bundles bundle on bundle.decision_bundle_id=bv.decision_bundle_id
        and bundle.bundle_revision=bv.bundle_revision and bundle.state='COMMITTED'
      join public.weekly_source_entitlement_heads head on head.id=bv.head_id and head.state='COMMITTED_CURRENT'
      join public.weekly_source_root_authorisations auth on auth.current_entitlement_head_id=head.id
        and auth.root_timesheet_id=head.root_timesheet_id and auth.withdrawn_at_utc is null
      join private.bpay_next_publication publication on publication.command_id=bv.publication_command_id_1
        and publication.work_id=p_work_id and publication.revision_id=v_source_current.id and publication.candidate_id=v_work.candidate_id
      join private.bpay_next_publication actual_publication on actual_publication.work_id=p_work_id
        and actual_publication.revision_id=p_revision_id and actual_publication.candidate_id=v_work.candidate_id
      where b.canonical_work_id=p_work_id and b.canonical_component_key=p_component_key
        and bv.approval_work_id=p_work_id and bv.approval_component_key=p_component_key
        and bv.approval_revision_id=v_source_current.id and bv.candidate_id=v_work.candidate_id
        and bv.publication_command_id_2 is null and bv.head_id=v_revision.source_head_id
        and v_source_current.source_event_id=bv.head_id and bv.approval_source_channel=v_revision.source_pay_channel
        and receipt.decision_bundle_id=bv.decision_bundle_id and receipt.bundle_revision=bv.bundle_revision
        and receipt.request_digest=bv.request_digest and cardinality(receipt.head_ids)=1 and receipt.head_ids[1]=bv.head_id
        and publication.status in ('QUEUED','APPLYING','APPLIED')
        and actual_publication.status in ('QUEUED','APPLYING','APPLIED')) then v_complete:=false;end if;
  v_segmented:=exists(select 1 from private.bpay_next_approved_segment a where a.revision_id=p_revision_id and a.component_key=p_component_key)
    or exists(select 1 from private.bpay_next_work_segment_origin_share s where s.work_id=p_work_id and s.component_key=p_component_key);
  if v_segmented then
    -- Reuse native maintained segment balances. Original actual target totals
    -- must also reconcile; no gross-to-net ratio or history re-sum.
    select count(d.segment_key) n,bool_and(d.approved_source_ex_vat>=0 and d.realised_source_ex_vat>=0) nonnegative,
      sum(d.approved_source_ex_vat) approved,sum(d.realised_source_ex_vat) realised,sum(d.held_source_ex_vat) held,
      sum(d.written_off_source_ex_vat) written_off,sum(d.active_recovery_source_ex_vat) recovery_held,
      sum(credit.ex) realised_ex,sum(credit.vat) realised_vat,sum(credit.inc) realised_inc,
      sum(held.ex) held_ex,sum(held.vat) held_vat,sum(held.inc) held_inc,
      sum(d.outstanding_source_ex_vat) outstanding,sum(d.free_recovery_source_ex_vat) free,
      sum(d.negative_source_ex_vat) negative,
      sum(greatest(d.approved_source_ex_vat-d.realised_source_ex_vat-d.held_source_ex_vat,0)) positive,
      sum(greatest(d.held_source_ex_vat-greatest(d.approved_source_ex_vat-d.realised_source_ex_vat,0),0)) overhang
      into v_segments from private.bpay_next_work_segment_debt_basis_v1(p_work_id,p_component_key,p_revision_id) d
      cross join lateral (select coalesce(sum(e.target_ex_vat),0) ex,coalesce(sum(e.target_vat),0) vat,coalesce(sum(e.target_inc_vat),0) inc
        from private.bpay_next_work_segment_effect_share e where e.work_id=p_work_id and e.component_key=p_component_key and e.segment_key=d.segment_key) credit
      cross join lateral (select coalesce(sum(s.target_reserved_ex_vat),0) ex,coalesce(sum(s.target_reserved_vat),0) vat,coalesce(sum(s.target_reserved_inc_vat),0) inc
        from private.bpay_next_work_segment_origin_share s join private.bpay_next_hold h on h.id=s.hold_id and h.status='ACTIVE'
        where s.work_id=p_work_id and s.component_key=p_component_key and s.segment_key=d.segment_key) held;
    v_complete:=v_complete and v_line.component_kind='WORK' and (v_revision.detail_kind='SHIFT' or v_revision.certified_zero
        or (coalesce(v_removed,false) and v_original.detail_kind='SHIFT'))
      and v_segments.n>0 and v_segments.nonnegative
      and (v_segments.approved,v_segments.realised,v_segments.held,v_segments.realised_ex,v_segments.realised_vat,v_segments.realised_inc,
        v_segments.held_ex,v_segments.held_vat,v_segments.held_inc,v_segments.written_off,v_segments.recovery_held)
        is not distinct from (v_position.approved_source_ex_vat,v_position.realised_source_ex_vat,v_position.held_source_ex_vat,
          v_position.realised_target_ex_vat,v_position.realised_target_vat,v_position.realised_target_inc_vat,
          v_position.held_target_ex_vat,v_position.held_target_vat,v_position.held_target_inc_vat,
          coalesce(v_case.principal_written_off,0),coalesce(v_case.active_recovery_hold_amount,0));
    v_outstanding:=v_segments.outstanding;v_free:=v_segments.free;v_negative:=v_segments.negative;v_positive:=v_segments.positive;v_overhang:=v_segments.overhang;
  else
    v_outstanding:=greatest(v_position.realised_source_ex_vat-v_position.approved_source_ex_vat-coalesce(v_case.principal_written_off,0),
      coalesce(v_case.active_recovery_hold_amount,0),0);
    v_free:=v_outstanding-coalesce(v_case.active_recovery_hold_amount,0);
    v_negative:=greatest(v_position.realised_source_ex_vat-v_position.approved_source_ex_vat,0);
    v_positive:=greatest(v_position.approved_source_ex_vat-v_position.realised_source_ex_vat-v_position.held_source_ex_vat,0);
    v_overhang:=greatest(v_position.held_source_ex_vat-greatest(v_position.approved_source_ex_vat-v_position.realised_source_ex_vat,0),0);
  end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('complete',coalesce(v_complete,false),'segmented',v_segmented,
    'outstanding_source_ex_vat',case when v_complete then v_outstanding end,
    'free_recovery_source_ex_vat',case when v_complete then v_free end,
    'negative_source_ex_vat',case when v_complete then v_negative end,
    'positive_source_ex_vat',case when v_complete then v_positive end,
    'held_overhang_source_ex_vat',case when v_complete then v_overhang end);
end

create or replace function private.bpay_next_component_resolution_active_v1(
 p_work_id uuid,p_boundary_revision_id uuid,p_line_id uuid,p_family text,p_code text,
 p_target_channel text,p_target_umbrella_id uuid,p_target_vat boolean,p_policy_id uuid,p_valuation_date date
) returns setof private.bpay_next_component_resolution
language plpgsql stable security invoker set search_path=pg_catalog,private
as $function$
declare b jsonb;d private.bpay_next_component_resolution%rowtype;v_count integer:=0;
begin
 if p_work_id is null or p_boundary_revision_id is null or p_line_id is null or p_family is null
  or p_family not in ('STANDARD','ADDITIONAL','ADJUSTMENT') or p_code is null or length(p_code) not between 1 and 256
  or p_target_channel is null
  or p_target_channel not in ('PAYE','UMBRELLA') or p_policy_id is null or p_valuation_date is null
  or not isfinite(p_valuation_date)
  or (p_target_channel='PAYE' and (p_target_umbrella_id is not null or p_target_vat is not null))
  or (p_target_channel='UMBRELLA' and (p_target_umbrella_id is null or p_target_vat is null)) then
  raise exception using errcode='22023',message='BPAY_NEXT_RESOLUTION_IDENTITY_INVALID';end if;
 -- No decision must leave existing Source/ordinary resolver admission unchanged.
 if not exists(select 1 from private.bpay_next_component_resolution x
  where x.work_id=p_work_id and x.rate_family=p_family and x.rate_code=p_code and x.state='ACTIVE'
   and x.target_pay_channel=p_target_channel and x.target_umbrella_id is not distinct from p_target_umbrella_id
   and x.target_umbrella_vat_chargeable is not distinct from p_target_vat
   and x.valuation_policy_id=p_policy_id and x.valuation_date=p_valuation_date
   and ((x.based_on_revision_id=p_boundary_revision_id and x.approved_line_id=p_line_id)
    or(x.published_revision_id=p_boundary_revision_id and x.published_line_id=p_line_id))) then return;end if;
 b:=private.bpay_next_component_resolution_basis_v1(p_boundary_revision_id,p_line_id,p_family,p_code);
 if (b->>'work_id')::uuid is distinct from p_work_id then
  raise exception using errcode='22023',message='BPAY_NEXT_RESOLUTION_IDENTITY_INVALID';end if;
 for d in select x.* from private.bpay_next_component_resolution x
  where x.work_id=p_work_id and x.rate_family=p_family and x.rate_code=p_code and x.state='ACTIVE'
   and x.target_pay_channel=p_target_channel and x.target_umbrella_id is not distinct from p_target_umbrella_id
   and x.target_umbrella_vat_chargeable is not distinct from p_target_vat
   and x.valuation_policy_id=p_policy_id and x.valuation_date=p_valuation_date
   and ((x.based_on_revision_id=p_boundary_revision_id and x.approved_line_id=p_line_id and x.original_basis=b)
    or (x.published_revision_id=p_boundary_revision_id and x.published_line_id=p_line_id and x.published_basis=b))
  limit 2 loop
  v_count:=v_count+1;
  if v_count>1 then raise exception using errcode='23514',message='BPAY_NEXT_RESOLUTION_COMPATIBILITY_AMBIGUOUS';end if;
  return next d;
 end loop;
end
$function$;

create or replace function private.bpay_next_component_resolution_need_publish_v1(
 p_operation_id uuid,p_work_id uuid default null
) returns void language plpgsql volatile security invoker set search_path=pg_catalog,private
as $function$
declare r private.bpay_next_pay_method_change_receipt%rowtype;n record;v_count integer:=0;
begin
 if p_operation_id is null then raise exception using errcode='22023',message='BPAY_NEXT_RESOLUTION_NEED_INPUT_INVALID';end if;
 select x.* into r from private.bpay_next_pay_method_change_receipt x where x.operation_id=p_operation_id;
 if r.operation_id is null or r.affected_member_count>1000
  or(p_work_id is not null and not exists(select 1 from private.bpay_next_work w where w.id=p_work_id and w.candidate_id=r.candidate_id)) then
  raise exception using errcode='23514',message='BPAY_NEXT_RESOLUTION_NEED_IDENTITY_CHANGED';end if;
 -- The original envelope is <=1000 members, each with <=5 native Standard
 -- buckets or one nonbucket code. Overflow fails the whole transaction.
 for n in
  select m.member_key,m.work_id,m.candidate_id,m.revision_id,a.id approved_line_id,
   bucket.rate_family,bucket.rate_code
  from private.bpay_next_pay_method_change_member m
  join private.bpay_next_approved_line a on a.revision_id=m.revision_id
   and a.id=m.approved_line_id and a.tax_treatment='TAXABLE'
  left join private.bpay_next_approved_segment s on s.revision_id=m.revision_id
   and s.id=m.approved_segment_id and s.approved_line_id=a.id
  cross join lateral (
   select 'STANDARD'::text rate_family,d.bucket rate_code
    from private.bpay_next_rate_detail d where d.approved_line_id=a.id
     and a.component_kind in ('WORK','PROTECTED_WORK') and d.approved_hours>0
     and(m.approved_segment_id is null or case d.bucket when 'DAY' then s.hours_day
      when 'NIGHT' then s.hours_night when 'SAT' then s.hours_sat when 'SUN' then s.hours_sun
      when 'BH' then s.hours_bh end>0)
   union all
   select 'ADDITIONAL',substring(a.component_key from 12)
    where a.component_kind='ADDITIONAL' and a.component_key like 'ADDITIONAL:%'
   union all select 'ADJUSTMENT',a.component_key where a.component_kind='ADJUSTMENT'
  ) bucket
  where m.operation_id=r.operation_id and m.member_kind='WORK' and m.classification='NEEDS_DECISION'
   and m.candidate_id=r.candidate_id and(p_work_id is null or m.work_id=p_work_id)
  order by m.member_key,a.id,bucket.rate_family,bucket.rate_code limit 5001
 loop
  v_count:=v_count+1;
  if v_count>5000 then raise exception using errcode='54000',message='BPAY_NEXT_RESOLUTION_NEED_SCOPE_TOO_LARGE';end if;
  insert into private.bpay_next_component_resolution_event(event_kind,work_id,candidate_id,revision_id,approved_line_id,
   rate_family,rate_code,need_operation_id,need_member_key,need_version,actor_user_id,reason)
  values('NEED',n.work_id,n.candidate_id,n.revision_id,n.approved_line_id,n.rate_family,n.rate_code,
   r.operation_id,n.member_key,r.post_metadata_version,r.actor_user_id,'PAY_METHOD_CHANGED')
  on conflict(need_operation_id,need_member_key,approved_line_id,rate_family,rate_code,need_version)
   where event_kind='NEED' do nothing;
 end loop;
end
$function$;

begin
 if p_operation_id is null then raise exception using errcode='22023',message='BPAY_NEXT_RESOLUTION_NEED_INPUT_INVALID';end if;
 select x.* into r from private.bpay_next_pay_method_change_receipt x where x.operation_id=p_operation_id;

  select m.member_key,m.work_id,m.candidate_id,m.revision_id,a.id approved_line_id,
   bucket.rate_family,bucket.rate_code
  from private.bpay_next_pay_method_change_member m
  join private.bpay_next_approved_line a on a.revision_id=m.revision_id
   and a.id=m.approved_line_id and a.tax_treatment='TAXABLE'
  left join private.bpay_next_approved_segment s on s.revision_id=m.revision_id
   and s.id=m.approved_segment_id and s.approved_line_id=a.id
  cross join lateral (
   select 'STANDARD'::text rate_family,d.bucket rate_code
    from private.bpay_next_rate_detail d where d.approved_line_id=a.id
     and a.component_kind in ('WORK','PROTECTED_WORK') and d.approved_hours>0
     and(m.approved_segment_id is null or case d.bucket when 'DAY' then s.hours_day

   union all

create or replace function private.bpay_next_captured_resolution_operands_v1(p_run_position_id uuid)
returns jsonb language plpgsql stable security invoker set search_path=pg_catalog,private
as $function$
declare
 rp private.bpay_next_run_position%rowtype;rw private.bpay_next_run_work%rowtype;
 worker private.bpay_next_run_worker%rowtype;run private.bpay_next_pay_run%rowtype;
 choice private.bpay_next_work_choice%rowtype;r private.bpay_next_work_revision%rowtype;
 a private.bpay_next_approved_line%rowtype;v_refs jsonb;v_members jsonb;v_result jsonb;
 v_count bigint;v_bad boolean;v_totals jsonb;
begin
 select x.* into rp from private.bpay_next_run_position x where x.id=p_run_position_id;
 select x.* into rw from private.bpay_next_run_work x where x.id=rp.run_work_id;
 select x.* into worker from private.bpay_next_run_worker x where x.id=rp.run_worker_id;
 select x.* into run from private.bpay_next_pay_run x where x.id=worker.run_id;
 select x.* into choice from private.bpay_next_work_choice x where x.run_id=run.id and x.work_id=rp.work_id;
 select x.* into r from private.bpay_next_work_revision x where x.id=rp.captured_revision_id and x.work_id=rp.work_id;
 select x.* into a from private.bpay_next_approved_line x where x.id=rp.approved_line_id
  and x.revision_id=rp.captured_revision_id and x.component_key=rp.component_key;
 if rp.id is null or rw.id is null or worker.id is null or run.id is null or choice.work_id is null
  or r.id is null or a.id is null or r.approved_at_utc is null or r.sealed_at_utc is null
  or run.accepted_choice_descriptor is null
  or a.tax_treatment is distinct from 'TAXABLE' or choice.accepted_resolution_refs is null
  or choice.selection_state is distinct from 'SEALED' or choice.expected_revision_id is distinct from r.id
  or (rp.run_worker_id,rp.work_id,rp.captured_revision_id) is distinct from (rw.run_worker_id,rw.work_id,rw.captured_revision_id)
  or rw.candidate_id is distinct from worker.candidate_id
  or not exists(select 1 from private.bpay_next_work w where w.id=rp.work_id and w.candidate_id=worker.candidate_id)
  or not rp.segment_attribution_complete or rp.segment_member_count<>rp.segment_expected_member_count
  or rp.approved_source_ex_vat is distinct from a.source_pay_ex_vat
  or rp.source_pay_channel is distinct from r.source_pay_channel or rp.needs_financial_resolution then
  raise exception using errcode='23514',message='BPAY_NEXT_RESOLUTION_POSITION_INCOMPATIBLE';end if;
 -- Validate the immutable original Header even when all native segments are excluded.
 perform private.bpay_next_choice_leaf_eligible_v1(run.id,rp.work_id,r.id,a.id,null);
 if rp.segment_expected_member_count>10000 then
  raise exception using errcode='54000',message='BPAY_NEXT_RESOLUTION_ACCEPTED_SCOPE_TOO_LARGE';end if;
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.value order by x.value->>'rate_family',x.value->>'rate_code'),'[]') into v_refs
  from jsonb_array_elements(choice.accepted_resolution_refs) x where (x.value->>'approved_line_id')::uuid=a.id;
 if jsonb_array_length(v_refs) not between 1 and 5 or octet_length(v_refs::text)>8192
  or (select count(distinct jsonb_build_array(x.value->>'rate_family',x.value->>'rate_code'))
    from jsonb_array_elements(v_refs) x)<>jsonb_array_length(v_refs) then
  raise exception using errcode='23514',message='BPAY_NEXT_RESOLUTION_ACCEPTED_BASIS_CHANGED';end if;
 -- The maintained count is not an excuse to omit the physical overflow sentinel.
 with parents as materialized (
  select p.* from private.bpay_next_run_work_segment_parent p where p.run_work_id=rw.id and p.component_key=rp.component_key
   order by p.segment_key limit 10001
 ), members as materialized (
  select p.*,s.run_worker_id,s.work_id as segment_work_id,s.captured_revision_id as segment_revision,
   s.segment_key as actual_key,s.approved_segment_id as actual_approved_segment,s.disposition,
   g.id as native_segment_id,g.revision_id as native_revision,g.approved_line_id as native_line,
   g.component_key as native_component,g.segment_key as native_key,g.approved_source_ex_vat as native_source,
   jsonb_build_array(g.hours_day,g.hours_night,g.hours_sat,g.hours_sun,g.hours_bh) as hours,
   jsonb_build_array(g.pay_day,g.pay_night,g.pay_sat,g.pay_sun,g.pay_bh) as rates
  from parents p left join private.bpay_next_run_work_segment s on s.id=p.run_work_segment_id
  left join private.bpay_next_approved_segment g on g.id=p.approved_segment_id
 )
 select count(*),coalesce(bool_or(
    (work_id,captured_revision_id,segment_key) is distinct from (segment_work_id,segment_revision,actual_key)
    or run_worker_id is distinct from worker.id or captured_revision_id is distinct from r.id
    or approved_segment_id is distinct from actual_approved_segment
    or (approved_segment_id is not null and (native_segment_id,native_revision,native_line,native_component,native_key,native_source)
      is distinct from (approved_segment_id,r.id,a.id,rp.component_key,segment_key,approved_source_ex_vat))
    or (included_positive_source_ex_vat>0 and (disposition is distinct from 'INCLUDED' or native_segment_id is null
      or not private.bpay_next_choice_leaf_eligible_v1(run.id,rp.work_id,r.id,a.id,native_segment_id)))
    or residual_source_ex_vat<>approved_source_ex_vat-realised_source_ex_vat-held_source_ex_vat
    or included_positive_source_ex_vat+excluded_positive_source_ex_vat-recovery_source_ex_vat-held_overhang_source_ex_vat<>residual_source_ex_vat
   ),false),coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('segment_key',segment_key,'run_work_segment_id',run_work_segment_id,
    'approved_segment_id',approved_segment_id,'approved_source_ex_vat',approved_source_ex_vat,
    'realised_source_ex_vat',realised_source_ex_vat,'held_source_ex_vat',held_source_ex_vat,
    'included_source_ex_vat',included_positive_source_ex_vat,'excluded_source_ex_vat',excluded_positive_source_ex_vat,
    'recovery_source_ex_vat',recovery_source_ex_vat,'held_overhang_source_ex_vat',held_overhang_source_ex_vat,
    'hours',hours,'rates',rates) order by segment_key),'[]'),
   jsonb_build_object('a',coalesce(sum(approved_source_ex_vat),0),'r',coalesce(sum(realised_source_ex_vat),0),
    'h',coalesce(sum(held_source_ex_vat),0),'included',coalesce(sum(included_positive_source_ex_vat),0),
    'excluded',coalesce(sum(excluded_positive_source_ex_vat),0),'recovery',coalesce(sum(recovery_source_ex_vat),0),
    'overhang',coalesce(sum(held_overhang_source_ex_vat),0))
 into v_count,v_bad,v_members,v_totals
 from members;
 if v_count>10000 then raise exception using errcode='54000',message='BPAY_NEXT_RESOLUTION_ACCEPTED_SCOPE_TOO_LARGE';end if;
 if v_count=0 and not private.bpay_next_choice_leaf_eligible_v1(run.id,rp.work_id,r.id,a.id,null) then
  raise exception using errcode='23514',message='BPAY_NEXT_RESOLUTION_POSITION_INCOMPATIBLE';end if;
 if v_bad or v_count<>rp.segment_member_count
  or (v_count>0 and ((v_totals->>'a')::numeric,(v_totals->>'r')::numeric,(v_totals->>'h')::numeric,(v_totals->>'included')::numeric,
     (v_totals->>'excluded')::numeric,(v_totals->>'recovery')::numeric,(v_totals->>'overhang')::numeric)
    is distinct from (rp.approved_source_ex_vat,rp.realised_source_ex_vat,rp.held_source_ex_vat,
      rp.segment_included_positive_ex_vat,rp.segment_excluded_positive_ex_vat,rp.segment_recovery_ex_vat,rp.segment_held_overhang_ex_vat)) then
  raise exception using errcode='23514',message='BPAY_NEXT_SEGMENT_HOLD_CAPTURE_INCOMPLETE';end if;
 v_result:=jsonb_build_object('position',to_jsonb(rp),'work',to_jsonb(rw),'worker',to_jsonb(worker),
  'pay_date',run.pay_date,'valuation_policy_id',r.valuation_policy_id,'refs',v_refs,'members',v_members,
  'included_source_ex_vat',case when v_count>0 then rp.segment_included_positive_ex_vat
    else greatest(rp.residual_source_ex_vat,0)-rp.snooze_excluded_positive_ex_vat end);
 if octet_length(v_result::text)>8388608 then
  raise exception using errcode='54000',message='BPAY_NEXT_RESOLUTION_ACCEPTED_SCOPE_TOO_LARGE';end if;
 return v_result;
end
$function$;

create or replace function private.weekly_source_pay_actor_allowed_v1(p_actor_user_id uuid)
returns boolean language sql stable security definer
set search_path to 'pg_catalog','pg_temp'
as $function$
  select exists(select 1 from public.tms_users actor
    where actor.id=p_actor_user_id and actor.is_active is true
      and (lower(btrim(coalesce(actor.role,'')))='admin'
        or coalesce(actor.payment_authoriser,false)
        or coalesce(actor.payment_golden_key,false)));
$function$;

begin
  if jsonb_typeof(p_snapshot) is distinct from 'object'
    or p_snapshot->>'timesheet_id' is distinct from p_timesheet_id::text

    or p_snapshot->>'candidate_id' is distinct from p_candidate::text
    or p_snapshot->>'client_id' is distinct from p_client::text

    or coalesce((p_snapshot->>'has_rate_issue')::boolean,true)
    or coalesce((p_snapshot->>'has_pay_channel_issue')::boolean,true)
    or nullif(btrim(p_snapshot->>'pay_method'),'') is null
    or jsonb_typeof(p_snapshot->'invoice_breakdown_json') is distinct from 'object'
    or nullif(p_snapshot->>'authorised_at_utc','') is not null
    or nullif(p_snapshot->>'paid_at_utc','') is not null
    or nullif(p_snapshot->>'locked_by_invoice_id','') is not null then
    raise exception 'CORRECTION_CANONICAL_SNAPSHOT_INVALID' using errcode='55000';
  end if;
end;

create or replace function private.timesheet_correction_cancel_capability_v1(p_timesheet_id uuid,p_actor_user_id uuid default null)
returns jsonb language plpgsql stable security definer
set search_path to 'pg_catalog','public','private','pg_temp'
as $function$
declare v_cap jsonb; v_request private.timesheet_correction_requests%rowtype; v_p public.timesheets%rowtype;
begin
  if to_regclass('pg_temp.timesheet_correction_cancel_capability_v1') is null
    or not exists(select 1 from pg_class c where c.oid=to_regclass('pg_temp.timesheet_correction_cancel_capability_v1')
      and c.relowner=(select p.proowner from pg_proc p where p.oid='private.timesheet_correction_cancel_capability_v1(uuid,uuid)'::regprocedure)) then
    return null;
  end if;
  execute 'select to_jsonb(cap) from pg_temp.timesheet_correction_cancel_capability_v1 cap where cap.timesheet_id=$1 and cap.backend_pid=pg_backend_pid() and cap.transaction_id=txid_current()'
    into v_cap using p_timesheet_id;
  if v_cap is null or (p_actor_user_id is not null and v_cap->>'actor_user_id' is distinct from p_actor_user_id::text) then return null; end if;
  select request.* into v_request from private.timesheet_correction_requests request where request.id=(v_cap->>'request_id')::uuid;
  select t.* into v_p from public.timesheets t where t.timesheet_id=p_timesheet_id;
  if v_request.state is distinct from 'WAITING' or v_request.state_revision::text is distinct from v_cap->>'state_revision'
    or v_request.replacement_timesheet_id is distinct from p_timesheet_id
    or v_p.timesheet_id is null or not v_p.is_current or v_p.authorised_at_server is not null
    or v_p.booking_id is distinct from v_request.replacement_booking_id
    or v_p.contract_id is distinct from v_request.contract_id
    or v_p.week_ending_date is distinct from v_request.week_ending_date
    or v_p.parent_timesheet_id is distinct from v_request.root_timesheet_id
    or v_p.correction_id is distinct from v_request.correction_id
    or v_p.correction_kind is distinct from 'WHOLE_TIMESHEET_REPLACEMENT'
    or v_p.candidate_workflow_id::text is distinct from v_cap->>'workflow_id'
    or v_p.candidate_workflow_generation::text is distinct from v_cap->>'workflow_generation'
    or exists(select 1 from public.invoice_lines l where l.timesheet_id=p_timesheet_id)
    or exists(select 1 from public.timesheets_financials tf where tf.timesheet_id=p_timesheet_id
      and (tf.authorised_at_utc is not null or tf.paid_at_utc is not null or tf.locked_by_invoice_id is not null
        or tf.unlocked_by_credit_note_id is not null or tf.processed_at_utc is not null
        or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(case when jsonb_typeof(tf.invoice_breakdown_json->'segments')='array'
          then tf.invoice_breakdown_json->'segments' else '[]'::jsonb end) s
          where nullif(s->>'invoice_locked_invoice_id','') is not null or nullif(s->>'invoice_locked_at_utc','') is not null
            or s->>'pay_locked'='true' or nullif(s->>'pay_locked_at_utc','') is not null)))
    or private.timesheet_correction_actor_allowed_v1((v_cap->>'actor_user_id')::uuid) is distinct from true then return null; end if;
  return v_cap;
end;
$function$;

as $function$
begin

    or p_rule_values->>'checking_profile_kind' is distinct from 'ROSTER_WEEKLY_SUMMARY_ACTUAL_V1' then return false; end if;
  if p_rule_values->>'self_bill_source' is distinct from 'SAME_FILE'
    or p_rule_values->>'final_report_profile_kind' is distinct from 'NONE'
    or p_rule_values->>'invoice_membership' is distinct from 'FINALISED_IN_CYCLE_WINDOW'
    or p_rule_values->>'pay_membership' is distinct from 'ALL_FINALISED_IN_FILE'
    or p_rule_values->>'invoice_amount_basis' is distinct from 'CONTRACT_CALCULATION'
    or p_rule_values->>'source_amount_basis' is distinct from 'NONE'
    or p_rule_values->>'rate_difference_policy' is distinct from 'NOT_APPLICABLE'
    or p_rule_values->'earliest_final_weekday' is distinct from 'null'::jsonb
    or p_rule_values->'earliest_final_local_time' is distinct from 'null'::jsonb then
    raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_MAGNIT_PRESET_INVALID' using errcode='22023'; end if;
  if p_effective_policy->>'weekly_rate_classification_method' is distinct from 'WHOLE_SHIFT_START_DAY' then
    raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_MAGNIT_WHOLE_SHIFT_REQUIRED' using errcode='22023'; end if;
  return true;
end;

create or replace function private.weekly_source_invoice_receipt_projection_assert_v1(p_invoice_id uuid)
returns void language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path to 'pg_catalog','pg_temp'
as $function$
declare v_record record; authority jsonb; expected jsonb; expected_hash bytea; members uuid[];
begin
  for v_record in select distinct presentation.* from public.weekly_source_invoice_line_bindings binding
    join public.weekly_source_invoice_presentation_lines presentation on presentation.id=binding.presentation_line_id
    where binding.invoice_id=p_invoice_id and binding.state='CURRENT' order by presentation.id
  loop
    authority:=private.weekly_source_invoice_rounding_authority_rebuild_v1(v_record.id);
    expected_hash:=private.weekly_source_invoice_presentation_expected_source_hash_v1(v_record.id);
    if v_record.source_hash is distinct from expected_hash then
      raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_INVOICE_PRESENTATION_SOURCE_HASH_INVALID' using errcode='55000'; end if;
    select array_agg(b.billing_movement_id order by m.movement_role,m.id) into members
      from public.weekly_source_invoice_line_bindings b join public.weekly_source_billing_movements m on m.id=b.billing_movement_id
      where b.presentation_line_id=v_record.id and b.state='CURRENT';
    if authority is not null and v_record.presentation_hash is distinct from private.weekly_source_sha256_jsonb_v1(
      'WEEKLY_SOURCE_INVOICE_PRESENTATION_V1',jsonb_build_object(
        'client_manifest_id',v_record.client_manifest_id,'movement_ids',to_jsonb(members),'line_kind',v_record.line_kind,
        'source_shift_group_id',v_record.source_shift_group_id,'work_date',v_record.work_date,
        'start_at_local',v_record.start_at_local,'end_at_local',v_record.end_at_local,'break_minutes',v_record.break_minutes,
        'hours',jsonb_build_array(v_record.hours_day,v_record.hours_night,v_record.hours_sat,v_record.hours_sun,v_record.hours_bh),
        'total_pay',v_record.total_pay_ex_vat,'total_charge',v_record.total_charge_ex_vat,
        'vat_rate',v_record.vat_rate_pct,'vat',v_record.vat_amount,'total',v_record.total_inc_vat,
        'charge_acceptance_id',v_record.charge_acceptance_id,'source_hash',encode(v_record.source_hash,'hex'))
        ||case when v_record.invoice_hold_release_id is null then '{}'::jsonb else jsonb_build_object(
          'invoice_hold_release_authority',private.weekly_source_invoice_presentation_release_authority_v1(members,v_record.invoice_hold_release_id)) end
        ||case when authority is null then '{}'::jsonb else jsonb_build_object('weekly_source_rounding_authority',authority) end) then
      raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_INVOICE_PRESENTATION_HASH_INVALID' using errcode='55000'; end if;
    select jsonb_build_object('net_pence',sum((money->>'net_pence')::numeric),
      'vat_pence',sum((money->>'vat_pence')::numeric),'gross_pence',sum((money->>'gross_pence')::numeric)) into expected
      from public.weekly_source_invoice_line_bindings binding
      cross join lateral (select private.weekly_source_invoice_admitted_member_money_v1(v_record.id,binding.billing_movement_id) money) actual
      where binding.presentation_line_id=v_record.id and binding.state='CURRENT';
    if v_record.invoice_presentation_charge_pence is distinct from (expected->>'net_pence')::bigint
      or v_record.vat_amount*100 is distinct from (expected->>'vat_pence')::numeric
      or v_record.total_inc_vat*100 is distinct from (expected->>'gross_pence')::numeric then
      raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_INVOICE_PRESENTATION_ADMITTED_MONEY_INVALID' using errcode='55000'; end if;
    if authority is not null and exists(select 1 from public.weekly_source_invoice_line_bindings b
      join public.invoice_lines line on line.id=b.invoice_line_id where b.presentation_line_id=v_record.id and b.state='CURRENT'
        and (line.meta_json->'weekly_source_rounding_authority' is distinct from authority
          or line.meta_json->>'presentation_disposition' is distinct from case when (authority->>'suppress_visible_rounding_line')::boolean
            then 'SUPPRESS_ZERO_ROUNDING_AUTHORITY' else 'VISIBLE' end)) then
      raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_INVOICE_ROUNDING_METADATA_INVALID' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  end loop;
end;
$function$;

begin
  for v_record in select distinct presentation.* from public.weekly_source_invoice_line_bindings binding
    join public.weekly_source_invoice_presentation_lines presentation on presentation.id=binding.presentation_line_id
    where binding.invoice_id=p_invoice_id and binding.state='CURRENT' order by presentation.id
  loop
    authority:=private.weekly_source_invoice_rounding_authority_rebuild_v1(v_record.id);

    select array_agg(b.billing_movement_id order by m.movement_role,m.id) into members

      where b.presentation_line_id=v_record.id and b.state='CURRENT';
    if authority is not null and v_record.presentation_hash is distinct from private.weekly_source_sha256_jsonb_v1(

        'client_manifest_id',v_record.client_manifest_id,'movement_ids',to_jsonb(members),'line_kind',v_record.line_kind,
        'source_shift_group_id',v_record.source_shift_group_id,'work_date',v_record.work_date,

        'hours',jsonb_build_array(v_record.hours_day,v_record.hours_night,v_record.hours_sat,v_record.hours_sun,v_record.hours_bh),
        'total_pay',v_record.total_pay_ex_vat,'total_charge',v_record.total_charge_ex_vat,

        ||case when authority is null then '{}'::jsonb else jsonb_build_object('weekly_source_rounding_authority',authority) end) then
      raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_INVOICE_PRESENTATION_HASH_INVALID' using errcode='55000'; end if;
    select jsonb_build_object('net_pence',sum((money->>'net_pence')::numeric),
      'vat_pence',sum((money->>'vat_pence')::numeric),'gross_pence',sum((money->>'gross_pence')::numeric)) into expected
      from public.weekly_source_invoice_line_bindings binding
      cross join lateral (select private.weekly_source_invoice_admitted_member_money_v1(v_record.id,binding.billing_movement_id) money) actual
      where binding.presentation_line_id=v_record.id and binding.state='CURRENT';
    if v_record.invoice_presentation_charge_pence is distinct from (expected->>'net_pence')::bigint
      or v_record.vat_amount*100 is distinct from (expected->>'vat_pence')::numeric
      or v_record.total_inc_vat*100 is distinct from (expected->>'gross_pence')::numeric then
      raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_INVOICE_PRESENTATION_ADMITTED_MONEY_INVALID' using errcode='55000'; end if;
    if authority is not null and exists(select 1 from public.weekly_source_invoice_line_bindings b
      join public.invoice_lines line on line.id=b.invoice_line_id where b.presentation_line_id=v_record.id and b.state='CURRENT'
        and (line.meta_json->'weekly_source_rounding_authority' is distinct from authority
          or line.meta_json->>'presentation_disposition' is distinct from case when (authority->>'suppress_visible_rounding_line')::boolean
            then 'SUPPRESS_ZERO_ROUNDING_AUTHORITY' else 'VISIBLE' end)) then
      raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_INVOICE_ROUNDING_METADATA_INVALID' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  end loop;
end;

create or replace function private.weekly_source_pay_query_next_receipt_event_v1(
  p_root_timesheet_id uuid,p_approval_id uuid,p_generation_id uuid,p_family_event_id uuid
) returns jsonb language plpgsql stable security definer
set search_path to 'pg_catalog','pg_temp'
as $function$
declare v_scope jsonb; v_receipts jsonb;
begin
  if p_root_timesheet_id is null or p_approval_id is null or p_generation_id is null then
    raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_PAY_QUERY_NEXT_RECEIPT_IDENTITY_REQUIRED' using errcode='22023'; end if;
  v_scope:=private.weekly_source_pay_query_scope_v1(p_root_timesheet_id);
  if v_scope is null or v_scope->>'target_family_id' is null then return null; end if;
  select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'lane','DIRECT_NEXT','orchestration_run_id',r.orchestration_run_id,
    'generation_id',r.generation_id,'work_id',r.work_id,'revision_id',r.revision_id,
    'command_id',r.command_id,'agency_sequence',r.agency_sequence::text,
    'accepted_family_bound_version',r.accepted_family_bound_version::text,
    'prepared_request_sha256',encode(r.prepared_request_sha256,'hex'),
    'publication_request_sha256',encode(r.publication_request_sha256,'hex'),
    'source_manifest_sha256',encode(r.source_manifest_sha256,'hex'),'receipt_state','COMPLETE'))
  into v_receipts
  from public.weekly_exceptional_payment_approvals a
  join private.bpay_next_protected_source_receipt r on r.approval_id=a.id and r.generation_id=p_generation_id
  join public.weekly_exceptional_pay_target_families f on f.id=r.family_id
  join public.weekly_exceptional_orchestration_runs o on o.id=r.orchestration_run_id
  join public.weekly_exceptional_pay_generations g on g.id=r.generation_id
  join private.bpay_next_work w on w.id=r.work_id
  join private.bpay_next_work_revision v on v.work_id=w.id and v.id=r.revision_id
  join private.bpay_next_publication p on p.command_id=r.command_id and p.work_id=w.id
    and p.revision_id=v.id and p.candidate_id=w.candidate_id
  join private.bpay_next_command c on c.id=p.command_id
  join private.bpay_next_command_member m on m.command_id=c.id and m.candidate_id=w.candidate_id
  join lateral (select e.* from public.weekly_exceptional_pay_family_events e
    where e.family_id=f.id and e.durable_work_event_id=a.work_event_id
      and (p_family_event_id is null or e.id=p_family_event_id)
    order by e.event_sequence desc limit 1) e on true
  where a.id=p_approval_id and f.id::text=v_scope->>'target_family_id'
    and a.pay_target_family_id=f.id and g.family_id=f.id and o.family_id=f.id
    and a.withdrawn_at_utc is null
    and a.candidate_id::text=v_scope->>'candidate_id' and a.client_id::text=v_scope->>'client_id'
    and a.contract_id::text=v_scope->>'contract_id'
    and a.week_ending=(v_scope->>'week_ending_date')::date
    and a.protected_work_date between a.week_ending-6 and a.week_ending
    and exists(select 1 from public.weekly_work_events d where d.id=a.work_event_id
      and d.candidate_id=a.candidate_id and d.client_id=a.client_id and d.work_date=a.protected_work_date)
    and e.state='WAIT' and e.evidence_approval_id=a.id and e.work_date=a.protected_work_date
    and e.office_actor_user_id=a.approved_by_user_id
    and e.start_at_local=a.protected_start_at_local and e.end_at_local=a.protected_end_at_local
    and e.break_minutes=a.protected_break_minutes
    and e.fixed_office_target_hash=a.signed_schedule_fact_hash
    and private.weekly_source_sha256_jsonb_v1('WEEKLY_PROTECTED_SCHEDULE_V1',
      e.fixed_office_target_snapshot_json)=a.signed_schedule_fact_hash
    and a.creation_orchestration_run_id=o.id
    and o.requested_by_user_id=r.actor_user_id and a.approved_by_user_id=r.actor_user_id
    and o.request_fingerprint=r.prepared_request_sha256
    and o.state='COMPLETE' and o.completed_at_utc is not null and isfinite(o.completed_at_utc)
    and o.after_state_fingerprint=r.publication_request_sha256
    and g.lifecycle_state in ('PUBLISHED','SUPERSEDED')
    and g.published_at_utc is not null and isfinite(g.published_at_utc)
    and g.result_hash=r.publication_request_sha256
    and g.complete_next_vector_json=a.approved_target_pay_components_json
    and private.weekly_source_sha256_jsonb_v1('WEEKLY_PROTECTED_COMPLETE_VECTOR_V1',
      g.complete_next_vector_json)=g.complete_next_vector_hash
    and g.fixed_target_source_state_fingerprint=r.source_manifest_sha256
    and e.source_proposal_hash=r.source_manifest_sha256
    and private.weekly_source_sha256_jsonb_v1('WEEKLY_PROTECTED_SOURCE_PROPOSAL_V1',
      e.source_proposal_snapshot_json)=r.source_manifest_sha256
    and (select count(*) from public.weekly_exceptional_pay_target_events t
      where t.family_id=f.id and t.approval_id=a.id and t.financial_generation_id=g.id)=1
    and exists(select 1 from public.weekly_exceptional_pay_target_events t
      where t.family_id=f.id and t.approval_id=a.id and t.financial_generation_id=g.id
        and t.complete_next_family_vector_fingerprint=g.complete_next_vector_hash
        and t.fixed_target_component_snapshot=g.complete_next_vector_json
        and t.current_source_proposal_snapshot=e.source_proposal_snapshot_json)
    and r.accepted_family_bound_version>0 and r.accepted_family_bound_version<=f.bound_version
    and w.candidate_id=a.candidate_id and w.contract_id=a.contract_id
    and w.booking_id=v_scope->>'family_booking_id' and w.work_kind='SOURCE'
    and w.week_ending_date=a.week_ending and v.week_ending_date=w.week_ending_date
    and v.source_kind='PROTECTED' and v.source_event_id=a.id
    and v.source_head_id is null and v.financial_snapshot_id is null
    and v.approved_at_utc is not null and isfinite(v.approved_at_utc)
    and v.sealed_at_utc is not null and isfinite(v.sealed_at_utc)
    and v.approved_source_ex_vat=a.approved_target_gross
    -- Both exact retained physical identities must belong to the raw family;
    -- neither needs to remain current or equal today's canonical physical root.
    and exists(select 1 from public.timesheets t where t.timesheet_id=w.original_timesheet_id
      and t.booking_id=w.booking_id and t.contract_id=w.contract_id
      and t.week_ending_date=w.week_ending_date and t.sheet_scope='WEEKLY'
      and t.line_type='HOURS' and t.is_adjustment is false and t.version>=1)
    and exists(select 1 from public.timesheets t where t.timesheet_id=v.physical_timesheet_id
      and t.booking_id=w.booking_id and t.contract_id=w.contract_id
      and t.week_ending_date=w.week_ending_date and t.sheet_scope='WEEKLY'
      and t.line_type='HOURS' and t.is_adjustment is false and t.version=v.physical_timesheet_version)
    and p.revision_no=v.revision_no and c.agency_sequence=r.agency_sequence
    and c.command_kind='POSITION_APPLY' and c.expected_member_count=1 and m.member_no=1
    and c.sealed_at_utc is not null and isfinite(c.sealed_at_utc)
    and c.id=private.bpay_next_source_command_id_v1(a.id)
    -- A job is created by later enrolment, not by publication acceptance.
    and not exists(select 1 from private.bpay_next_job j where j.command_id=c.id
      and (j.candidate_id<>w.candidate_id or j.job_kind<>'POSITION_APPLY'
        or j.command_sequence<>c.agency_sequence or j.module_epoch<>c.module_epoch))
    and (select count(*) from public.weekly_exceptional_orchestration_steps s
      where s.orchestration_run_id=o.id and s.step_kind='PUBLISH_NEXT')=1
    and exists(select 1 from public.weekly_exceptional_orchestration_steps s
      where s.orchestration_run_id=o.id and s.step_kind='PUBLISH_NEXT'
        and s.outcome='COMPLETE' and s.completed_at_utc is not null and isfinite(s.completed_at_utc)
        and s.allowlisted_owner_name='public.weekly_exceptional_pay_publish_next_v1'
        and s.allowlisted_owner_signature='jsonb->jsonb'
        and s.bounded_request_hash=r.publication_request_sha256
        and s.owner_response_hash=r.publication_request_sha256
        and s.after_state_fingerprint=r.publication_request_sha256
        and s.before_state_fingerprint=o.before_state_fingerprint
        and s.bounded_owner_response_json=private.bpay_next_protected_receipt_json_v1(o.id,false));
  if jsonb_array_length(v_receipts) is distinct from 1 then return null; end if;
  return v_receipts->0;
end;
$function$;
routines.body:
declare v_scope jsonb; v_receipts jsonb;
begin
  if p_root_timesheet_id is null or p_approval_id is null or p_generation_id is null then
    raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_PAY_QUERY_NEXT_RECEIPT_IDENTITY_REQUIRED' using errcode='22023'; end if;
  v_scope:=private.weekly_source_pay_query_scope_v1(p_root_timesheet_id);
  if v_scope is null or v_scope->>'target_family_id' is null then return null; end if;
  select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'lane','DIRECT_NEXT','orchestration_run_id',r.orchestration_run_id,
    'generation_id',r.generation_id,'work_id',r.work_id,'revision_id',r.revision_id,
    'command_id',r.command_id,'agency_sequence',r.agency_sequence::text,
    'accepted_family_bound_version',r.accepted_family_bound_version::text,
    'prepared_request_sha256',encode(r.prepared_request_sha256,'hex'),
    'publication_request_sha256',encode(r.publication_request_sha256,'hex'),
    'source_manifest_sha256',encode(r.source_manifest_sha256,'hex'),'receipt_state','COMPLETE'))
  into v_receipts
  from public.weekly_exceptional_payment_approvals a
  join private.bpay_next_protected_source_receipt r on r.approval_id=a.id and r.generation_id=p_generation_id
  join public.weekly_exceptional_pay_target_families f on f.id=r.family_id
  join public.weekly_exceptional_orchestration_runs o on o.id=r.orchestration_run_id
  join public.weekly_exceptional_pay_generations g on g.id=r.generation_id
  join private.bpay_next_work w on w.id=r.work_id
  join private.bpay_next_work_revision v on v.work_id=w.id and v.id=r.revision_id
  join private.bpay_next_publication p on p.command_id=r.command_id and p.work_id=w.id
    and p.revision_id=v.id and p.candidate_id=w.candidate_id
  join private.bpay_next_command c on c.id=p.command_id
  join private.bpay_next_command_member m on m.command_id=c.id and m.candidate_id=w.candidate_id
  join lateral (select e.* from public.weekly_exceptional_pay_family_events e
    where e.family_id=f.id and e.durable_work_event_id=a.work_event_id
      and (p_family_event_id is null or e.id=p_family_event_id)
    order by e.event_sequence desc limit 1) e on true
  where a.id=p_approval_id and f.id::text=v_scope->>'target_family_id'
    and a.pay_target_family_id=f.id and g.family_id=f.id and o.family_id=f.id
    and a.withdrawn_at_utc is null
    and a.candidate_id::text=v_scope->>'candidate_id' and a.client_id::text=v_scope->>'client_id'
    and a.contract_id::text=v_scope->>'contract_id'
    and a.week_ending=(v_scope->>'week_ending_date')::date
    and a.protected_work_date between a.week_ending-6 and a.week_ending
    and exists(select 1 from public.weekly_work_events d where d.id=a.work_event_id
      and d.candidate_id=a.candidate_id and d.client_id=a.client_id and d.work_date=a.protected_work_date)
    and e.state='WAIT' and e.evidence_approval_id=a.id and e.work_date=a.protected_work_date
    and e.office_actor_user_id=a.approved_by_user_id
    and e.start_at_local=a.protected_start_at_local and e.end_at_local=a.protected_end_at_local
    and e.break_minutes=a.protected_break_minutes
    and e.fixed_office_target_hash=a.signed_schedule_fact_hash
    and private.weekly_source_sha256_jsonb_v1('WEEKLY_PROTECTED_SCHEDULE_V1',
      e.fixed_office_target_snapshot_json)=a.signed_schedule_fact_hash
    and a.creation_orchestration_run_id=o.id
    and o.requested_by_user_id=r.actor_user_id and a.approved_by_user_id=r.actor_user_id
    and o.request_fingerprint=r.prepared_request_sha256
    and o.state='COMPLETE' and o.completed_at_utc is not null and isfinite(o.completed_at_utc)
    and o.after_state_fingerprint=r.publication_request_sha256
    and g.lifecycle_state in ('PUBLISHED','SUPERSEDED')
    and g.published_at_utc is not null and isfinite(g.published_at_utc)
    and g.result_hash=r.publication_request_sha256
    and g.complete_next_vector_json=a.approved_target_pay_components_json
    and private.weekly_source_sha256_jsonb_v1('WEEKLY_PROTECTED_COMPLETE_VECTOR_V1',
      g.complete_next_vector_json)=g.complete_next_vector_hash
    and g.fixed_target_source_state_fingerprint=r.source_manifest_sha256
    and e.source_proposal_hash=r.source_manifest_sha256
    and private.weekly_source_sha256_jsonb_v1('WEEKLY_PROTECTED_SOURCE_PROPOSAL_V1',
      e.source_proposal_snapshot_json)=r.source_manifest_sha256
    and (select count(*) from public.weekly_exceptional_pay_target_events t
      where t.family_id=f.id and t.approval_id=a.id and t.financial_generation_id=g.id)=1
    and exists(select 1 from public.weekly_exceptional_pay_target_events t
      where t.family_id=f.id and t.approval_id=a.id and t.financial_generation_id=g.id
        and t.complete_next_family_vector_fingerprint=g.complete_next_vector_hash
        and t.fixed_target_component_snapshot=g.complete_next_vector_json
        and t.current_source_proposal_snapshot=e.source_proposal_snapshot_json)
    and r.accepted_family_bound_version>0 and r.accepted_family_bound_version<=f.bound_version
    and w.candidate_id=a.candidate_id and w.contract_id=a.contract_id
    and w.booking_id=v_scope->>'family_booking_id' and w.work_kind='SOURCE'
    and w.week_ending_date=a.week_ending and v.week_ending_date=w.week_ending_date
    and v.source_kind='PROTECTED' and v.source_event_id=a.id
    and v.source_head_id is null and v.financial_snapshot_id is null
    and v.approved_at_utc is not null and isfinite(v.approved_at_utc)
    and v.sealed_at_utc is not null and isfinite(v.sealed_at_utc)
    and v.approved_source_ex_vat=a.approved_target_gross
    -- Both exact retained physical identities must belong to the raw family;
    -- neither needs to remain current or equal today's canonical physical root.
    and exists(select 1 from public.timesheets t where t.timesheet_id=w.original_timesheet_id
      and t.booking_id=w.booking_id and t.contract_id=w.contract_id
      and t.week_ending_date=w.week_ending_date and t.sheet_scope='WEEKLY'
      and t.line_type='HOURS' and t.is_adjustment is false and t.version>=1)
    and exists(select 1 from public.timesheets t where t.timesheet_id=v.physical_timesheet_id
      and t.booking_id=w.booking_id and t.contract_id=w.contract_id
      and t.week_ending_date=w.week_ending_date and t.sheet_scope='WEEKLY'
      and t.line_type='HOURS' and t.is_adjustment is false and t.version=v.physical_timesheet_version)
    and p.revision_no=v.revision_no and c.agency_sequence=r.agency_sequence
    and c.command_kind='POSITION_APPLY' and c.expected_member_count=1 and m.member_no=1
    and c.sealed_at_utc is not null and isfinite(c.sealed_at_utc)
    and c.id=private.bpay_next_source_command_id_v1(a.id)
    -- A job is created by later enrolment, not by publication acceptance.
    and not exists(select 1 from private.bpay_next_job j where j.command_id=c.id
      and (j.candidate_id<>w.candidate_id or j.job_kind<>'POSITION_APPLY'
        or j.command_sequence<>c.agency_sequence or j.module_epoch<>c.module_epoch))
    and (select count(*) from public.weekly_exceptional_orchestration_steps s
      where s.orchestration_run_id=o.id and s.step_kind='PUBLISH_NEXT')=1
    and exists(select 1 from public.weekly_exceptional_orchestration_steps s
      where s.orchestration_run_id=o.id and s.step_kind='PUBLISH_NEXT'
        and s.outcome='COMPLETE' and s.completed_at_utc is not null and isfinite(s.completed_at_utc)
        and s.allowlisted_owner_name='public.weekly_exceptional_pay_publish_next_v1'
        and s.allowlisted_owner_signature='jsonb->jsonb'
        and s.bounded_request_hash=r.publication_request_sha256
        and s.owner_response_hash=r.publication_request_sha256
        and s.after_state_fingerprint=r.publication_request_sha256
        and s.before_state_fingerprint=o.before_state_fingerprint
        and s.bounded_owner_response_json=private.bpay_next_protected_receipt_json_v1(o.id,false));
  if jsonb_array_length(v_receipts) is distinct from 1 then return null; end if;
  return v_receipts->0;
end;
