create or replace function private.weekly_source_bulk_source_facts_v1(p_cycle_id uuid,p_client_ids uuid[])
returns jsonb language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path to 'pg_catalog','pg_temp'
as $function$
declare c public.weekly_source_cycles%rowtype; g public.weekly_source_groups%rowtype;
  p public.weekly_source_projection_publications%rowtype; u public.weekly_source_uploads%rowtype;
  clients uuid[]; facts jsonb; actual_client uuid;
begin
  if p_cycle_id is null or p_client_ids is null or array_position(p_client_ids,null::uuid) is not null then
    raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_BULK_SOURCE_CAS_INVALID' using errcode='22023'; end if;
  select coalesce(array_agg(distinct value order by value),'{}'::uuid[]) into clients from unnest(p_client_ids) value;
  if cardinality(clients)>100 then raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_BULK_SOURCE_CAS_SCOPE_TOO_LARGE' using errcode='54000'; end if;
  select * into strict c from public.weekly_source_cycles where id=p_cycle_id;
  select * into strict g from public.weekly_source_groups where id=c.source_group_id and active and source_family='ROSTER';
  select * into strict p from public.weekly_source_projection_publications where id=c.current_projection_publication_id
    and source_cycle_id=c.id and state='CURRENT' and authority_scope_kind='CYCLE' and correction_session_id is null and report_scope_id is null;
  select * into strict u from public.weekly_source_uploads where id=c.current_complete_upload_id and id=p.upload_id
    and source_cycle_id=c.id and state='CURRENT' and report_scope_id is null;
  perform private.weekly_source_query_current_publication_v1(c.id,p.id);
  actual_client:=private.weekly_source_checking_client_scope_v1(p.id);
  if exists(select 1 from unnest(clients) client where (actual_client is not null and actual_client<>client)
    or not exists(select 1 from public.weekly_source_group_clients member where member.source_group_id=g.id and member.client_id=client
      and daterange(member.valid_from,coalesce(member.valid_to,'infinity'::date),'[]')
        && daterange(coalesce(u.confirmed_coverage_start_local_date,c.finalisation_week_ending-6),
          coalesce(u.confirmed_coverage_end_local_date,c.finalisation_week_ending),'[]'))) then
    raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_BULK_SOURCE_CAS_CLIENT_SCOPE_CHANGED' using errcode='40001'; end if;
  -- CTE scope comes from saved Source parents. Incident IDs contribute stable
  -- work-event scope irrespective of OPEN/CLOSED; their mutable rows do not.
  with report_scopes as materialized (
    select scope.* from public.weekly_source_report_scopes scope where scope.source_group_id=g.id
      and scope.client_id=any(clients) and scope.self_bill_report_id is not null
  ), report_bindings as materialized (
    select binding.* from public.weekly_source_self_bill_report_line_bindings binding
      join public.weekly_source_self_bill_reports report on report.id=binding.self_bill_report_id
      where report.source_group_id=g.id and report.client_id=any(clients) and binding.state='CURRENT'
  ), publications as materialized (
    select publication.* from public.weekly_source_projection_publications publication where publication.id=p.id
      or publication.id in(select current_projection_publication_id from report_scopes)
      or publication.id in(select export_projection_publication_id from report_bindings)
  ), uploads as materialized (
    select upload.* from public.weekly_source_uploads upload where upload.id=u.id
      or upload.id in(select upload_id from publications)
  ), source_rows as materialized (
    select row_data.* from public.weekly_source_upload_rows row_data where row_data.upload_id in(select id from uploads)
  ), resolutions as materialized (
    select resolution.* from public.weekly_source_row_resolutions resolution
      join source_rows row_data on row_data.id=resolution.upload_row_id
      join publications publication on publication.upload_id=row_data.upload_id
        and resolution.generation=coalesce(publication.projection_generation,publication.authority_scope_version)
      where resolution.client_id=any(clients)
      union select resolution.* from public.weekly_source_row_resolutions resolution
        join report_bindings binding on binding.bound_row_resolution_id=resolution.id
  ), events as materialized (
    select event.* from public.weekly_work_events event where event.first_source_group_id=g.id and event.client_id=any(clients)
      and (event.id in(select work_event_id from resolutions) or event.id in(select work_event_id from report_bindings)
        or exists(select 1 from public.weekly_discrepancy_incidents incident where incident.source_cycle_id=c.id
          and incident.work_event_id=event.id and incident.client_id=event.client_id))
  ), revisions as materialized (
    select revision.* from public.weekly_source_final_revisions revision
      join public.weekly_source_cycles source_cycle on source_cycle.id=revision.source_cycle_id and source_cycle.source_group_id=g.id
      where revision.state in ('CURRENT','PREPARED','SUPERSEDED') and (
        revision.source_cycle_id=c.id or revision.report_scope_id in(select id from report_scopes)
        or exists(select 1 from public.weekly_source_final_snapshot_lines snapshot where snapshot.final_revision_id=revision.id
          and snapshot.work_event_id in(select id from events)))
  ), snapshots as materialized (
    select snapshot.* from public.weekly_source_final_snapshot_lines snapshot where snapshot.final_revision_id in(select id from revisions)
      and snapshot.client_id=any(clients)
  ), lineages as materialized (
    select lineage.* from public.weekly_source_row_timesheet_lineages lineage where lineage.client_id=any(clients)
      and (lineage.row_resolution_id in(select id from resolutions) or lineage.work_event_id in(select id from events))
  ), pay_receipts as materialized (
    select receipt.* from public.weekly_source_ordinary_pay_projection_receipts receipt where receipt.client_id=any(clients)
      and receipt.final_revision_id in(select id from revisions)
  ), financial_identities as materialized (
    -- The Source receipt is immutable and already pins all published economics
    -- and root-before/after/service hashes. Protection may replace currentness
    -- on the same native family; the Source financial identity stays exact.
    select financial.id,financial.timesheet_id,financial.client_id,financial.candidate_id,
      (select min(m.contract_id::text)::uuid
        from pay_receipts receipt
        cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(case when jsonb_typeof(receipt.source_unit_outcomes_json)='array'
          then receipt.source_unit_outcomes_json else '[]'::jsonb end) unit
        join public.weekly_source_billing_movements m on m.id=(unit->>'movement_id')::uuid
          and m.final_revision_id=receipt.final_revision_id and m.invoice_timesheet_id=receipt.root_timesheet_id
          and m.actual_client_id=receipt.client_id and m.candidate_id=financial.candidate_id
          and encode(m.movement_economic_hash,'hex')=unit->>'movement_economic_hash'
          and m.source_profile_kind<>'SELF_BILL_REPORT'
          and m.source_line_kind not in ('SELF_BILL_REPORT_LINE','INVOICE_VAT_ROUNDING','SOURCE_REBILL_LINE','SOURCE_INVOICE_CORRECTION')
        where receipt.published_timesheet_financial_id=financial.id
        having count(distinct m.contract_id)=1) as contract_id
      from public.timesheets_financials financial where financial.id in(select published_timesheet_financial_id from pay_receipts)
  ), root_identities as materialized (
    select root.timesheet_id,root.client_id,contract.candidate_id,root.contract_id,root.booking_id
      from public.timesheets root join public.contracts contract on contract.id=root.contract_id
      where root.timesheet_id in(select root_timesheet_id from pay_receipts)
  ), cycles as materialized (
    select cycle.* from public.weekly_source_cycles cycle where cycle.id=c.id or cycle.id in(select source_cycle_id from publications)
      or cycle.id in(select source_cycle_id from revisions)
  ), contracts as materialized (
    select contract.* from public.contracts contract where contract.client_id=any(clients)
      and (daterange(contract.start_date,contract.end_date,'[]') && daterange(
        coalesce(u.confirmed_coverage_start_local_date,c.finalisation_week_ending-6),
        coalesce(u.confirmed_coverage_end_local_date,c.finalisation_week_ending),'[]')
        or contract.id in(select contract_id from resolutions) or contract.id in(select contract_id from snapshots)
        or exists(select 1 from public.weekly_issue_comparison_revisions comparison
          join public.weekly_discrepancy_incidents incident on incident.current_comparison_revision_id=comparison.id
          where incident.source_cycle_id=c.id and incident.client_id=contract.client_id and comparison.contract_id=contract.id))
  ), policy_dates as materialized (
    select client client_id,null::uuid contract_id,c.finalisation_week_ending work_date from unnest(clients) client
    union select client_id,contract_id,work_date from snapshots
    union select resolution.client_id,resolution.contract_id,row_data.work_date from resolutions resolution
      join source_rows row_data on row_data.id=resolution.upload_row_id
    union select client_id,null::uuid,work_date from events
    union select contract.client_id,contract.id,greatest(contract.start_date,
      coalesce(u.confirmed_coverage_start_local_date,c.finalisation_week_ending-6)) from contracts contract
  ), resolved_policies as materialized (
    select client_id,contract_id,work_date,private._weekly_source_effective_policy_v1(client_id,contract_id,work_date) policy
      from policy_dates
  )
  select jsonb_build_object('schema_version','WEEKLY_SOURCE_BULK_SOURCE_FACTS_V1','source_cycle_id',c.id,
    'client_ids',to_jsonb(clients),'group',to_jsonb(g),
    'cycles',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.id) from cycles x),'[]'::jsonb),
    'clients',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.id) from public.clients x where x.id=any(clients)),'[]'::jsonb),
    'memberships',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.client_id,x.valid_from,x.id)
      from public.weekly_source_group_clients x where x.source_group_id=g.id and x.client_id=any(clients)),'[]'::jsonb),
    'client_policies',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.client_id,x.effective_from,x.id)
      from public.weekly_source_client_policies x where x.source_group_id=g.id and x.client_id=any(clients)),'[]'::jsonb),
    'client_settings',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.client_id,x.id) from public.client_settings x where x.client_id=any(clients)),'[]'::jsonb),
    'contracts',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.id) from contracts x),'[]'::jsonb),
    'contract_policies',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.contract_id,x.effective_from,x.id)
      from public.weekly_source_contract_policies x where x.contract_id in(select id from contracts)),'[]'::jsonb),
    'global_settings',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) from public.weekly_source_global_settings x where x.singleton),'[]'::jsonb),
    'resolved_policies',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.client_id,x.contract_id nulls first,x.work_date) from resolved_policies x),'[]'::jsonb),
    'assignments',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.effective_from_week_ending,x.id)
      from public.weekly_source_group_rule_assignments x where x.source_group_id=g.id),'[]'::jsonb),
    'rule_versions',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.id) from public.weekly_source_rule_set_versions x
      where x.id in(select rule_set_version_id from public.weekly_source_group_rule_assignments where source_group_id=g.id)
        or x.id in(select rule_set_version_id from revisions)),'[]'::jsonb),
    'effective_rules',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('client_id',client,
      'effective_rule_set',private.weekly_source_operational_effective_rule_set_v1(client,c.id)) order by client) from unnest(clients) client),'[]'::jsonb),
    'profiles',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.id) from public.weekly_source_format_profiles x
      where x.id in(select source_format_profile_id from uploads)),'[]'::jsonb),
    'uploads',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.id) from uploads x),'[]'::jsonb),
    'publications',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.id) from publications x),'[]'::jsonb),
    'rows',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.upload_id,x.source_row_ordinal,x.id) from source_rows x),'[]'::jsonb),
    'resolutions',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.upload_row_id,x.generation,x.id) from resolutions x),'[]'::jsonb),
    'economics',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.row_resolution_id,x.id) from public.weekly_source_row_economic_snapshots x
      where x.row_resolution_id in(select id from resolutions)),'[]'::jsonb),
    'expense_policy_snapshots',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.row_resolution_id,x.id)
      from public.weekly_source_row_expense_policy_snapshots x where x.row_resolution_id in(select id from resolutions)),'[]'::jsonb),
    'expense_authorities',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.work_event_id,x.generation,x.id)
      from public.weekly_expense_authority_generations x where x.final_revision_id in(select id from revisions)
        and x.work_event_id in(select id from events)),'[]'::jsonb),
    'expense_cell_evidence',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.upload_id,x.source_row_ordinal,x.id)
      from public.weekly_source_expense_cell_evidence x where x.upload_id in(select id from uploads)),'[]'::jsonb),
    'charge_checks',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.row_resolution_id,x.id)
      from public.weekly_source_charge_checks x where x.row_resolution_id in(select id from resolutions)),'[]'::jsonb),
    'charge_acceptances',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.row_resolution_id,x.id)
      from public.weekly_source_charge_acceptances x where x.row_resolution_id in(select id from resolutions)),'[]'::jsonb),
    'invoice_hold_releases',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.upload_row_id,x.hold_kind,x.id)
      from public.weekly_source_invoice_hold_releases x where x.upload_row_id in(select id from source_rows)),'[]'::jsonb),
    'transitions',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.final_revision_id,x.work_event_id,x.id)
      from public.weekly_source_state_transitions x where x.final_revision_id in(select id from revisions)
        and x.work_event_id in(select id from events)),'[]'::jsonb),
    'report_scopes',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.id) from report_scopes x),'[]'::jsonb),
    'reports',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.id) from public.weekly_source_self_bill_reports x
      where x.source_group_id=g.id and x.client_id=any(clients)),'[]'::jsonb),
    'report_bindings',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.report_row_id,x.id) from report_bindings x),'[]'::jsonb),
    'events',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.id) from events x),'[]'::jsonb),
    'revisions',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.id) from revisions x),'[]'::jsonb),
    'snapshots',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.final_revision_id,x.work_event_id,x.id) from snapshots x),'[]'::jsonb),
    'lineages',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.id) from lineages x),'[]'::jsonb),
    'pay_receipts',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.id) from pay_receipts x),'[]'::jsonb),
    'financial_identities',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.id) from financial_identities x),'[]'::jsonb),
    'root_identities',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.timesheet_id) from root_identities x),'[]'::jsonb)) into facts;
  if exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(facts->'pay_receipts') receipt
    where receipt->>'published_timesheet_financial_id' is not null and (
      jsonb_typeof(receipt->'source_unit_outcomes_json') is distinct from 'array'
      or case when jsonb_typeof(receipt->'source_unit_outcomes_json')='array'
        then jsonb_array_length(receipt->'source_unit_outcomes_json')=0 else true end
      or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(case when jsonb_typeof(receipt->'source_unit_outcomes_json')='array'
          then receipt->'source_unit_outcomes_json' else '[]'::jsonb end) unit
        where not exists(select 1 from public.weekly_source_billing_movements m
          where m.id=(unit->>'movement_id')::uuid and m.final_revision_id=(receipt->>'final_revision_id')::uuid
            and m.invoice_timesheet_id=(receipt->>'root_timesheet_id')::uuid
            and m.actual_client_id=(receipt->>'client_id')::uuid
            and exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(facts->'financial_identities') financial
              where financial->>'id'=receipt->>'published_timesheet_financial_id'
                and financial->>'candidate_id'=m.candidate_id::text
                and financial->>'contract_id'=m.contract_id::text)
            and encode(m.movement_economic_hash,'hex')=unit->>'movement_economic_hash'
            and m.source_profile_kind<>'SELF_BILL_REPORT'
            and m.source_line_kind not in ('SELF_BILL_REPORT_LINE','INVOICE_VAT_ROUNDING','SOURCE_REBILL_LINE','SOURCE_INVOICE_CORRECTION'))))) then
    raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_BULK_SOURCE_CAS_FINANCIAL_IDENTITY_INVALID' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  if (select count(*) from public.clients where id=any(clients))<>cardinality(clients)
    or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(facts->'pay_receipts') receipt
      where receipt->>'published_timesheet_financial_id' is not null and not exists(
        select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(facts->'financial_identities') financial
          where financial->>'id'=receipt->>'published_timesheet_financial_id'
            and financial->>'timesheet_id'=receipt->>'root_timesheet_id' and financial->>'client_id'=receipt->>'client_id'
            and exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(facts->'root_identities') root
              join jsonb_array_elements(facts->'contracts') contract on contract->>'id'=financial->>'contract_id'
              where root->>'timesheet_id'=financial->>'timesheet_id'
                and root->>'candidate_id'=financial->>'candidate_id' and root->>'contract_id'=financial->>'contract_id'
                and (root->>'client_id' is null or root->>'client_id'=financial->>'client_id')
                and contract->>'client_id'=financial->>'client_id' and contract->>'candidate_id'=financial->>'candidate_id'))) then
    raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_BULK_SOURCE_CAS_FINANCIAL_IDENTITY_INVALID' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  if octet_length(convert_to(facts::text,'UTF8'))>8388608 then
    raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_BULK_SOURCE_CAS_SCOPE_TOO_LARGE' using errcode='54000'; end if;
  return facts;
exception when no_data_found or too_many_rows or invalid_text_representation then
  raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_BULK_SOURCE_CAS_SCOPE_UNAVAILABLE' using errcode='55000';
end;
$function$;
routines.body:
declare c public.weekly_source_cycles%rowtype; g public.weekly_source_groups%rowtype;
  p public.weekly_source_projection_publications%rowtype; u public.weekly_source_uploads%rowtype;
  clients uuid[]; facts jsonb; actual_client uuid;
begin
  if p_cycle_id is null or p_client_ids is null or array_position(p_client_ids,null::uuid) is not null then
    raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_BULK_SOURCE_CAS_INVALID' using errcode='22023'; end if;
  select coalesce(array_agg(distinct value order by value),'{}'::uuid[]) into clients from unnest(p_client_ids) value;
  if cardinality(clients)>100 then raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_BULK_SOURCE_CAS_SCOPE_TOO_LARGE' using errcode='54000'; end if;
  select * into strict c from public.weekly_source_cycles where id=p_cycle_id;
  select * into strict g from public.weekly_source_groups where id=c.source_group_id and active and source_family='ROSTER';
  select * into strict p from public.weekly_source_projection_publications where id=c.current_projection_publication_id
    and source_cycle_id=c.id and state='CURRENT' and authority_scope_kind='CYCLE' and correction_session_id is null and report_scope_id is null;
  select * into strict u from public.weekly_source_uploads where id=c.current_complete_upload_id and id=p.upload_id
    and source_cycle_id=c.id and state='CURRENT' and report_scope_id is null;
  perform private.weekly_source_query_current_publication_v1(c.id,p.id);
  actual_client:=private.weekly_source_checking_client_scope_v1(p.id);
  if exists(select 1 from unnest(clients) client where (actual_client is not null and actual_client<>client)
    or not exists(select 1 from public.weekly_source_group_clients member where member.source_group_id=g.id and member.client_id=client
      and daterange(member.valid_from,coalesce(member.valid_to,'infinity'::date),'[]')
        && daterange(coalesce(u.confirmed_coverage_start_local_date,c.finalisation_week_ending-6),
          coalesce(u.confirmed_coverage_end_local_date,c.finalisation_week_ending),'[]'))) then
    raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_BULK_SOURCE_CAS_CLIENT_SCOPE_CHANGED' using errcode='40001'; end if;
  -- CTE scope comes from saved Source parents. Incident IDs contribute stable
  -- work-event scope irrespective of OPEN/CLOSED; their mutable rows do not.
  with report_scopes as materialized (
    select scope.* from public.weekly_source_report_scopes scope where scope.source_group_id=g.id
      and scope.client_id=any(clients) and scope.self_bill_report_id is not null
  ), report_bindings as materialized (
    select binding.* from public.weekly_source_self_bill_report_line_bindings binding
      join public.weekly_source_self_bill_reports report on report.id=binding.self_bill_report_id
      where report.source_group_id=g.id and report.client_id=any(clients) and binding.state='CURRENT'
  ), publications as materialized (
    select publication.* from public.weekly_source_projection_publications publication where publication.id=p.id
      or publication.id in(select current_projection_publication_id from report_scopes)
      or publication.id in(select export_projection_publication_id from report_bindings)
  ), uploads as materialized (
    select upload.* from public.weekly_source_uploads upload where upload.id=u.id
      or upload.id in(select upload_id from publications)
  ), source_rows as materialized (
    select row_data.* from public.weekly_source_upload_rows row_data where row_data.upload_id in(select id from uploads)
  ), resolutions as materialized (
    select resolution.* from public.weekly_source_row_resolutions resolution
      join source_rows row_data on row_data.id=resolution.upload_row_id
      join publications publication on publication.upload_id=row_data.upload_id
        and resolution.generation=coalesce(publication.projection_generation,publication.authority_scope_version)
      where resolution.client_id=any(clients)
      union select resolution.* from public.weekly_source_row_resolutions resolution
        join report_bindings binding on binding.bound_row_resolution_id=resolution.id
  ), events as materialized (
    select event.* from public.weekly_work_events event where event.first_source_group_id=g.id and event.client_id=any(clients)
      and (event.id in(select work_event_id from resolutions) or event.id in(select work_event_id from report_bindings)
        or exists(select 1 from public.weekly_discrepancy_incidents incident where incident.source_cycle_id=c.id
          and incident.work_event_id=event.id and incident.client_id=event.client_id))
  ), revisions as materialized (
    select revision.* from public.weekly_source_final_revisions revision
      join public.weekly_source_cycles source_cycle on source_cycle.id=revision.source_cycle_id and source_cycle.source_group_id=g.id
      where revision.state in ('CURRENT','PREPARED','SUPERSEDED') and (
        revision.source_cycle_id=c.id or revision.report_scope_id in(select id from report_scopes)
        or exists(select 1 from public.weekly_source_final_snapshot_lines snapshot where snapshot.final_revision_id=revision.id
          and snapshot.work_event_id in(select id from events)))
  ), snapshots as materialized (
    select snapshot.* from public.weekly_source_final_snapshot_lines snapshot where snapshot.final_revision_id in(select id from revisions)
      and snapshot.client_id=any(clients)
  ), lineages as materialized (
    select lineage.* from public.weekly_source_row_timesheet_lineages lineage where lineage.client_id=any(clients)
      and (lineage.row_resolution_id in(select id from resolutions) or lineage.work_event_id in(select id from events))
  ), pay_receipts as materialized (
    select receipt.* from public.weekly_source_ordinary_pay_projection_receipts receipt where receipt.client_id=any(clients)
      and receipt.final_revision_id in(select id from revisions)
  ), financial_identities as materialized (
    -- The Source receipt is immutable and already pins all published economics
    -- and root-before/after/service hashes. Protection may replace currentness
    -- on the same native family; the Source financial identity stays exact.
    select financial.id,financial.timesheet_id,financial.client_id,financial.candidate_id,
      (select min(m.contract_id::text)::uuid
        from pay_receipts receipt
        cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(case when jsonb_typeof(receipt.source_unit_outcomes_json)='array'
          then receipt.source_unit_outcomes_json else '[]'::jsonb end) unit
        join public.weekly_source_billing_movements m on m.id=(unit->>'movement_id')::uuid
          and m.final_revision_id=receipt.final_revision_id and m.invoice_timesheet_id=receipt.root_timesheet_id
          and m.actual_client_id=receipt.client_id and m.candidate_id=financial.candidate_id
          and encode(m.movement_economic_hash,'hex')=unit->>'movement_economic_hash'
          and m.source_profile_kind<>'SELF_BILL_REPORT'
          and m.source_line_kind not in ('SELF_BILL_REPORT_LINE','INVOICE_VAT_ROUNDING','SOURCE_REBILL_LINE','SOURCE_INVOICE_CORRECTION')
        where receipt.published_timesheet_financial_id=financial.id
        having count(distinct m.contract_id)=1) as contract_id
      from public.timesheets_financials financial where financial.id in(select published_timesheet_financial_id from pay_receipts)
  ), root_identities as materialized (
    select root.timesheet_id,root.client_id,contract.candidate_id,root.contract_id,root.booking_id
      from public.timesheets root join public.contracts contract on contract.id=root.contract_id
      where root.timesheet_id in(select root_timesheet_id from pay_receipts)
  ), cycles as materialized (
    select cycle.* from public.weekly_source_cycles cycle where cycle.id=c.id or cycle.id in(select source_cycle_id from publications)
      or cycle.id in(select source_cycle_id from revisions)
  ), contracts as materialized (
    select contract.* from public.contracts contract where contract.client_id=any(clients)
      and (daterange(contract.start_date,contract.end_date,'[]') && daterange(
        coalesce(u.confirmed_coverage_start_local_date,c.finalisation_week_ending-6),
        coalesce(u.confirmed_coverage_end_local_date,c.finalisation_week_ending),'[]')
        or contract.id in(select contract_id from resolutions) or contract.id in(select contract_id from snapshots)
        or exists(select 1 from public.weekly_issue_comparison_revisions comparison
          join public.weekly_discrepancy_incidents incident on incident.current_comparison_revision_id=comparison.id
          where incident.source_cycle_id=c.id and incident.client_id=contract.client_id and comparison.contract_id=contract.id))
  ), policy_dates as materialized (
    select client client_id,null::uuid contract_id,c.finalisation_week_ending work_date from unnest(clients) client
    union select client_id,contract_id,work_date from snapshots
    union select resolution.client_id,resolution.contract_id,row_data.work_date from resolutions resolution
      join source_rows row_data on row_data.id=resolution.upload_row_id
    union select client_id,null::uuid,work_date from events
    union select contract.client_id,contract.id,greatest(contract.start_date,
      coalesce(u.confirmed_coverage_start_local_date,c.finalisation_week_ending-6)) from contracts contract
  ), resolved_policies as materialized (
    select client_id,contract_id,work_date,private._weekly_source_effective_policy_v1(client_id,contract_id,work_date) policy
      from policy_dates
  )
  select jsonb_build_object('schema_version','WEEKLY_SOURCE_BULK_SOURCE_FACTS_V1','source_cycle_id',c.id,
    'client_ids',to_jsonb(clients),'group',to_jsonb(g),
    'cycles',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.id) from cycles x),'[]'::jsonb),
    'clients',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.id) from public.clients x where x.id=any(clients)),'[]'::jsonb),
    'memberships',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.client_id,x.valid_from,x.id)
      from public.weekly_source_group_clients x where x.source_group_id=g.id and x.client_id=any(clients)),'[]'::jsonb),
    'client_policies',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.client_id,x.effective_from,x.id)
      from public.weekly_source_client_policies x where x.source_group_id=g.id and x.client_id=any(clients)),'[]'::jsonb),
    'client_settings',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.client_id,x.id) from public.client_settings x where x.client_id=any(clients)),'[]'::jsonb),
    'contracts',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.id) from contracts x),'[]'::jsonb),
    'contract_policies',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.contract_id,x.effective_from,x.id)
      from public.weekly_source_contract_policies x where x.contract_id in(select id from contracts)),'[]'::jsonb),
    'global_settings',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) from public.weekly_source_global_settings x where x.singleton),'[]'::jsonb),
    'resolved_policies',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.client_id,x.contract_id nulls first,x.work_date) from resolved_policies x),'[]'::jsonb),
    'assignments',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.effective_from_week_ending,x.id)
      from public.weekly_source_group_rule_assignments x where x.source_group_id=g.id),'[]'::jsonb),
    'rule_versions',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.id) from public.weekly_source_rule_set_versions x
      where x.id in(select rule_set_version_id from public.weekly_source_group_rule_assignments where source_group_id=g.id)
        or x.id in(select rule_set_version_id from revisions)),'[]'::jsonb),
    'effective_rules',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('client_id',client,
      'effective_rule_set',private.weekly_source_operational_effective_rule_set_v1(client,c.id)) order by client) from unnest(clients) client),'[]'::jsonb),
    'profiles',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.id) from public.weekly_source_format_profiles x
      where x.id in(select source_format_profile_id from uploads)),'[]'::jsonb),
    'uploads',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.id) from uploads x),'[]'::jsonb),
    'publications',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.id) from publications x),'[]'::jsonb),
    'rows',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.upload_id,x.source_row_ordinal,x.id) from source_rows x),'[]'::jsonb),
    'resolutions',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.upload_row_id,x.generation,x.id) from resolutions x),'[]'::jsonb),
    'economics',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.row_resolution_id,x.id) from public.weekly_source_row_economic_snapshots x
      where x.row_resolution_id in(select id from resolutions)),'[]'::jsonb),
    'expense_policy_snapshots',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.row_resolution_id,x.id)
      from public.weekly_source_row_expense_policy_snapshots x where x.row_resolution_id in(select id from resolutions)),'[]'::jsonb),
    'expense_authorities',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.work_event_id,x.generation,x.id)
      from public.weekly_expense_authority_generations x where x.final_revision_id in(select id from revisions)
        and x.work_event_id in(select id from events)),'[]'::jsonb),
    'expense_cell_evidence',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.upload_id,x.source_row_ordinal,x.id)
      from public.weekly_source_expense_cell_evidence x where x.upload_id in(select id from uploads)),'[]'::jsonb),
    'charge_checks',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.row_resolution_id,x.id)
      from public.weekly_source_charge_checks x where x.row_resolution_id in(select id from resolutions)),'[]'::jsonb),
    'charge_acceptances',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.row_resolution_id,x.id)
      from public.weekly_source_charge_acceptances x where x.row_resolution_id in(select id from resolutions)),'[]'::jsonb),
    'invoice_hold_releases',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.upload_row_id,x.hold_kind,x.id)
      from public.weekly_source_invoice_hold_releases x where x.upload_row_id in(select id from source_rows)),'[]'::jsonb),
    'transitions',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.final_revision_id,x.work_event_id,x.id)
      from public.weekly_source_state_transitions x where x.final_revision_id in(select id from revisions)
        and x.work_event_id in(select id from events)),'[]'::jsonb),
    'report_scopes',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.id) from report_scopes x),'[]'::jsonb),
    'reports',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.id) from public.weekly_source_self_bill_reports x
      where x.source_group_id=g.id and x.client_id=any(clients)),'[]'::jsonb),
    'report_bindings',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.report_row_id,x.id) from report_bindings x),'[]'::jsonb),
    'events',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.id) from events x),'[]'::jsonb),
    'revisions',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.id) from revisions x),'[]'::jsonb),
    'snapshots',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.final_revision_id,x.work_event_id,x.id) from snapshots x),'[]'::jsonb),
    'lineages',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.id) from lineages x),'[]'::jsonb),
    'pay_receipts',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.id) from pay_receipts x),'[]'::jsonb),
    'financial_identities',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.id) from financial_identities x),'[]'::jsonb),
    'root_identities',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.timesheet_id) from root_identities x),'[]'::jsonb)) into facts;
  if exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(facts->'pay_receipts') receipt
    where receipt->>'published_timesheet_financial_id' is not null and (
      jsonb_typeof(receipt->'source_unit_outcomes_json') is distinct from 'array'
      or case when jsonb_typeof(receipt->'source_unit_outcomes_json')='array'
        then jsonb_array_length(receipt->'source_unit_outcomes_json')=0 else true end
      or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(case when jsonb_typeof(receipt->'source_unit_outcomes_json')='array'
          then receipt->'source_unit_outcomes_json' else '[]'::jsonb end) unit
        where not exists(select 1 from public.weekly_source_billing_movements m
          where m.id=(unit->>'movement_id')::uuid and m.final_revision_id=(receipt->>'final_revision_id')::uuid
            and m.invoice_timesheet_id=(receipt->>'root_timesheet_id')::uuid
            and m.actual_client_id=(receipt->>'client_id')::uuid
            and exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(facts->'financial_identities') financial
              where financial->>'id'=receipt->>'published_timesheet_financial_id'
                and financial->>'candidate_id'=m.candidate_id::text
                and financial->>'contract_id'=m.contract_id::text)
            and encode(m.movement_economic_hash,'hex')=unit->>'movement_economic_hash'
            and m.source_profile_kind<>'SELF_BILL_REPORT'
            and m.source_line_kind not in ('SELF_BILL_REPORT_LINE','INVOICE_VAT_ROUNDING','SOURCE_REBILL_LINE','SOURCE_INVOICE_CORRECTION'))))) then
    raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_BULK_SOURCE_CAS_FINANCIAL_IDENTITY_INVALID' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  if (select count(*) from public.clients where id=any(clients))<>cardinality(clients)
    or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(facts->'pay_receipts') receipt
      where receipt->>'published_timesheet_financial_id' is not null and not exists(
        select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(facts->'financial_identities') financial
          where financial->>'id'=receipt->>'published_timesheet_financial_id'
            and financial->>'timesheet_id'=receipt->>'root_timesheet_id' and financial->>'client_id'=receipt->>'client_id'
            and exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(facts->'root_identities') root
              join jsonb_array_elements(facts->'contracts') contract on contract->>'id'=financial->>'contract_id'
              where root->>'timesheet_id'=financial->>'timesheet_id'
                and root->>'candidate_id'=financial->>'candidate_id' and root->>'contract_id'=financial->>'contract_id'
                and (root->>'client_id' is null or root->>'client_id'=financial->>'client_id')
                and contract->>'client_id'=financial->>'client_id' and contract->>'candidate_id'=financial->>'candidate_id'))) then
    raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_BULK_SOURCE_CAS_FINANCIAL_IDENTITY_INVALID' using errcode='55000'; end if;

    raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_BULK_SOURCE_CAS_SCOPE_TOO_LARGE' using errcode='54000'; end if;
  return facts;
exception when no_data_found or too_many_rows or invalid_text_representation then
  raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_BULK_SOURCE_CAS_SCOPE_UNAVAILABLE' using errcode='55000';
end;

create or replace function private.weekly_source_protected_qualification_current_catalogue_v1()
returns jsonb language sql stable security definer set search_path to 'pg_catalog','public'
as $function$
with
app_namespaces as (
  select oid, nspname, nspowner, nspacl
  from pg_catalog.pg_namespace
  where nspname in ('public', 'private')
),
contract_role_names as (
  select oid, case when rolname=current_user then 'postgres' else rolname end as logical_name
  from pg_catalog.pg_roles
),
extensions_contract as (
  select jsonb_agg(
    jsonb_build_object('name', e.extname, 'schema', n.nspname)
    order by e.extname collate "C"
  ) as value
  from pg_catalog.pg_extension e
  join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid = e.extnamespace
  where e.extname in ('btree_gist', 'pgcrypto', 'pg_trgm', 'uuid-ossp')
),
enum_contract as (
  select jsonb_agg(
    jsonb_build_object(
      'schema', n.nspname,
      'name', t.typname,
      'labels', (
        select jsonb_agg(e.enumlabel order by e.enumsortorder)
        from pg_catalog.pg_enum e
        where e.enumtypid = t.oid
      )
    ) order by n.nspname collate "C", t.typname collate "C"
  ) as value
  from pg_catalog.pg_type t
  join app_namespaces n on n.oid = t.typnamespace
  where t.typtype = 'e'
),
relation_contract as (
  select jsonb_agg(
    jsonb_build_object(
      'schema', n.nspname,
      'name', c.relname,
      'kind', c.relkind,
      'owner', (select logical_name from contract_role_names where oid=c.relowner),
      'rls', c.relrowsecurity,
      'force_rls', c.relforcerowsecurity,
      'options', coalesce(to_jsonb(c.reloptions), '[]'::jsonb),
      'acl', coalesce((
        select jsonb_agg(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'grantee', expanded_acl.grantee,
            'privilege', expanded_acl.privilege,
            'grantable', expanded_acl.grantable
          ) order by expanded_acl.grantee collate "C",
                     expanded_acl.privilege collate "C", expanded_acl.grantable
        )
        from (
          select distinct
            case when a.grantee = 0 then 'PUBLIC'
              else (select logical_name from contract_role_names where oid=a.grantee) end as grantee,
            a.privilege_type as privilege,
            a.is_grantable as grantable
          from pg_catalog.aclexplode(coalesce(
            c.relacl,
            pg_catalog.acldefault(
              case when c.relkind = 'S' then 's'::"char" else 'r'::"char" end,
              c.relowner
            )
          )) a
        ) expanded_acl
      ), '[]'::jsonb),
      'columns', coalesce((
        select jsonb_agg(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'name', a.attname,
            'type', pg_catalog.format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod),
            'not_null', a.attnotnull,
            'identity', a.attidentity,
            'generated', a.attgenerated,
            'default', pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(d.adbin, d.adrelid)
          ) order by a.attname collate "C"
        )
        from pg_catalog.pg_attribute a
        left join pg_catalog.pg_attrdef d
          on d.adrelid = a.attrelid and d.adnum = a.attnum
        where a.attrelid = c.oid and a.attnum > 0 and not a.attisdropped
      ), '[]'::jsonb),
      'constraints', coalesce((
        select jsonb_agg(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'name', con.conname,
            'type', con.contype,
            'definition', pg_catalog.pg_get_constraintdef(con.oid, true),
            'deferrable', con.condeferrable,
            'deferred', con.condeferred,
            'validated', con.convalidated
          ) order by con.conname collate "C"
        )
        from pg_catalog.pg_constraint con
        where con.conrelid = c.oid
          -- PostgreSQL 18 also represents an ordinary column NOT NULL
          -- specification as a relation pg_constraint row (contype = 'n').
          -- The portable contract already seals that enforceable authority in
          -- columns[].not_null; it deliberately does not treat the generated
          -- constraint name as separate application authority.  Exclude only
          -- the exact ordinary duplicate shape.  Any future or malformed
          -- NOT NULL constraint metadata remains visible and therefore causes
          -- contract drift rather than being silently normalised away.
          and not (
            con.contype = 'n'
            and con.contypid = 0::oid
            and con.conindid = 0::oid
            and con.conparentid = 0::oid
            and con.confrelid = 0::oid
            and not con.condeferrable
            and not con.condeferred
            and con.convalidated
            and con.conislocal
            and con.coninhcount = 0
            and not con.connoinherit
            and con.conkey is not null
            and pg_catalog.cardinality(con.conkey) = 1
            and con.confkey is null
            and con.conpfeqop is null
            and con.conppeqop is null
            and con.conffeqop is null
            and con.conexclop is null
            and con.conbin is null
            and exists (
              select 1
              from pg_catalog.pg_attribute not_null_column
              where not_null_column.attrelid = con.conrelid
                and not_null_column.attnum = con.conkey[1]
                and not_null_column.attnum > 0
                and not not_null_column.attisdropped
                and not_null_column.attnotnull
            )
          )
      ), '[]'::jsonb),
      'indexes', coalesce((
        select jsonb_agg(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'name', i.relname,
            'definition', pg_catalog.pg_get_indexdef(i.oid)
          ) order by i.relname collate "C"
        )
        from pg_catalog.pg_index ix
        join pg_catalog.pg_class i on i.oid = ix.indexrelid
        where ix.indrelid = c.oid
      ), '[]'::jsonb),
      'view_definition_sha256', case when c.relkind = 'v' then
        pg_catalog.encode(
          extensions.digest(
            pg_catalog.convert_to(pg_catalog.pg_get_viewdef(c.oid, true), 'UTF8'),
            'sha256'
          ), 'hex'
        )
      else null end
    ) order by n.nspname collate "C", c.relkind, c.relname collate "C"
  ) as value
  from pg_catalog.pg_class c
  join app_namespaces n on n.oid = c.relnamespace
  where c.relkind in ('r', 'p', 'v', 'S')
    and not (
      n.nspname = 'private'
      and c.relname in (
        'cloudtms_database_identity',
        'cloudtms_database_releases',
        'cloudtms_migration_ledger',
        'cloudtms_repeatable_ledger'
      )
    )
),
routine_contract as (
  select jsonb_agg(
    jsonb_build_object(
      'schema', n.nspname,
      'identity', p.proname || '(' || pg_catalog.pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) || ')',
      'owner', (select logical_name from contract_role_names where oid=p.proowner),
      'security_definer', p.prosecdef,
      'volatility', p.provolatile,
      'parallel', p.proparallel,
      -- plpgsql_check is development instrumentation and is not installed by
      -- every PostgreSQL provider. Its routine-local settings are excluded
      -- from the provider-neutral application contract; search_path and every
      -- other routine configuration remain authoritative.
      'config', coalesce((
        select jsonb_agg(config_value order by config_value collate "C")
        from pg_catalog.unnest(coalesce(p.proconfig, array[]::text[])) config_value
        where config_value !~ '^plpgsql_check[.]'
      ), '[]'::jsonb),
      'acl', coalesce((
        select jsonb_agg(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'grantee', expanded_acl.grantee,
            'privilege', expanded_acl.privilege,
            'grantable', expanded_acl.grantable
          ) order by expanded_acl.grantee collate "C",
                     expanded_acl.privilege collate "C", expanded_acl.grantable
        )
        from (
          select distinct
            case when a.grantee = 0 then 'PUBLIC'
              else (select logical_name from contract_role_names where oid=a.grantee) end as grantee,
            a.privilege_type as privilege,
            a.is_grantable as grantable
          from pg_catalog.aclexplode(coalesce(
            p.proacl,
            pg_catalog.acldefault('f'::"char", p.proowner)
          )) a
        ) expanded_acl
        where not (
          p.proname = 'cloudtms_data_api_mfa_gate'
          and expanded_acl.grantee = 'authenticator'
        )
      ), '[]'::jsonb),
      'definition_sha256', pg_catalog.encode(
        extensions.digest(
          pg_catalog.convert_to(
            pg_catalog.replace(
              pg_catalog.regexp_replace(
                pg_catalog.pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),
                E'\n SET "plpgsql_check\\.[^"]+" TO ''[^'']*''',
                '',
                'g'
              ),
              E'\r\n',
              E'\n'
            ),
            'UTF8'
          ),
          'sha256'
        ), 'hex'
      )
    ) order by n.nspname collate "C", p.proname collate "C",
               pg_catalog.pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) collate "C"
  ) as value
  from pg_catalog.pg_proc p
  join app_namespaces n on n.oid = p.pronamespace
  where not exists (
    select 1
    from pg_catalog.pg_depend d
    where d.classid = 'pg_proc'::regclass
      and d.objid = p.oid
      and d.deptype = 'e'
  )
),
trigger_contract as (
  select jsonb_agg(
    jsonb_build_object(
      'schema', n.nspname,
      'table', c.relname,
      'name', t.tgname,
      'definition', pg_catalog.pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid, true),
      'enabled', t.tgenabled
    ) order by n.nspname collate "C", c.relname collate "C", t.tgname collate "C"
  ) as value
  from pg_catalog.pg_trigger t
  join pg_catalog.pg_class c on c.oid = t.tgrelid
  join app_namespaces n on n.oid = c.relnamespace
  where not t.tgisinternal
),
policy_contract as (
  select jsonb_agg(
    jsonb_build_object(
      'schema', schemaname,
      'table', tablename,
      'name', policyname,
      'permissive', permissive,
      'roles', coalesce((
        select jsonb_agg(
          case when role_name::text=current_user then 'postgres' else role_name::text end
          order by (case when role_name::text=current_user then 'postgres' else role_name::text end) collate "C"
        )
        from pg_catalog.unnest(roles) with ordinality as policy_role(role_name,ordinality)
      ), '[]'::jsonb),
      'command', cmd,
      'using', qual,
      'check', with_check
    ) order by schemaname collate "C", tablename collate "C", policyname collate "C"
  ) as value
  from pg_catalog.pg_policies
  where schemaname in ('public', 'private')
),
schema_contract as (
  select jsonb_agg(
    jsonb_build_object(
      'schema', n.nspname,
      'owner', (select logical_name from contract_role_names where oid=n.nspowner),
      'acl', coalesce((
        select jsonb_agg(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'grantee', expanded_acl.grantee,
            'privilege', expanded_acl.privilege,
            'grantable', expanded_acl.grantable
          ) order by expanded_acl.grantee collate "C",
                     expanded_acl.privilege collate "C", expanded_acl.grantable
        )
        from (
          select distinct
            case when a.grantee = 0 then 'PUBLIC'
              else (select logical_name from contract_role_names where oid=a.grantee) end as grantee,
            a.privilege_type as privilege,
            a.is_grantable as grantable
          from pg_catalog.aclexplode(coalesce(
            n.nspacl,
            pg_catalog.acldefault('n'::"char", n.nspowner)
          )) a
        ) expanded_acl
      ), '[]'::jsonb)
    ) order by n.nspname collate "C"
  ) as value
  from app_namespaces n
),
default_acl_rows as (
  select
    owner_role.logical_name as owner_name,
    n.nspname as schema_name,
    d.defaclobjtype as object_kind,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'owner', owner_role.logical_name,
      'schema', n.nspname,
      'kind', d.defaclobjtype,
      'acl', coalesce((
        select jsonb_agg(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'grantee', expanded_acl.grantee,
            'privilege', expanded_acl.privilege,
            'grantable', expanded_acl.grantable
          ) order by expanded_acl.grantee collate "C",
                     expanded_acl.privilege collate "C", expanded_acl.grantable
        )
        from (
          select distinct
            case when a.grantee = 0 then 'PUBLIC'
              else (select logical_name from contract_role_names where oid=a.grantee) end as grantee,
            a.privilege_type as privilege,
            a.is_grantable as grantable
          from pg_catalog.aclexplode(coalesce(
            d.defaclacl,
            pg_catalog.acldefault(d.defaclobjtype, d.defaclrole)
          )) a
        ) expanded_acl
      ), '[]'::jsonb)
    ) as contract_row
  from pg_catalog.pg_default_acl d
  join app_namespaces n on n.oid = d.defaclnamespace
  join contract_role_names owner_role on owner_role.oid=d.defaclrole
  -- Default privileges are installation authority only for the exact role
  -- running this release.  A provider image can also contain a physical role
  -- literally named `postgres`; when CURRENT_USER is the generated service
  -- owner, importing that bootstrap role's defaults would merge two different
  -- security postures under one logical owner.
  where d.defaclrole = (
    select role_row.oid
    from pg_catalog.pg_roles role_row
    where role_row.rolname = current_user
  )
),
default_acl_contract as (
  -- Collapse byte-identical rows defensively while preserving every distinct
  -- default privilege owned by the exact installation role above.
  select jsonb_agg(
    contract_row order by owner_name collate "C",
                          schema_name collate "C", object_kind
  ) as value
  from (
    select distinct owner_name, schema_name, object_kind, contract_row
    from default_acl_rows
  ) canonical_default_acl_rows
)
select jsonb_build_object(
  'contract_version', 5,
  'extensions', coalesce((select value from extensions_contract), '[]'::jsonb),
  'schemas', coalesce((select value from schema_contract), '[]'::jsonb),
  'enums', coalesce((select value from enum_contract), '[]'::jsonb),
  'relations', coalesce((select value from relation_contract), '[]'::jsonb),
  'routines', coalesce((select value from routine_contract), '[]'::jsonb),
  'triggers', coalesce((select value from trigger_contract), '[]'::jsonb),
  'policies', coalesce((select value from policy_contract), '[]'::jsonb),
  'default_acls', coalesce((select value from default_acl_contract), '[]'::jsonb)
);

      'config', coalesce((
        select jsonb_agg(config_value order by config_value collate "C")
        from pg_catalog.unnest(coalesce(p.proconfig, array[]::text[])) config_value
        where config_value !~ '^plpgsql_check[.]'
      ), '[]'::jsonb),
      'acl', coalesce((
        select jsonb_agg(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'grantee', expanded_acl.grantee,
            'privilege', expanded_acl.privilege,
            'grantable', expanded_acl.grantable
          ) order by expanded_acl.grantee collate "C",
                     expanded_acl.privilege collate "C", expanded_acl.grantable
        )
        from (
          select distinct
            case when a.grantee = 0 then 'PUBLIC'
              else (select logical_name from contract_role_names where oid=a.grantee) end as grantee,
            a.privilege_type as privilege,
            a.is_grantable as grantable
          from pg_catalog.aclexplode(coalesce(
            p.proacl,
            pg_catalog.acldefault('f'::"char", p.proowner)
          )) a
        ) expanded_acl
        where not (
          p.proname = 'cloudtms_data_api_mfa_gate'
          and expanded_acl.grantee = 'authenticator'
        )
      ), '[]'::jsonb),
      'definition_sha256', pg_catalog.encode(
        extensions.digest(
          pg_catalog.convert_to(
            pg_catalog.replace(
              pg_catalog.regexp_replace(
                pg_catalog.pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),
                E'\n SET "plpgsql_check\\.[^"]+" TO ''[^'']*''',
                '',
                'g'
              ),
              E'\r\n',
              E'\n'
            ),
            'UTF8'
          ),
          'sha256'
        ), 'hex'
      )
    ) order by n.nspname collate "C", p.proname collate "C",
               pg_catalog.pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) collate "C"
  ) as value
  from pg_catalog.pg_proc p
  join app_namespaces n on n.oid = p.pronamespace
  where not exists (
    select 1
    from pg_catalog.pg_depend d
    where d.classid = 'pg_proc'::regclass
      and d.objid = p.oid
      and d.deptype = 'e'
  )
),
trigger_contract as (
  select jsonb_agg(
    jsonb_build_object(
      'schema', n.nspname,
      'table', c.relname,
      'name', t.tgname,
      'definition', pg_catalog.pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid, true),
      'enabled', t.tgenabled
    ) order by n.nspname collate "C", c.relname collate "C", t.tgname collate "C"
  ) as value
  from pg_catalog.pg_trigger t
  join pg_catalog.pg_class c on c.oid = t.tgrelid
  join app_namespaces n on n.oid = c.relnamespace
  where not t.tgisinternal
),
policy_contract as (
  select jsonb_agg(
    jsonb_build_object(
      'schema', schemaname,
      'table', tablename,
      'name', policyname,
      'permissive', permissive,
      'roles', coalesce((
        select jsonb_agg(
          case when role_name::text=current_user then 'postgres' else role_name::text end
          order by (case when role_name::text=current_user then 'postgres' else role_name::text end) collate "C"
        )
        from pg_catalog.unnest(roles) with ordinality as policy_role(role_name,ordinality)
      ), '[]'::jsonb),
      'command', cmd,
      'using', qual,
      'check', with_check
    ) order by schemaname collate "C", tablename collate "C", policyname collate "C"
  ) as value
  from pg_catalog.pg_policies
  where schemaname in ('public', 'private')
),
schema_contract as (
  select jsonb_agg(
    jsonb_build_object(
      'schema', n.nspname,
      'owner', (select logical_name from contract_role_names where oid=n.nspowner),
      'acl', coalesce((
        select jsonb_agg(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'grantee', expanded_acl.grantee,
            'privilege', expanded_acl.privilege,
            'grantable', expanded_acl.grantable
          ) order by expanded_acl.grantee collate "C",
                     expanded_acl.privilege collate "C", expanded_acl.grantable
        )
        from (
          select distinct
            case when a.grantee = 0 then 'PUBLIC'
              else (select logical_name from contract_role_names where oid=a.grantee) end as grantee,
            a.privilege_type as privilege,
            a.is_grantable as grantable
          from pg_catalog.aclexplode(coalesce(
            n.nspacl,
            pg_catalog.acldefault('n'::"char", n.nspowner)
          )) a
        ) expanded_acl
      ), '[]'::jsonb)
    ) order by n.nspname collate "C"
  ) as value
  from app_namespaces n
),
default_acl_rows as (
  select
    owner_role.logical_name as owner_name,
    n.nspname as schema_name,
    d.defaclobjtype as object_kind,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'owner', owner_role.logical_name,
      'schema', n.nspname,
      'kind', d.defaclobjtype,
      'acl', coalesce((
        select jsonb_agg(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'grantee', expanded_acl.grantee,
            'privilege', expanded_acl.privilege,
            'grantable', expanded_acl.grantable
          ) order by expanded_acl.grantee collate "C",
                     expanded_acl.privilege collate "C", expanded_acl.grantable
        )
        from (
          select distinct
            case when a.grantee = 0 then 'PUBLIC'
              else (select logical_name from contract_role_names where oid=a.grantee) end as grantee,
            a.privilege_type as privilege,
            a.is_grantable as grantable
          from pg_catalog.aclexplode(coalesce(
            d.defaclacl,
            pg_catalog.acldefault(d.defaclobjtype, d.defaclrole)
          )) a
        ) expanded_acl
      ), '[]'::jsonb)
    ) as contract_row
  from pg_catalog.pg_default_acl d
  join app_namespaces n on n.oid = d.defaclnamespace
  join contract_role_names owner_role on owner_role.oid=d.defaclrole
  -- Default privileges are installation authority only for the exact role
  -- running this release.  A provider image can also contain a physical role
  -- literally named `postgres`; when CURRENT_USER is the generated service
  -- owner, importing that bootstrap role's defaults would merge two different
  -- security postures under one logical owner.
  where d.defaclrole = (
    select role_row.oid
    from pg_catalog.pg_roles role_row
    where role_row.rolname = current_user
  )
),
default_acl_contract as (
  -- Collapse byte-identical rows defensively while preserving every distinct
  -- default privilege owned by the exact installation role above.
  select jsonb_agg(
    contract_row order by owner_name collate "C",
                          schema_name collate "C", object_kind
  ) as value
  from (
    select distinct owner_name, schema_name, object_kind, contract_row
    from default_acl_rows
  ) canonical_default_acl_rows
)
select jsonb_build_object(
  'contract_version', 5,
  'extensions', coalesce((select value from extensions_contract), '[]'::jsonb),
  'schemas', coalesce((select value from schema_contract), '[]'::jsonb),
  'enums', coalesce((select value from enum_contract), '[]'::jsonb),
  'relations', coalesce((select value from relation_contract), '[]'::jsonb),
  'routines', coalesce((select value from routine_contract), '[]'::jsonb),
  'triggers', coalesce((select value from trigger_contract), '[]'::jsonb),
  'policies', coalesce((select value from policy_contract), '[]'::jsonb),
  'default_acls', coalesce((select value from default_acl_contract), '[]'::jsonb)
);

returns boolean language sql immutable security invoker set search_path to 'pg_catalog','pg_temp'
as $function$
  select coalesce(jsonb_typeof(p_value)='object' and p_value ?& p_keys
    and private.weekly_exceptional_json_keys_exact_v1(p_value,p_keys),false)
