create or replace function private.weekly_source_protected_operational_certificate_assert_v1(
  p_q jsonb,p_group_id uuid,p_from date,p_to date,p_expected_sha256 text
) returns jsonb language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path to 'pg_catalog','pg_temp'
as $function$
declare q jsonb:=p_q; g public.weekly_source_groups%rowtype; r private.cloudtms_database_releases%rowtype;
  executed private.cloudtms_database_releases%rowtype; native jsonb; row_value jsonb; closure jsonb;
  needed text[]; keys text[]; remote_needed text[]:=array['CLIENT_HTTP','OFFICE_UI','MYTMS_PHONE']; origin text; n integer;
begin
  select * into strict g from public.weekly_source_groups where id=p_group_id and active and source_family='ROSTER' and environment='TEST';
  select * into strict r from private.cloudtms_database_releases order by started_at_utc desc,release_id desc limit 1;
  if current_database()<>'cloudtms_test_clone' or r.status<>'VERIFIED' or r.completed_at_utc is null
    or r.installed_contract_sha256 is distinct from r.repository_contract_sha256
    or r.evidence_json#>>'{managed_release,environment}' is distinct from 'TEST'
    or r.evidence_json#>>'{managed_release,expected_database}' is distinct from current_database()
    or not private.weekly_source_qualification_closed_object_v1(q,array['schema_version','phase','release_id','git_commit','contract_sha256',
      'agency_id','environment','source_group_id','effective_from_week_ending','effective_to_week_ending','capabilities',
      'native_execution_qualification','remote_gate_receipts','test_setup_closure','source_equivalence','activation_scope','receipt_input_commit','qualification_sha256'])
    or q->>'schema_version' is distinct from 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_PROTECTED_CAPABILITY_OPERATIONAL_QUALIFICATION_V1'
    or q->>'phase' is distinct from 'ALL_PRE_SWITCH_GATES_QUALIFIED'
    or q->>'release_id' is distinct from r.release_id or q->>'git_commit' is distinct from r.git_commit
    or q->>'contract_sha256' is distinct from r.installed_contract_sha256 or q->>'agency_id' is distinct from g.agency_id::text
    or q->>'source_group_id' is distinct from g.id::text or q->>'environment' is distinct from g.environment
    or q->>'effective_from_week_ending' is distinct from p_from::text or q->>'effective_to_week_ending' is distinct from p_to::text
    or coalesce(p_expected_sha256,'') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' or q->>'qualification_sha256' is distinct from p_expected_sha256
    or q->>'qualification_sha256' is distinct from encode(private.weekly_source_sha256_jsonb_v1(
      'WEEKLY_SOURCE_PROTECTED_CAPABILITY_OPERATIONAL_QUALIFICATION_V1',q-'qualification_sha256'),'hex')
    or q->'capabilities' not in ('["BULK_SIGNED"]'::jsonb,'["AUTOMATIC_RECONCILE","BULK_SIGNED"]'::jsonb) then
    raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_PROTECTED_OPERATIONAL_GATES_REQUIRED' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  native:=q->'native_execution_qualification';closure:=q->'test_setup_closure';
  select * into strict executed from private.cloudtms_database_releases where release_id=native->>'release_id';
  if executed.status<>'VERIFIED' or executed.completed_at_utc is null
    or executed.git_commit is distinct from native->>'git_commit'
    or executed.installed_contract_sha256 is distinct from executed.repository_contract_sha256
    or executed.installed_contract_sha256 is distinct from r.installed_contract_sha256
    or executed.evidence_json#>>'{weekly_source_protected_qualification_catalogue,jsonb_sha256}'
      is distinct from r.evidence_json#>>'{weekly_source_protected_qualification_catalogue,jsonb_sha256}'
    or private.weekly_source_protected_qualification_release_v1()->>'release_id' is distinct from r.release_id
    or not private.weekly_source_qualification_closed_object_v1(native,array['schema_version','release_id','git_commit','contract_sha256','agency_id','environment',
      'source_group_id','effective_from_week_ending','effective_to_week_ending','capabilities','gate_receipts','qualification_sha256'])
    or native->>'schema_version' is distinct from 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_PROTECTED_CAPABILITY_QUALIFICATION_V1'
    or native->>'contract_sha256' is distinct from r.installed_contract_sha256
    or native->>'agency_id' is distinct from g.agency_id::text or native->>'source_group_id' is distinct from g.id::text
    or native->>'environment' is distinct from 'TEST' or native->>'effective_from_week_ending' is distinct from q#>>'{activation_scope,native_effective_from_week_ending}'
    or native->>'effective_to_week_ending' is distinct from q#>>'{activation_scope,native_effective_to_week_ending}' or native->'capabilities' is distinct from q->'capabilities'
    or native->>'qualification_sha256' is distinct from encode(private.weekly_source_sha256_jsonb_v1(
      'WEEKLY_SOURCE_PROTECTED_CAPABILITY_QUALIFICATION_V1',native-'qualification_sha256'),'hex') then
    raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_PROTECTED_OPERATIONAL_GATES_REQUIRED' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  needed:=array['SOURCE_CAS_NATIVE','NATIVE_PROTECTION','SECURITY','LEGACY_PAY','NEXT_PAY','CLIENT_API','DOCUMENT','OWN_STAGE_CAS','SOURCE_ROUTING'];
  if q->'capabilities' @> '["AUTOMATIC_RECONCILE"]'::jsonb then needed:=array_append(needed,'AUTOMATIC_COMPONENT_DELTA'); end if;
  if jsonb_typeof(native->'gate_receipts') is distinct from 'array' or jsonb_array_length(native->'gate_receipts')<>cardinality(needed)
    or (select count(distinct value->>'gate') from jsonb_array_elements(native->'gate_receipts') value)<>cardinality(needed) then
    raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_PROTECTED_OPERATIONAL_GATES_REQUIRED' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  for row_value in select value from jsonb_array_elements(native->'gate_receipts') value loop
    if not private.weekly_source_qualification_closed_object_v1(row_value,array['gate','status','execution','database','receipt_id','receipt_sha256',
        'source_commit','contract_sha256','source_group_id','agency_id','environment'])
      or not(coalesce(row_value->>'gate','')=any(needed)) or row_value->>'status' is distinct from 'PASS'
      or row_value->>'execution' is distinct from 'AGENCY_TEST_NATIVE' or row_value->>'database' is distinct from current_database()
      or row_value->>'source_commit' is distinct from executed.git_commit or row_value->>'contract_sha256' is distinct from executed.installed_contract_sha256
      or row_value->>'source_group_id' is distinct from g.id::text or row_value->>'agency_id' is distinct from g.agency_id::text
      or row_value->>'environment' is distinct from 'TEST' or nullif(row_value->>'receipt_id','') is null
      or coalesce(row_value->>'receipt_sha256','') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' then
      raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_PROTECTED_OPERATIONAL_GATES_REQUIRED' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  end loop;
  if not private.weekly_source_qualification_closed_object_v1(closure,array['scope_id','scope_sha256','setup_authorization_sha256',
      'original_census_sha256','actor_user_id','source_cycle_id','week_ending','execution_release_id','execution_source_commit',
      'execution_contract_sha256','closure_audit_id','closure_audit_sha256','state','closed_at_utc','all_assignments_disabled','all_operational_producers_false'])
    or exists(select 1 from unnest(array['scope_id','actor_user_id','source_cycle_id','closure_audit_id']) k
      where coalesce(closure->>k,'') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$')
    or exists(select 1 from unnest(array['scope_sha256','setup_authorization_sha256','original_census_sha256','closure_audit_sha256']) k
      where coalesce(closure->>k,'') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')
    or coalesce(closure->>'week_ending','') !~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'
    or coalesce(closure->>'closed_at_utc','') !~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]{1,6})?(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})$'
    or closure->>'state' is distinct from 'CLOSED' or closure->'all_assignments_disabled' is distinct from 'true'::jsonb
    or closure->'all_operational_producers_false' is distinct from 'true'::jsonb
    or closure->>'execution_release_id' is distinct from executed.release_id
    or closure->>'execution_source_commit' is distinct from executed.git_commit
    or closure->>'execution_contract_sha256' is distinct from executed.installed_contract_sha256
    or (closure->>'week_ending')::date<(native->>'effective_from_week_ending')::date
    or (native->>'effective_to_week_ending' is not null and (closure->>'week_ending')::date>(native->>'effective_to_week_ending')::date)
    or not exists(select 1 from public.audit_events a where a.id=(closure->>'closure_audit_id')::uuid
      and a.object_id_text=closure->>'scope_id' and a.event_sequence_is_authoritative
      and ((a.object_type='weekly_source_protected_test_journey' and a.action='WEEKLY_SOURCE_TEST_JOURNEY_CLOSED')
        or (a.object_type='weekly_source_off_rule_test_journey' and a.action='WEEKLY_SOURCE_OFF_RULE_TEST_CLOSED'))
      and a.after_json=closure-'closure_audit_id'-'closure_audit_sha256'
      and encode(private.weekly_source_sha256_jsonb_v1('WEEKLY_SOURCE_TEST_JOURNEY_CLOSED_V1',a.after_json),'hex')=closure->>'closure_audit_sha256') then
    raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_PROTECTED_OPERATIONAL_GATES_REQUIRED' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  if jsonb_typeof(q->'remote_gate_receipts') is distinct from 'array' or jsonb_array_length(q->'remote_gate_receipts')<>3
    or (select count(distinct value->>'gate') from jsonb_array_elements(q->'remote_gate_receipts') value)<>3 then
    raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_PROTECTED_OPERATIONAL_GATES_REQUIRED' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  for row_value in select value from jsonb_array_elements(q->'remote_gate_receipts') value loop
    origin:=case row_value->>'gate' when 'CLIENT_HTTP' then 'AUTHENTICATED_DEPLOYED_HTTP'
      when 'OFFICE_UI' then 'DEPLOYED_OFFICE_BROWSER_UI' when 'MYTMS_PHONE' then 'PHYSICAL_TESTFLIGHT_MYTMS_PHONE' end;
    keys:=case row_value->>'gate'
      when 'CLIENT_HTTP' then array['real_authenticated_session','trusted_actor_injected','closed_browser_payload','native_preview_commit_retry',
        'native_source_cas_error_order','foreign_actor_and_scope_refused','operational_readiness_false']
      when 'OFFICE_UI' then array['actual_deployed_bundle','deep_link_scope','actual_preview_and_confirmation','native_partial_retry_display',
        'unauthorised_controls_absent','operational_readiness_false']
      when 'MYTMS_PHONE' then array['actual_installed_test_build','actual_candidate_authenticated_session','genuine_signed_submission_bytes',
        'native_signature_authority','actual_approved_hours_display','actual_document_bytes_and_hash','operational_readiness_false'] end;
    if not private.weekly_source_qualification_closed_object_v1(row_value,array['schema_version','gate','origin','execution_release_id',
        'execution_source_commit','execution_contract_sha256','environment','database','agency_id','source_group_id','source_cycle_id',
        'actor_user_id','week_ending','scope_id','scope_sha256','original_census_sha256','server_request_ids','server_trace_sha256',
        'native_result_receipts_sha256','capture_sha256','deployments','assertions','receipt_id','receipt_sha256'])
      or origin is null or row_value->>'origin' is distinct from origin
      or row_value->>'schema_version' is distinct from 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_PROTECTED_REMOTE_GATE_RECEIPT_V1'
      or row_value->>'execution_release_id' is distinct from executed.release_id or row_value->>'execution_source_commit' is distinct from executed.git_commit
      or row_value->>'execution_contract_sha256' is distinct from executed.installed_contract_sha256
      or row_value->>'source_group_id' is distinct from g.id::text or row_value->>'agency_id' is distinct from g.agency_id::text
      or row_value->>'environment' is distinct from 'TEST' or row_value->>'database' is distinct from current_database()
      or exists(select 1 from unnest(array['source_cycle_id','actor_user_id','week_ending','scope_id','scope_sha256','original_census_sha256']) k
        where row_value->>k is distinct from closure->>k)
      or not private.weekly_source_qualification_closed_object_v1(row_value->'assertions',keys)
      or exists(select 1 from unnest(keys) k where row_value#>array['assertions',k] is distinct from 'true'::jsonb)
      or exists(select 1 from unnest(array['receipt_sha256','server_trace_sha256','native_result_receipts_sha256','capture_sha256']) k
        where coalesce(row_value->>k,'') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')
      or coalesce(row_value->>'receipt_id','') !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_./:@-]{1,256}$'
      or jsonb_typeof(row_value->'server_request_ids') is distinct from 'array'
      or jsonb_array_length(row_value->'server_request_ids') not between 1 and 100
      or (select count(distinct value) from jsonb_array_elements(row_value->'server_request_ids') value)
        <>jsonb_array_length(row_value->'server_request_ids')
      or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(row_value->'server_request_ids') request_id
        where jsonb_typeof(request_id)<>'string' or request_id#>>'{}' !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9:_-]{1,128}$')
      or not private.weekly_source_qualification_closed_object_v1(row_value->'deployments',array['worker_script','worker_version_id',
        'worker_source_commit','office_source_commit','office_bundle_sha256','mytms_source_commit','mytms_build_id',
        'mytms_bundle_identifier','mytms_build_artifact_sha256'])
      or coalesce(row_value#>>'{deployments,worker_version_id}','') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
      or exists(select 1 from unnest(array['office_source_commit','mytms_source_commit']) k
        where coalesce(row_value#>>array['deployments',k],'') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{40}$')
      or exists(select 1 from unnest(array['office_bundle_sha256','mytms_build_artifact_sha256']) k
        where coalesce(row_value#>>array['deployments',k],'') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')
      or nullif(row_value#>>'{deployments,mytms_build_id}','') is null
      or row_value#>>'{deployments,worker_script}' is distinct from 'test-cloudtms-backend'
      or row_value#>>'{deployments,worker_source_commit}' is distinct from executed.git_commit
      or row_value#>>'{deployments,mytms_bundle_identifier}' is distinct from 'net.cloudtms.mytms.test' then
      raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_PROTECTED_OPERATIONAL_GATES_REQUIRED' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  end loop;
  if (select count(distinct value->'deployments') from jsonb_array_elements(q->'remote_gate_receipts') value)<>1 then
    raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_PROTECTED_OPERATIONAL_GATES_REQUIRED' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  if coalesce(q->>'receipt_input_commit','') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{40}$' then
    raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_PROTECTED_OPERATIONAL_GATES_REQUIRED' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  perform private.weekly_source_activation_window_binding_assert_v1(q->'activation_scope',native,closure,g.id,p_from,p_to);
  -- Installed execution is immutable. Only receipt-input Git data differs.
  perform private.weekly_source_protected_execution_tree_assert_v2(q->'source_equivalence',executed.git_commit,q->>'receipt_input_commit');
  return q;
exception when no_data_found or too_many_rows or invalid_text_representation or datetime_field_overflow then
  raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_PROTECTED_OPERATIONAL_GATES_REQUIRED' using errcode='55000';
end;
$function$;
routines.body:
declare q jsonb:=p_q; g public.weekly_source_groups%rowtype; r private.cloudtms_database_releases%rowtype;
  executed private.cloudtms_database_releases%rowtype; native jsonb; row_value jsonb; closure jsonb;
  needed text[]; keys text[]; remote_needed text[]:=array['CLIENT_HTTP','OFFICE_UI','MYTMS_PHONE']; origin text; n integer;
begin
  select * into strict g from public.weekly_source_groups where id=p_group_id and active and source_family='ROSTER' and environment='TEST';
  select * into strict r from private.cloudtms_database_releases order by started_at_utc desc,release_id desc limit 1;
  if current_database()<>'cloudtms_test_clone' or r.status<>'VERIFIED' or r.completed_at_utc is null
    or r.installed_contract_sha256 is distinct from r.repository_contract_sha256
    or r.evidence_json#>>'{managed_release,environment}' is distinct from 'TEST'
    or r.evidence_json#>>'{managed_release,expected_database}' is distinct from current_database()
    or not private.weekly_source_qualification_closed_object_v1(q,array['schema_version','phase','release_id','git_commit','contract_sha256',
      'agency_id','environment','source_group_id','effective_from_week_ending','effective_to_week_ending','capabilities',
      'native_execution_qualification','remote_gate_receipts','test_setup_closure','source_equivalence','activation_scope','receipt_input_commit','qualification_sha256'])
    or q->>'schema_version' is distinct from 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_PROTECTED_CAPABILITY_OPERATIONAL_QUALIFICATION_V1'
    or q->>'phase' is distinct from 'ALL_PRE_SWITCH_GATES_QUALIFIED'
    or q->>'release_id' is distinct from r.release_id or q->>'git_commit' is distinct from r.git_commit
    or q->>'contract_sha256' is distinct from r.installed_contract_sha256 or q->>'agency_id' is distinct from g.agency_id::text
    or q->>'source_group_id' is distinct from g.id::text or q->>'environment' is distinct from g.environment
    or q->>'effective_from_week_ending' is distinct from p_from::text or q->>'effective_to_week_ending' is distinct from p_to::text
    or coalesce(p_expected_sha256,'') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' or q->>'qualification_sha256' is distinct from p_expected_sha256
    or q->>'qualification_sha256' is distinct from encode(private.weekly_source_sha256_jsonb_v1(
      'WEEKLY_SOURCE_PROTECTED_CAPABILITY_OPERATIONAL_QUALIFICATION_V1',q-'qualification_sha256'),'hex')
    or q->'capabilities' not in ('["BULK_SIGNED"]'::jsonb,'["AUTOMATIC_RECONCILE","BULK_SIGNED"]'::jsonb) then
    raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_PROTECTED_OPERATIONAL_GATES_REQUIRED' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  native:=q->'native_execution_qualification';closure:=q->'test_setup_closure';
  select * into strict executed from private.cloudtms_database_releases where release_id=native->>'release_id';
  if executed.status<>'VERIFIED' or executed.completed_at_utc is null
    or executed.git_commit is distinct from native->>'git_commit'
    or executed.installed_contract_sha256 is distinct from executed.repository_contract_sha256
    or executed.installed_contract_sha256 is distinct from r.installed_contract_sha256
    or executed.evidence_json#>>'{weekly_source_protected_qualification_catalogue,jsonb_sha256}'
      is distinct from r.evidence_json#>>'{weekly_source_protected_qualification_catalogue,jsonb_sha256}'
    or private.weekly_source_protected_qualification_release_v1()->>'release_id' is distinct from r.release_id
    or not private.weekly_source_qualification_closed_object_v1(native,array['schema_version','release_id','git_commit','contract_sha256','agency_id','environment',
      'source_group_id','effective_from_week_ending','effective_to_week_ending','capabilities','gate_receipts','qualification_sha256'])
    or native->>'schema_version' is distinct from 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_PROTECTED_CAPABILITY_QUALIFICATION_V1'
    or native->>'contract_sha256' is distinct from r.installed_contract_sha256
    or native->>'agency_id' is distinct from g.agency_id::text or native->>'source_group_id' is distinct from g.id::text
    or native->>'environment' is distinct from 'TEST' or native->>'effective_from_week_ending' is distinct from q#>>'{activation_scope,native_effective_from_week_ending}'
    or native->>'effective_to_week_ending' is distinct from q#>>'{activation_scope,native_effective_to_week_ending}' or native->'capabilities' is distinct from q->'capabilities'
    or native->>'qualification_sha256' is distinct from encode(private.weekly_source_sha256_jsonb_v1(
      'WEEKLY_SOURCE_PROTECTED_CAPABILITY_QUALIFICATION_V1',native-'qualification_sha256'),'hex') then
    raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_PROTECTED_OPERATIONAL_GATES_REQUIRED' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  needed:=array['SOURCE_CAS_NATIVE','NATIVE_PROTECTION','SECURITY','LEGACY_PAY','NEXT_PAY','CLIENT_API','DOCUMENT','OWN_STAGE_CAS','SOURCE_ROUTING'];
  if q->'capabilities' @> '["AUTOMATIC_RECONCILE"]'::jsonb then needed:=array_append(needed,'AUTOMATIC_COMPONENT_DELTA'); end if;
  if jsonb_typeof(native->'gate_receipts') is distinct from 'array' or jsonb_array_length(native->'gate_receipts')<>cardinality(needed)
    or (select count(distinct value->>'gate') from jsonb_array_elements(native->'gate_receipts') value)<>cardinality(needed) then
    raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_PROTECTED_OPERATIONAL_GATES_REQUIRED' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  for row_value in select value from jsonb_array_elements(native->'gate_receipts') value loop
    if not private.weekly_source_qualification_closed_object_v1(row_value,array['gate','status','execution','database','receipt_id','receipt_sha256',
        'source_commit','contract_sha256','source_group_id','agency_id','environment'])
      or not(coalesce(row_value->>'gate','')=any(needed)) or row_value->>'status' is distinct from 'PASS'
      or row_value->>'execution' is distinct from 'AGENCY_TEST_NATIVE' or row_value->>'database' is distinct from current_database()
      or row_value->>'source_commit' is distinct from executed.git_commit or row_value->>'contract_sha256' is distinct from executed.installed_contract_sha256
      or row_value->>'source_group_id' is distinct from g.id::text or row_value->>'agency_id' is distinct from g.agency_id::text
      or row_value->>'environment' is distinct from 'TEST' or nullif(row_value->>'receipt_id','') is null
      or coalesce(row_value->>'receipt_sha256','') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' then
      raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_PROTECTED_OPERATIONAL_GATES_REQUIRED' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  end loop;
  if not private.weekly_source_qualification_closed_object_v1(closure,array['scope_id','scope_sha256','setup_authorization_sha256',
      'original_census_sha256','actor_user_id','source_cycle_id','week_ending','execution_release_id','execution_source_commit',
      'execution_contract_sha256','closure_audit_id','closure_audit_sha256','state','closed_at_utc','all_assignments_disabled','all_operational_producers_false'])
    or exists(select 1 from unnest(array['scope_id','actor_user_id','source_cycle_id','closure_audit_id']) k
      where coalesce(closure->>k,'') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$')
    or exists(select 1 from unnest(array['scope_sha256','setup_authorization_sha256','original_census_sha256','closure_audit_sha256']) k
      where coalesce(closure->>k,'') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')
    or coalesce(closure->>'week_ending','') !~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'
    or coalesce(closure->>'closed_at_utc','') !~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]{1,6})?(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})$'
    or closure->>'state' is distinct from 'CLOSED' or closure->'all_assignments_disabled' is distinct from 'true'::jsonb
    or closure->'all_operational_producers_false' is distinct from 'true'::jsonb
    or closure->>'execution_release_id' is distinct from executed.release_id
    or closure->>'execution_source_commit' is distinct from executed.git_commit
    or closure->>'execution_contract_sha256' is distinct from executed.installed_contract_sha256
    or (closure->>'week_ending')::date<(native->>'effective_from_week_ending')::date
    or (native->>'effective_to_week_ending' is not null and (closure->>'week_ending')::date>(native->>'effective_to_week_ending')::date)
    or not exists(select 1 from public.audit_events a where a.id=(closure->>'closure_audit_id')::uuid
      and a.object_id_text=closure->>'scope_id' and a.event_sequence_is_authoritative
      and ((a.object_type='weekly_source_protected_test_journey' and a.action='WEEKLY_SOURCE_TEST_JOURNEY_CLOSED')
        or (a.object_type='weekly_source_off_rule_test_journey' and a.action='WEEKLY_SOURCE_OFF_RULE_TEST_CLOSED'))
      and a.after_json=closure-'closure_audit_id'-'closure_audit_sha256'
      and encode(private.weekly_source_sha256_jsonb_v1('WEEKLY_SOURCE_TEST_JOURNEY_CLOSED_V1',a.after_json),'hex')=closure->>'closure_audit_sha256') then
    raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_PROTECTED_OPERATIONAL_GATES_REQUIRED' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  if jsonb_typeof(q->'remote_gate_receipts') is distinct from 'array' or jsonb_array_length(q->'remote_gate_receipts')<>3
    or (select count(distinct value->>'gate') from jsonb_array_elements(q->'remote_gate_receipts') value)<>3 then
    raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_PROTECTED_OPERATIONAL_GATES_REQUIRED' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  for row_value in select value from jsonb_array_elements(q->'remote_gate_receipts') value loop
    origin:=case row_value->>'gate' when 'CLIENT_HTTP' then 'AUTHENTICATED_DEPLOYED_HTTP'
      when 'OFFICE_UI' then 'DEPLOYED_OFFICE_BROWSER_UI' when 'MYTMS_PHONE' then 'PHYSICAL_TESTFLIGHT_MYTMS_PHONE' end;
    keys:=case row_value->>'gate'
      when 'CLIENT_HTTP' then array['real_authenticated_session','trusted_actor_injected','closed_browser_payload','native_preview_commit_retry',
        'native_source_cas_error_order','foreign_actor_and_scope_refused','operational_readiness_false']
      when 'OFFICE_UI' then array['actual_deployed_bundle','deep_link_scope','actual_preview_and_confirmation','native_partial_retry_display',
        'unauthorised_controls_absent','operational_readiness_false']
      when 'MYTMS_PHONE' then array['actual_installed_test_build','actual_candidate_authenticated_session','genuine_signed_submission_bytes',
        'native_signature_authority','actual_approved_hours_display','actual_document_bytes_and_hash','operational_readiness_false'] end;
    if not private.weekly_source_qualification_closed_object_v1(row_value,array['schema_version','gate','origin','execution_release_id',
        'execution_source_commit','execution_contract_sha256','environment','database','agency_id','source_group_id','source_cycle_id',
        'actor_user_id','week_ending','scope_id','scope_sha256','original_census_sha256','server_request_ids','server_trace_sha256',
        'native_result_receipts_sha256','capture_sha256','deployments','assertions','receipt_id','receipt_sha256'])
      or origin is null or row_value->>'origin' is distinct from origin
      or row_value->>'schema_version' is distinct from 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_PROTECTED_REMOTE_GATE_RECEIPT_V1'
      or row_value->>'execution_release_id' is distinct from executed.release_id or row_value->>'execution_source_commit' is distinct from executed.git_commit
      or row_value->>'execution_contract_sha256' is distinct from executed.installed_contract_sha256
      or row_value->>'source_group_id' is distinct from g.id::text or row_value->>'agency_id' is distinct from g.agency_id::text
      or row_value->>'environment' is distinct from 'TEST' or row_value->>'database' is distinct from current_database()
      or exists(select 1 from unnest(array['source_cycle_id','actor_user_id','week_ending','scope_id','scope_sha256','original_census_sha256']) k
        where row_value->>k is distinct from closure->>k)
      or not private.weekly_source_qualification_closed_object_v1(row_value->'assertions',keys)
      or exists(select 1 from unnest(keys) k where row_value#>array['assertions',k] is distinct from 'true'::jsonb)
      or exists(select 1 from unnest(array['receipt_sha256','server_trace_sha256','native_result_receipts_sha256','capture_sha256']) k
        where coalesce(row_value->>k,'') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')
      or coalesce(row_value->>'receipt_id','') !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_./:@-]{1,256}$'
      or jsonb_typeof(row_value->'server_request_ids') is distinct from 'array'
      or jsonb_array_length(row_value->'server_request_ids') not between 1 and 100
      or (select count(distinct value) from jsonb_array_elements(row_value->'server_request_ids') value)
        <>jsonb_array_length(row_value->'server_request_ids')
      or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(row_value->'server_request_ids') request_id
        where jsonb_typeof(request_id)<>'string' or request_id#>>'{}' !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9:_-]{1,128}$')
      or not private.weekly_source_qualification_closed_object_v1(row_value->'deployments',array['worker_script','worker_version_id',
        'worker_source_commit','office_source_commit','office_bundle_sha256','mytms_source_commit','mytms_build_id',
        'mytms_bundle_identifier','mytms_build_artifact_sha256'])
      or coalesce(row_value#>>'{deployments,worker_version_id}','') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
      or exists(select 1 from unnest(array['office_source_commit','mytms_source_commit']) k
        where coalesce(row_value#>>array['deployments',k],'') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{40}$')
      or exists(select 1 from unnest(array['office_bundle_sha256','mytms_build_artifact_sha256']) k
        where coalesce(row_value#>>array['deployments',k],'') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')
      or nullif(row_value#>>'{deployments,mytms_build_id}','') is null
      or row_value#>>'{deployments,worker_script}' is distinct from 'test-cloudtms-backend'
      or row_value#>>'{deployments,worker_source_commit}' is distinct from executed.git_commit
      or row_value#>>'{deployments,mytms_bundle_identifier}' is distinct from 'net.cloudtms.mytms.test' then
      raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_PROTECTED_OPERATIONAL_GATES_REQUIRED' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  end loop;
  if (select count(distinct value->'deployments') from jsonb_array_elements(q->'remote_gate_receipts') value)<>1 then
    raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_PROTECTED_OPERATIONAL_GATES_REQUIRED' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  if coalesce(q->>'receipt_input_commit','') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{40}$' then
    raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_PROTECTED_OPERATIONAL_GATES_REQUIRED' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  perform private.weekly_source_activation_window_binding_assert_v1(q->'activation_scope',native,closure,g.id,p_from,p_to);
  -- Installed execution is immutable. Only receipt-input Git data differs.
  perform private.weekly_source_protected_execution_tree_assert_v2(q->'source_equivalence',executed.git_commit,q->>'receipt_input_commit');
  return q;
exception when no_data_found or too_many_rows or invalid_text_representation or datetime_field_overflow then
  raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_PROTECTED_OPERATIONAL_GATES_REQUIRED' using errcode='55000';
end;

create or replace function private.weekly_source_protected_execution_tree_assert_v2(p_proof jsonb,p_execution_commit text,p_installation_commit text)
returns void language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path to 'pg_catalog','pg_temp'
as $function$
declare file jsonb;
begin
  -- PostgreSQL cannot read Git objects. This asserts the closed receipt DTO;
  -- the protected managed writer MUST remeasure the literal complete Git tree.
  -- A caller JSON/hash assertion is never source equivalence authority.
  if not private.weekly_source_qualification_closed_object_v1(p_proof,array['schema_version','execution_source_commit','installation_source_commit',
      'inventory_schema','files','receipt_bindings','source_equivalence_sha256'])
    or p_proof->>'schema_version' is distinct from 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_COMMITTED_EXECUTION_TREE_EQUIVALENCE_V2'
    or p_proof->>'inventory_schema' is distinct from 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_NATIVE_RELEASE_TOOLCHAIN_VERIFIER_INVENTORY_V2'
    or p_proof->>'execution_source_commit' is distinct from p_execution_commit
    or p_proof->>'installation_source_commit' is distinct from p_installation_commit
    or p_proof->>'source_equivalence_sha256' is distinct from encode(private.weekly_source_sha256_jsonb_v1(
      'WEEKLY_SOURCE_COMMITTED_EXECUTION_TREE_EQUIVALENCE_V2',p_proof-'source_equivalence_sha256'),'hex')
    or jsonb_typeof(p_proof->'files') is distinct from 'array' or jsonb_array_length(p_proof->'files')=0
    or jsonb_typeof(p_proof->'receipt_bindings') is distinct from 'array'
    or (select count(distinct value->>'path') from jsonb_array_elements(p_proof->'files') value)<>jsonb_array_length(p_proof->'files')
    or exists(select 1 from unnest(array['.node-version','.gitattributes','osv-scanner.toml','.github/workflows/database-release.yml','supabase/release/export_contract.sql',
      'supabase/release/current-release.json','supabase/release/current-contract.json','scripts/cloudtms-db-release.mjs']) required_path
      where not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(p_proof->'files') item where item->>'path'=required_path)) then
    raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_PROTECTED_EXECUTION_TREE_CHANGED' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  for file in select value from jsonb_array_elements(p_proof->'files') value loop
    if not private.weekly_source_qualification_closed_object_v1(file,array['path','git_mode','git_type','execution_blob_oid','installation_blob_oid',
        'execution_sha256','installation_sha256','comparison','comparison_sha256'])
      or nullif(file->>'path','') is null or file->>'git_mode' not in ('100644','100755') or file->>'git_type' is distinct from 'blob'
      or exists(select 1 from unnest(array['execution_sha256','installation_sha256','comparison_sha256']) k
        where coalesce(file->>k,'') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')
      or exists(select 1 from unnest(array['execution_blob_oid','installation_blob_oid']) k where coalesce(file->>k,'') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{40}$')
      or (file->>'path'<>'supabase/release/current-release.json' and
        (file->>'comparison' is distinct from 'EXACT_GIT_OBJECT' or file->>'execution_blob_oid' is distinct from file->>'installation_blob_oid'
          or file->>'execution_sha256' is distinct from file->>'installation_sha256'))
      or (file->>'path'='supabase/release/current-release.json'
        and file->>'comparison' is distinct from 'RELEASE_AUTHORITY_EXCEPT_CLOSED_RECEIPT_DESCRIPTORS') then
      raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_PROTECTED_EXECUTION_TREE_CHANGED' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  end loop;
end;
$function$;

create or replace function private.weekly_source_rule_qualification_authorization_v1(p_cycle_id uuid,p_actor_id uuid,p_purpose text)
returns jsonb language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path to 'pg_catalog','pg_temp'
as $function$
declare r private.cloudtms_database_releases%rowtype; auth jsonb; n integer; recorded_at timestamptz;
begin
  perform private.weekly_source_query_require_service_v1();
  select * into strict r from private.cloudtms_database_releases order by started_at_utc desc,release_id desc limit 1;
  if current_database()<>'cloudtms_test_clone' or r.status<>'VERIFIED' or r.completed_at_utc is null
    or r.installed_contract_sha256 is distinct from r.repository_contract_sha256
    or r.evidence_json#>>'{managed_release,environment}' is distinct from 'TEST'
    or r.evidence_json#>>'{managed_release,expected_database}' is distinct from current_database()
    or jsonb_typeof(r.evidence_json->'weekly_source_protected_test_setup_authorizations') is distinct from 'array'
    or p_purpose not in ('SOURCE_FIXTURE_SETUP','AUTOMATIC_JOURNEY') then
    raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_RULE_QUALIFICATION_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  select count(*),jsonb_agg(value)->0 into n,auth
    from jsonb_array_elements(r.evidence_json->'weekly_source_protected_test_setup_authorizations') value
    where value->>'schema_version'='WEEKLY_SOURCE_OFF_RULE_TEST_AUTHORIZATION_V1'
      and value->>'source_cycle_id'=p_cycle_id::text and value->>'journey_actor_user_id'=p_actor_id::text
      and value->>'purpose'=p_purpose;
  select coalesce(max((audit.after_json->>'recorded_at_utc')::timestamptz),r.completed_at_utc) into recorded_at
    from public.audit_events audit where audit.object_type='weekly_source_post_verified_evidence'
      and audit.object_id_text=r.release_id and audit.action='WEEKLY_SOURCE_POST_VERIFIED_EVIDENCE_RECORDED'
      and audit.event_sequence_is_authoritative and audit.after_json->>'artifact_slot'='weekly_source_protected_test_setup_authorizations'
      and exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(audit.after_json->'artifacts') item
        where item->>'authorization_sha256'=auth->>'authorization_sha256');
  if n<>1 or not private.weekly_source_qualification_closed_object_v1(auth,array['schema_version','authorization_id','scope_id',
    'release_id','source_commit','contract_sha256','agency_id','source_group_id','source_cycle_id','setup_actor_user_id',
    'journey_actor_user_id','purpose','week_ending','expires_at_utc','fixture_namespace','fixture_manifest','assignment_id',

create or replace function private.weekly_source_historical_fixture_setup_assert_v1(p_auth jsonb,p_initial_open boolean)
returns void language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path to 'pg_catalog','pg_temp'
as $function$
declare completed jsonb; frame jsonb; assignment public.weekly_source_group_rule_assignments%rowtype;
  reference public.weekly_source_group_rule_assignments%rowtype; c public.weekly_source_cycles%rowtype; n integer;
  clients uuid[]; week date; today date; native_receipt jsonb;
begin
  today:=(clock_timestamp() at time zone 'Europe/London')::date;
  week:=(p_auth->>'week_ending')::date;
  select * into strict c from public.weekly_source_cycles where id=(p_auth->>'source_cycle_id')::uuid;
  select * into strict assignment from public.weekly_source_group_rule_assignments where id=(p_auth->>'assignment_id')::uuid;
  select count(*),jsonb_agg(audit.after_json)->0,jsonb_agg(audit.before_json)->0 into n,completed,frame
    from public.audit_events audit where audit.object_type='weekly_source_historical_fixture_assignment'
      and audit.action='WEEKLY_SOURCE_HISTORICAL_FIXTURE_ASSIGNED' and audit.event_sequence_is_authoritative
      and audit.after_json->>'assignment_id'=assignment.id::text;
  if n<>1 or not private.weekly_source_qualification_closed_object_v1(completed,array['schema_version','execution','source_cycle_id','assignment_id',
      'assignment_sha256','rule_set_version_id','native_receipt','frame_sha256','phase','operational_ready','historical_operational_activation'])
    or not private.weekly_source_qualification_closed_object_v1(frame,array['schema_version','request_id','actor_user_id','execution','turn_backend_pid',
      'source_cycle_id','future_reference_assignment_id','expected_future_assignment_sha256','fixture_manifest','native_request','transaction_id','backend_pid',
      'current_local_date','phase','operational_ready','frame_sha256'])
    or completed->'execution' is distinct from frame->'execution'
    or week>=today or extract(dow from week)<>0 or c.finalisation_week_ending<>week
    or assignment.source_group_id::text is distinct from p_auth->>'source_group_id'
    or c.source_group_id<>assignment.source_group_id or assignment.feature_enabled or assignment.feature_receipt_json is not null
    or assignment.effective_from_week_ending<>week or assignment.effective_to_week_ending is distinct from week
    or assignment.rule_set_version_id::text is distinct from p_auth->>'rule_set_version_id'
    or assignment.version::text is distinct from p_auth->>'assignment_version'
    or encode(private.weekly_source_sha256_jsonb_v1('WEEKLY_SOURCE_OFF_RULE_ASSIGNMENT_V1',to_jsonb(assignment)),'hex')
      is distinct from p_auth->>'assignment_sha256'
    or completed->>'schema_version' is distinct from 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_HISTORICAL_FIXTURE_ASSIGNED_V1'
    or completed->>'phase' is distinct from 'HISTORICAL_DISABLED_FIXTURE_ASSIGNMENT_ONLY'
    or completed->'operational_ready' is distinct from 'false'::jsonb
    or completed->'historical_operational_activation' is distinct from 'false'::jsonb
    or completed->>'source_cycle_id' is distinct from c.id::text
    or completed->>'assignment_sha256' is distinct from p_auth->>'assignment_sha256'
    or completed->>'rule_set_version_id' is distinct from p_auth->>'rule_set_version_id'
    or completed->>'frame_sha256' is distinct from frame->>'frame_sha256'
    or frame->>'frame_sha256' is distinct from encode(private.weekly_source_sha256_jsonb_v1(
      'WEEKLY_SOURCE_HISTORICAL_FIXTURE_ASSIGNMENT_FRAME_V1',frame-'frame_sha256'),'hex')
    or frame->'execution' is distinct from private.weekly_source_protected_qualification_release_v1()
    or frame->>'actor_user_id' is distinct from p_auth->>'setup_actor_user_id'
    or frame->>'source_cycle_id' is distinct from c.id::text or frame->'fixture_manifest' is distinct from p_auth->'fixture_manifest'
    or frame->'operational_ready' is distinct from 'false'::jsonb
    or frame->>'phase' is distinct from 'HISTORICAL_DISABLED_FIXTURE_ASSIGNMENT_ONLY'
    or assignment.assignment_request_id::text is distinct from frame#>>'{native_request,request_id}'
    or assignment.created_by_user_id::text is distinct from p_auth->>'setup_actor_user_id'
    or assignment.assignment_request_sha256 is distinct from encode(extensions.digest(convert_to((frame->'native_request')::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
    or not exists(select 1 from public.audit_events admitted where admitted.object_type='weekly_source_historical_fixture_assignment'
      and admitted.object_id_text=assignment.assignment_request_id::text and admitted.event_sequence_is_authoritative
      and admitted.action='WEEKLY_SOURCE_HISTORICAL_FIXTURE_ASSIGNMENT_ADMITTED' and admitted.after_json=frame) then
    raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_HISTORICAL_FIXTURE_ASSIGNMENT_UNPROVED' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  native_receipt:=completed->'native_receipt';
  if native_receipt is distinct from assignment.assignment_receipt_json
    or native_receipt->>'contract' is distinct from 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_RULE_ASSIGNED_V1'
    or native_receipt->>'assignment_id' is distinct from assignment.id::text
    or native_receipt->'feature_enabled' is distinct from 'false'::jsonb or native_receipt->'replayed' is distinct from 'false'::jsonb then
    raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_HISTORICAL_FIXTURE_ASSIGNMENT_UNPROVED' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  select * into strict reference from public.weekly_source_group_rule_assignments where id=(frame->>'future_reference_assignment_id')::uuid;
  if reference.source_group_id<>assignment.source_group_id or reference.feature_enabled
    or reference.rule_set_version_id is distinct from assignment.rule_set_version_id
    or reference.effective_from_week_ending<today
    or encode(private.weekly_source_sha256_jsonb_v1('WEEKLY_SOURCE_OFF_RULE_ASSIGNMENT_V1',to_jsonb(reference)),'hex')
      is distinct from frame->>'expected_future_assignment_sha256' then
    raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_HISTORICAL_FIXTURE_REFERENCE_CHANGED' using errcode='40001'; end if;
  if p_initial_open then
    -- Include every state and every group: an unsuccessful/partial old upload
    -- is still a prior upload for the fixture Client/week, never a fresh cycle.
    select array_agg(value::uuid order by value::uuid) into clients from jsonb_array_elements_text(p_auth#>'{fixture_manifest,client_ids}') value;
    if c.current_complete_upload_id is not null or c.current_projection_publication_id is not null or c.current_final_revision_id is not null
      or c.state in ('FINALISING','FINALISED','CORRECTION_IN_PROGRESS')
      or p_auth->'original_source_cas' is distinct from 'null'::jsonb
      or exists(select 1 from public.weekly_source_final_revisions final where final.source_cycle_id=c.id)
      or exists(select 1 from public.weekly_source_uploads upload join public.weekly_source_cycles cycle on cycle.id=upload.source_cycle_id
        where cycle.source_group_id=c.source_group_id or (cycle.finalisation_week_ending=week and (
          cycle.scope_client_id=any(clients) or upload.file_metadata_json->>'client_id' in(select value::text from unnest(clients) value)
          or exists(select 1 from public.weekly_source_group_clients member where member.source_group_id=cycle.source_group_id
            and member.client_id=any(clients) and week between member.valid_from and coalesce(member.valid_to,'infinity'::date))))) then
      raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_HISTORICAL_FIXTURE_NOT_FRESH' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  end if;
exception when no_data_found or too_many_rows or invalid_text_representation or datetime_field_overflow or invalid_datetime_format then
  raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_HISTORICAL_FIXTURE_ASSIGNMENT_UNPROVED' using errcode='55000';
end;
$function$;

    raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_HISTORICAL_FIXTURE_REFERENCE_CHANGED' using errcode='40001'; end if;
  if p_initial_open then
    -- Include every state and every group: an unsuccessful/partial old upload
    -- is still a prior upload for the fixture Client/week, never a fresh cycle.
    select array_agg(value::uuid order by value::uuid) into clients from jsonb_array_elements_text(p_auth#>'{fixture_manifest,client_ids}') value;
    if c.current_complete_upload_id is not null or c.current_projection_publication_id is not null or c.current_final_revision_id is not null
      or c.state in ('FINALISING','FINALISED','CORRECTION_IN_PROGRESS')
      or p_auth->'original_source_cas' is distinct from 'null'::jsonb
      or exists(select 1 from public.weekly_source_final_revisions final where final.source_cycle_id=c.id)
      or exists(select 1 from public.weekly_source_uploads upload join public.weekly_source_cycles cycle on cycle.id=upload.source_cycle_id
        where cycle.source_group_id=c.source_group_id or (cycle.finalisation_week_ending=week and (
          cycle.scope_client_id=any(clients) or upload.file_metadata_json->>'client_id' in(select value::text from unnest(clients) value)
          or exists(select 1 from public.weekly_source_group_clients member where member.source_group_id=cycle.source_group_id
            and member.client_id=any(clients) and week between member.valid_from and coalesce(member.valid_to,'infinity'::date))))) then
      raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_HISTORICAL_FIXTURE_NOT_FRESH' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  end if;
exception when no_data_found or too_many_rows or invalid_text_representation or datetime_field_overflow or invalid_datetime_format then
  raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_HISTORICAL_FIXTURE_ASSIGNMENT_UNPROVED' using errcode='55000';
end;

create or replace function private.weekly_source_operational_effective_rule_set_v1(p_client_id uuid,p_cycle_id uuid)
returns jsonb language sql stable security definer set search_path to 'pg_catalog','pg_temp'
as $function$
  select jsonb_build_object('contract','WEEKLY_SOURCE_EFFECTIVE_RULE_SET_V1','source_group_id',g.id,

  from public.weekly_source_cycles c join public.weekly_source_groups g on g.id=c.source_group_id and g.active and g.source_family='ROSTER'

  join public.weekly_source_rule_sets r on r.id=v.rule_set_id and r.agency_id=g.agency_id and r.environment=g.environment

create or replace function private.weekly_source_activation_window_binding_assert_v1(p_binding jsonb,p_native jsonb,p_closure jsonb,p_group uuid,p_from date,p_to date)
returns void language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path to 'pg_catalog','pg_temp'
as $function$
declare a public.weekly_source_group_rule_assignments%rowtype; v public.weekly_source_rule_set_versions%rowtype; lease jsonb; off_lease boolean;
begin
  if not private.weekly_source_qualification_closed_object_v1(p_binding,array['schema_version','assignment_id','assignment_version','assignment_sha256',
    'source_group_id','feature_purpose','rule_set_version_id','rule_values_sha256','effective_from_week_ending','effective_to_week_ending',
    'native_effective_from_week_ending','native_effective_to_week_ending','fixture_cycle_id','fixture_rule_set_version_id','fixture_rule_values_sha256',
    'scope_id','scope_sha256','original_census_sha256','scope_binding_sha256'])
    or p_binding->>'schema_version' is distinct from 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_ACTIVATION_WINDOW_BINDING_V1'
    or exists(select 1 from unnest(array['assignment_id','source_group_id','fixture_cycle_id','scope_id']) key
      where coalesce(p_binding->>key,'') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$')
    or exists(select 1 from unnest(array['assignment_sha256','scope_sha256','original_census_sha256','scope_binding_sha256']) key
      where coalesce(p_binding->>key,'') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')
    or coalesce(p_binding->>'assignment_version','') !~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'
    or p_binding->>'scope_binding_sha256' is distinct from encode(private.weekly_source_sha256_jsonb_v1(
      'WEEKLY_SOURCE_ACTIVATION_WINDOW_BINDING_V1',p_binding-'scope_binding_sha256'),'hex')
    or p_binding->>'source_group_id' is distinct from p_group::text
    or p_binding->>'effective_from_week_ending' is distinct from p_from::text
    or p_binding->>'effective_to_week_ending' is distinct from p_to::text
    or p_binding->>'native_effective_from_week_ending' is distinct from p_native->>'effective_from_week_ending'
    or p_binding->>'native_effective_to_week_ending' is distinct from p_native->>'effective_to_week_ending'
    or p_binding->>'fixture_cycle_id' is distinct from p_closure->>'source_cycle_id'
    or exists(select 1 from unnest(array['scope_id','scope_sha256','original_census_sha256']) key where p_binding->>key is distinct from p_closure->>key)
    or extract(dow from p_from)<>0 or (p_to is not null and (extract(dow from p_to)<>0 or p_to<p_from))
    or extract(dow from (p_native->>'effective_from_week_ending')::date)<>0
    or p_from<(p_native->>'effective_from_week_ending')::date then
    raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_OPERATIONAL_ACTIVATION_WINDOW_BINDING_INVALID' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  select * into strict a from public.weekly_source_group_rule_assignments where id=(p_binding->>'assignment_id')::uuid;
  if a.source_group_id<>p_group or a.effective_from_week_ending<>p_from or a.effective_to_week_ending is distinct from p_to
    or a.rule_set_version_id::text is distinct from p_binding->>'rule_set_version_id'
    or p_binding->>'feature_purpose' not in ('RULE_SET','PROTECTED_SOURCE') then
    raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_OPERATIONAL_ACTIVATION_WINDOW_BINDING_CHANGED' using errcode='40001'; end if;
  -- Before activation/recording the ENTIRE exact saved row is still disabled.
  -- After activation the normal native receipt, request/CAS and admin guards
  -- remain the capability reader's authority; this is never a new toggle.
  if not a.feature_enabled and (a.version::text is distinct from p_binding->>'assignment_version'
    or encode(private.weekly_source_sha256_jsonb_v1('WEEKLY_SOURCE_OFF_RULE_ASSIGNMENT_V1',to_jsonb(a)),'hex')
      is distinct from p_binding->>'assignment_sha256') then
    raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_OPERATIONAL_ACTIVATION_WINDOW_BINDING_CHANGED' using errcode='40001'; end if;
  if a.feature_enabled and (a.feature_purpose is distinct from p_binding->>'feature_purpose'
    or a.feature_receipt_json#>'{protected_capability_qualification,activation_scope}' is distinct from p_binding) then
    raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_OPERATIONAL_ACTIVATION_WINDOW_BINDING_CHANGED' using errcode='40001'; end if;
  select audit.after_json,audit.object_type='weekly_source_off_rule_test_journey' into strict lease,off_lease
    from public.audit_events audit where audit.object_id_text=p_closure->>'scope_id' and audit.event_sequence_is_authoritative
      and ((audit.object_type='weekly_source_off_rule_test_journey' and audit.action='WEEKLY_SOURCE_OFF_RULE_TEST_OPENED')
        or (audit.object_type='weekly_source_protected_test_journey' and audit.action='WEEKLY_SOURCE_TEST_JOURNEY_OPENED'))
      and audit.after_json->>'scope_sha256'=p_closure->>'scope_sha256';
  if p_binding->>'feature_purpose'='PROTECTED_SOURCE' then
    if a.rule_set_version_id is not null or p_binding->'rule_values_sha256' is distinct from 'null'::jsonb
      or p_binding->'fixture_rule_set_version_id' is distinct from 'null'::jsonb
      or p_binding->'fixture_rule_values_sha256' is distinct from 'null'::jsonb
      or p_native->'capabilities' @> '["AUTOMATIC_RECONCILE"]'::jsonb or off_lease then
      raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_OPERATIONAL_ACTIVATION_WINDOW_BINDING_INVALID' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  else
    select * into strict v from public.weekly_source_rule_set_versions where id=a.rule_set_version_id;
    if not off_lease or lease->>'purpose' is distinct from 'AUTOMATIC_JOURNEY'
      or lease->>'rule_set_version_id' is distinct from v.id::text
      or p_binding->>'fixture_rule_set_version_id' is distinct from v.id::text
      or p_binding->>'fixture_rule_values_sha256' is distinct from v.values_sha256
      or p_binding->>'rule_values_sha256' is distinct from v.values_sha256
      or v.values_json->>'invoice_sender' is distinct from 'CLIENT_SELF_BILL' then
      raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_OPERATIONAL_ACTIVATION_WINDOW_BINDING_INVALID' using errcode='55000'; end if;
    perform private._weekly_source_rule_group_context_v1(p_group,p_from,p_to,v.values_json,true);
  end if;
exception when no_data_found or too_many_rows or invalid_text_representation or datetime_field_overflow or invalid_datetime_format then
  raise exception 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_OPERATIONAL_ACTIVATION_WINDOW_BINDING_INVALID' using errcode='55000';
end;

  if not a.feature_enabled and (a.version::text is distinct from p_binding->>'assignment_version'
    or encode(private.weekly_source_sha256_jsonb_v1('WEEKLY_SOURCE_OFF_RULE_ASSIGNMENT_V1',to_jsonb(a)),'hex')

  if a.feature_enabled and (a.feature_purpose is distinct from p_binding->>'feature_purpose'

create or replace function private.timesheet_correction_a0_clock_scope_v1(p_request_id uuid)
returns jsonb language plpgsql stable security definer
set search_path to 'pg_catalog','pg_temp'
as $function$
declare
  v_request private.timesheet_correction_requests%rowtype;
  v_ts public.timesheets%rowtype; v_contract public.contracts%rowtype;
  v_settings jsonb; v_members jsonb; v_member jsonb; v_scope jsonb;
begin
  select r.* into v_request from private.timesheet_correction_requests r where r.id=p_request_id;
  if not found or v_request.state<>'WAITING' or v_request.origin<>'SIGNED_TIMESHEET_CORRECTION'
    or v_request.reversed_financial_id is not null or v_request.original_invoice_id is not null
    or v_request.return_invoice_id is not null then
    raise exception 'CORRECTION_A0_NATIVE_CLOCK_SCOPE_UNPROVED' using errcode='55000';
  end if;
  select t.* into v_ts from public.timesheets t where t.timesheet_id=v_request.reversed_timesheet_id;
  if not found or v_ts.version<>v_request.reversed_version or not v_ts.is_current
    or v_ts.sheet_scope::text<>'WEEKLY' or v_ts.archived_at_utc is not null
    or v_ts.authorised_at_server is not null or v_ts.revoked_at is not null
    or v_ts.contract_id is distinct from v_request.contract_id
    or v_ts.week_ending_date is distinct from v_request.week_ending_date
    or v_ts.booking_id is distinct from v_request.frozen_original_json#>>'{timesheet,booking_id}'
    or private.timesheet_correction_timesheet_authority_hash_v1(to_jsonb(v_ts))
      is distinct from private.timesheet_correction_timesheet_authority_hash_v1(v_request.frozen_original_json->'timesheet')
    or v_request.frozen_original_json->'financial_snapshot' is distinct from 'null'::jsonb
    or v_request.frozen_original_json->'financial_authority_hash' is distinct from 'null'::jsonb
    or jsonb_typeof(v_request.frozen_original_json->'manager_signed_witness') is distinct from 'object'
    or exists(select 1 from public.timesheets_financials f where f.timesheet_id=v_ts.timesheet_id)
    or exists(select 1 from public.nhsp_shifts s where s.timesheet_id=v_ts.timesheet_id and s.cancelled_at_utc is null)
    or exists(select 1 from public.weekly_source_row_timesheet_lineages l where l.timesheet_id=v_ts.timesheet_id)
    -- The unchanged weekly clock calculator preserves expense/mileage from
    -- curFin. With no curFin an extant native claim must not become fabricated
    -- zero. A separate native claim materialisation journey is required.
    or exists(select 1 from public.candidate_expense_components e
      where e.removed_at_utc is null and (e.owning_timesheet_id=v_ts.timesheet_id
        or (e.owning_timesheet_id is null and e.workflow_id in(
          select w.id from public.candidate_submission_workflows w
          where w.target_timesheet_id in(v_ts.timesheet_id,v_request.replacement_timesheet_id)
            or w.anchor_timesheet_id in(v_ts.timesheet_id,v_request.replacement_timesheet_id)))
        or (e.owning_timesheet_id=v_request.replacement_timesheet_id
          and not exists(select 1 from public.timesheets_financials pf
            where pf.timesheet_id=v_request.replacement_timesheet_id and pf.is_current))))
    then raise exception 'CORRECTION_A0_NATIVE_CLOCK_SCOPE_UNPROVED' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  select c.* into v_contract from public.contracts c where c.id=v_ts.contract_id;
  if not found or v_contract.candidate_id is distinct from v_request.candidate_id
    or v_contract.client_id is distinct from v_request.client_id
    or v_contract.start_date is null or v_contract.end_date is null
    or jsonb_typeof(v_ts.actual_schedule_json) is distinct from 'array'
    then raise exception 'CORRECTION_A0_NATIVE_CLOCK_SCOPE_UNPROVED' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  if jsonb_array_length(v_ts.actual_schedule_json)=0 then
    raise exception 'CORRECTION_A0_NATIVE_CLOCK_SCOPE_UNPROVED' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  -- Validate dates separately before casting. Native clock/break owners retain
  -- complete range/overnight/time bucket calculation and their own refusals.
  if exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(v_ts.actual_schedule_json) s(value)
    where jsonb_typeof(s.value) is distinct from 'object'
      or pg_input_is_valid(s.value->>'date','date') is distinct from true
      or (s.value->>'date' ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$') is distinct from true) then
    raise exception 'CORRECTION_A0_NATIVE_CLOCK_SCOPE_UNPROVED' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  if exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(v_ts.actual_schedule_json) s(value)
    where (s.value->>'date')::date not between v_ts.week_ending_date-6 and v_ts.week_ending_date
      or (s.value->>'date')::date not between v_contract.start_date and v_contract.end_date) then
    raise exception 'CORRECTION_A0_NATIVE_CLOCK_SCOPE_UNPROVED' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  v_settings:=private._timesheet_settings_authority_frozen_v1(v_ts.timesheet_id);
  if v_settings->>'client_id' is distinct from v_request.client_id::text
    or v_settings->>'contract_id' is distinct from v_request.contract_id::text
    or v_settings#>'{applicability,configuration_valid}' is distinct from 'true'::jsonb
    or v_settings#>'{applicability,import_authoritative}' is distinct from 'false'::jsonb
    or private.weekly_source_signed_check_only_v1(v_ts.timesheet_id) is distinct from true
    then raise exception 'CORRECTION_A0_NATIVE_CLOCK_SCOPE_UNPROVED' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  -- Require actual controlled NULL-rule SIGNED_CHECK_ONLY activation. NULL
  -- effective rules alone cannot prove a legacy/native clock price scope.
  select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'source_group_id',g.id,'source_group_version',g.version::text,
      'membership_id',gc.id,'membership_valid_from',gc.valid_from,'membership_valid_to',gc.valid_to,
      'assignment_id',a.id,'assignment_version',a.version::text,
      'activation_release_id',a.feature_release_id,'activation_request_id',a.feature_request_id,
      'activation_request_sha256',a.feature_request_sha256,
      'activation_receipt_sha256',encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(a.feature_receipt_json::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex'))
      order by g.id,gc.id,a.id) into v_members
    from public.weekly_source_groups g
    join public.weekly_source_group_clients gc on gc.source_group_id=g.id and gc.client_id=v_request.client_id
    join public.weekly_source_group_rule_assignments a on a.source_group_id=g.id
    join private.cloudtms_database_releases rel on rel.release_id=a.feature_release_id
    where g.active and g.source_family='ROSTER'
      and v_ts.week_ending_date between gc.valid_from and coalesce(gc.valid_to,'infinity'::date)
      and a.feature_enabled and a.feature_purpose='SIGNED_CHECK_ONLY' and a.rule_set_version_id is null
      and v_ts.week_ending_date between a.effective_from_week_ending and coalesce(a.effective_to_week_ending,'infinity'::date)
      and a.feature_changed_at_utc is not null and a.feature_request_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
      and a.feature_receipt_json->>'contract'='WEEKLY_SOURCE_RULE_FEATURE_RECEIPT_V1'
      and a.feature_receipt_json->>'assignment_id'=a.id::text
      and a.feature_receipt_json->>'feature_purpose'='SIGNED_CHECK_ONLY'
      and a.feature_receipt_json->'feature_enabled'='true'::jsonb
      and a.feature_receipt_json->>'release_id'=a.feature_release_id
      and rel.status='VERIFIED' and rel.completed_at_utc is not null
      and rel.installed_contract_sha256=rel.repository_contract_sha256;
  if v_members is null or jsonb_array_length(v_members)<>1
    or exists(select 1 from public.weekly_source_group_clients gc
      join public.weekly_source_group_rule_assignments a on a.source_group_id=gc.source_group_id
      where gc.client_id=v_request.client_id and a.feature_purpose='RULE_SET'
        and (a.feature_enabled or a.feature_release_id is not null or a.feature_changed_at_utc is not null)
        and v_ts.week_ending_date between gc.valid_from and coalesce(gc.valid_to,'infinity'::date)
        and v_ts.week_ending_date between a.effective_from_week_ending and coalesce(a.effective_to_week_ending,'infinity'::date)) then
    raise exception 'CORRECTION_A0_NATIVE_CLOCK_SCOPE_UNPROVED' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  v_member:=v_members->0;
  v_scope:=jsonb_build_object('contract','TIMESHEET_CORRECTION_A0_CLOCK_SCOPE_V1',
    'request_id',v_request.id,'original_timesheet_id',v_ts.timesheet_id,'original_version',v_ts.version,
    'original_booking_id',v_ts.booking_id,'candidate_id',v_request.candidate_id,'client_id',v_request.client_id,
    'contract_id',v_contract.id,'week_ending_date',v_ts.week_ending_date,
    'pricing_origin','SIGNED_CHECK_ONLY_CONTRACT_RATES','rule_set_version_id',null,
    'settings_authority_fingerprint',v_settings->>'authority_fingerprint',
    'timesheet_authority_hash',private.timesheet_correction_timesheet_authority_hash_v1(to_jsonb(v_ts)),
    -- Exact native read input, never labelled as an invented historical rate.
    'contract_input',to_jsonb(v_contract),'controlled_scope',v_member);
  return v_scope||jsonb_build_object('scope_sha256',encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(v_scope::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex'));

declare
  v_request private.timesheet_correction_requests%rowtype;
  v_ts public.timesheets%rowtype; v_contract public.contracts%rowtype;
  v_settings jsonb; v_members jsonb; v_member jsonb; v_scope jsonb;
begin
  select r.* into v_request from private.timesheet_correction_requests r where r.id=p_request_id;
  if not found or v_request.state<>'WAITING' or v_request.origin<>'SIGNED_TIMESHEET_CORRECTION'
    or v_request.reversed_financial_id is not null or v_request.original_invoice_id is not null
    or v_request.return_invoice_id is not null then
    raise exception 'CORRECTION_A0_NATIVE_CLOCK_SCOPE_UNPROVED' using errcode='55000';
  end if;
  select t.* into v_ts from public.timesheets t where t.timesheet_id=v_request.reversed_timesheet_id;
  if not found or v_ts.version<>v_request.reversed_version or not v_ts.is_current
    or v_ts.sheet_scope::text<>'WEEKLY' or v_ts.archived_at_utc is not null
    or v_ts.authorised_at_server is not null or v_ts.revoked_at is not null
    or v_ts.contract_id is distinct from v_request.contract_id
    or v_ts.week_ending_date is distinct from v_request.week_ending_date
    or v_ts.booking_id is distinct from v_request.frozen_original_json#>>'{timesheet,booking_id}'
    or private.timesheet_correction_timesheet_authority_hash_v1(to_jsonb(v_ts))
      is distinct from private.timesheet_correction_timesheet_authority_hash_v1(v_request.frozen_original_json->'timesheet')
    or v_request.frozen_original_json->'financial_snapshot' is distinct from 'null'::jsonb
    or v_request.frozen_original_json->'financial_authority_hash' is distinct from 'null'::jsonb
    or jsonb_typeof(v_request.frozen_original_json->'manager_signed_witness') is distinct from 'object'
    or exists(select 1 from public.timesheets_financials f where f.timesheet_id=v_ts.timesheet_id)
    or exists(select 1 from public.nhsp_shifts s where s.timesheet_id=v_ts.timesheet_id and s.cancelled_at_utc is null)
    or exists(select 1 from public.weekly_source_row_timesheet_lineages l where l.timesheet_id=v_ts.timesheet_id)
    -- The unchanged weekly clock calculator preserves expense/mileage from
    -- curFin. With no curFin an extant native claim must not become fabricated
    -- zero. A separate native claim materialisation journey is required.
    or exists(select 1 from public.candidate_expense_components e
      where e.removed_at_utc is null and (e.owning_timesheet_id=v_ts.timesheet_id
        or (e.owning_timesheet_id is null and e.workflow_id in(
          select w.id from public.candidate_submission_workflows w
          where w.target_timesheet_id in(v_ts.timesheet_id,v_request.replacement_timesheet_id)
            or w.anchor_timesheet_id in(v_ts.timesheet_id,v_request.replacement_timesheet_id)))
        or (e.owning_timesheet_id=v_request.replacement_timesheet_id
          and not exists(select 1 from public.timesheets_financials pf
            where pf.timesheet_id=v_request.replacement_timesheet_id and pf.is_current))))
    then raise exception 'CORRECTION_A0_NATIVE_CLOCK_SCOPE_UNPROVED' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  select c.* into v_contract from public.contracts c where c.id=v_ts.contract_id;
  if not found or v_contract.candidate_id is distinct from v_request.candidate_id
    or v_contract.client_id is distinct from v_request.client_id
    or v_contract.start_date is null or v_contract.end_date is null
    or jsonb_typeof(v_ts.actual_schedule_json) is distinct from 'array'
    then raise exception 'CORRECTION_A0_NATIVE_CLOCK_SCOPE_UNPROVED' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  if jsonb_array_length(v_ts.actual_schedule_json)=0 then
    raise exception 'CORRECTION_A0_NATIVE_CLOCK_SCOPE_UNPROVED' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  -- Validate dates separately before casting. Native clock/break owners retain
  -- complete range/overnight/time bucket calculation and their own refusals.
  if exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(v_ts.actual_schedule_json) s(value)
    where jsonb_typeof(s.value) is distinct from 'object'
      or pg_input_is_valid(s.value->>'date','date') is distinct from true
      or (s.value->>'date' ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$') is distinct from true) then
    raise exception 'CORRECTION_A0_NATIVE_CLOCK_SCOPE_UNPROVED' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  if exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(v_ts.actual_schedule_json) s(value)
    where (s.value->>'date')::date not between v_ts.week_ending_date-6 and v_ts.week_ending_date
      or (s.value->>'date')::date not between v_contract.start_date and v_contract.end_date) then
    raise exception 'CORRECTION_A0_NATIVE_CLOCK_SCOPE_UNPROVED' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  v_settings:=private._timesheet_settings_authority_frozen_v1(v_ts.timesheet_id);
  if v_settings->>'client_id' is distinct from v_request.client_id::text
    or v_settings->>'contract_id' is distinct from v_request.contract_id::text
    or v_settings#>'{applicability,configuration_valid}' is distinct from 'true'::jsonb
    or v_settings#>'{applicability,import_authoritative}' is distinct from 'false'::jsonb
    or private.weekly_source_signed_check_only_v1(v_ts.timesheet_id) is distinct from true
    then raise exception 'CORRECTION_A0_NATIVE_CLOCK_SCOPE_UNPROVED' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  -- Require actual controlled NULL-rule SIGNED_CHECK_ONLY activation. NULL
  -- effective rules alone cannot prove a legacy/native clock price scope.
  select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'source_group_id',g.id,'source_group_version',g.version::text,
      'membership_id',gc.id,'membership_valid_from',gc.valid_from,'membership_valid_to',gc.valid_to,
      'assignment_id',a.id,'assignment_version',a.version::text,
      'activation_release_id',a.feature_release_id,'activation_request_id',a.feature_request_id,
      'activation_request_sha256',a.feature_request_sha256,
      'activation_receipt_sha256',encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(a.feature_receipt_json::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex'))
      order by g.id,gc.id,a.id) into v_members
    from public.weekly_source_groups g
    join public.weekly_source_group_clients gc on gc.source_group_id=g.id and gc.client_id=v_request.client_id
    join public.weekly_source_group_rule_assignments a on a.source_group_id=g.id
    join private.cloudtms_database_releases rel on rel.release_id=a.feature_release_id
    where g.active and g.source_family='ROSTER'
      and v_ts.week_ending_date between gc.valid_from and coalesce(gc.valid_to,'infinity'::date)
      and a.feature_enabled and a.feature_purpose='SIGNED_CHECK_ONLY' and a.rule_set_version_id is null
      and v_ts.week_ending_date between a.effective_from_week_ending and coalesce(a.effective_to_week_ending,'infinity'::date)
      and a.feature_changed_at_utc is not null and a.feature_request_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
      and a.feature_receipt_json->>'contract'='WEEKLY_SOURCE_RULE_FEATURE_RECEIPT_V1'
      and a.feature_receipt_json->>'assignment_id'=a.id::text
      and a.feature_receipt_json->>'feature_purpose'='SIGNED_CHECK_ONLY'
      and a.feature_receipt_json->'feature_enabled'='true'::jsonb
      and a.feature_receipt_json->>'release_id'=a.feature_release_id
      and rel.status='VERIFIED' and rel.completed_at_utc is not null
      and rel.installed_contract_sha256=rel.repository_contract_sha256;
  if v_members is null or jsonb_array_length(v_members)<>1
    or exists(select 1 from public.weekly_source_group_clients gc
      join public.weekly_source_group_rule_assignments a on a.source_group_id=gc.source_group_id
      where gc.client_id=v_request.client_id and a.feature_purpose='RULE_SET'
        and (a.feature_enabled or a.feature_release_id is not null or a.feature_changed_at_utc is not null)
        and v_ts.week_ending_date between gc.valid_from and coalesce(gc.valid_to,'infinity'::date)
        and v_ts.week_ending_date between a.effective_from_week_ending and coalesce(a.effective_to_week_ending,'infinity'::date)) then
    raise exception 'CORRECTION_A0_NATIVE_CLOCK_SCOPE_UNPROVED' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  v_member:=v_members->0;
  v_scope:=jsonb_build_object('contract','TIMESHEET_CORRECTION_A0_CLOCK_SCOPE_V1',
    'request_id',v_request.id,'original_timesheet_id',v_ts.timesheet_id,'original_version',v_ts.version,
    'original_booking_id',v_ts.booking_id,'candidate_id',v_request.candidate_id,'client_id',v_request.client_id,
    'contract_id',v_contract.id,'week_ending_date',v_ts.week_ending_date,
    'pricing_origin','SIGNED_CHECK_ONLY_CONTRACT_RATES','rule_set_version_id',null,
    'settings_authority_fingerprint',v_settings->>'authority_fingerprint',
    'timesheet_authority_hash',private.timesheet_correction_timesheet_authority_hash_v1(to_jsonb(v_ts)),
    -- Exact native read input, never labelled as an invented historical rate.
    'contract_input',to_jsonb(v_contract),'controlled_scope',v_member);
  return v_scope||jsonb_build_object('scope_sha256',encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(v_scope::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex'));
end;
